items.text: Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA： BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Nov 4th, 2026 23：00 (UTC) to Nov 5th, 2026 04：00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows：
Brand New Content
I. New Hero： Kael
Ever since merging his soul with Taotie, Kael, once an unremarkable disciple of the Herald, has wielded extraordinary power he can barely control.
He began calling himself The One Who Eats Void and threw himself wholeheartedly into the grand cause of saving the world.
But his soul and Taotie's are still not fully in sync, leaving him caught between ravenous bouts of gluttony and the constant struggle to keep his own desires in check!
II. New Wanchu Weapon： Bident
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/de06b4c7ed259879caed7731d8f024ecf086bc9e.png"]

Legend has it that this weapon was forged by the 'merfolk', criminals exiled to the Deep Ocean by the Herald. An unusual weapon designed for underwater combat, it inherits the Herald's Prowess. A spiral mechanism between its twin prongs stirs up an undercurrent and conjures swirling curtains of water with each swing and thrust, briefly trapping foes and subduing them unseen.
Can only be obtained in Wanchu - Dark Pearl Abyss. It requires water flow to launch an attack, so it's only usable in the water area.
III. Showdown New Gameplay： Vanquisher's Trials

A secret temple lies hidden on The Morus Isle. Those who enter its trials cannot bring their own weapons or souljades. Only by mastering the principles of martial arts can they stand against the powerful foes within. Only those who endure a hundred battles here can truly reach the pinnacle of martial mastery!
1. Rules

・Vanquisher's Trials has two difficulties, Nightscream and Legend, each with three stages： Iron Sunder, Six Paths Trial, and Sandforge Tribulation. (Note： Trios mode does not automatically fill empty team slots. Form a team before attempting the challenge.)
・In Vanquisher's Trials, you can only use preset heroes with their corresponding Souljade and Potential. Each stage offers 4 heroes to choose from.
・Each stage has 4 Challenge quests. Completing each Challenge quest earns you 1 star. Accumulate enough stars to claim limited-time event rewards.
· Legend mode will become available 1 week after the event begins. After that, a new Legend difficulty stage will unlock every 7 days.
2. Rank Rewards
・On legend difficulty, rankings are based on the best completion time for each stage, with separate rankings for solo and Trios.
・After the event ends, players in the top 10, top 100, and top 500 of each leaderboard will receive limited-time title rewards.
3. Showdown： Brand New Souljade
1. Defuse·Surge： Increases Defuse (Counterattack) Damage, and increases your Critical Rate for a set period after a successful Defuse.
2. Critical Transmutation： Reduces the effective Critical Rate cap from Souljade attributes and converts excess Critical Rate into Critical DMG.
IV. Limited-time Event
1. Martial Cutie：
Event Duration： After the update on Nov. 5th 2026 until Dec. 29th, 2026 at 16：00 (UTC)
Event Details：
1. During the event, players can obtain Paw Tally by completing Daily Quests and Weekly Quests.
2. Purchase Items to visit the pet Shop and purchase equipment for your pets to increase their Power!

3. You can challenge pet stages or use Matchmaking to spar with other players, and receive different rewards! You can also upgrade pets. Upgrading pets increases skill levels, Max Health, Bag size, and pet Power.
4. In this event, Molin is available by default. After clearing the pet stages The Morus Isle and Holoroth, you can unlock White Rabbit and Fire Pup respectively.

5. After the update on Nov. 19th, 2026, the new maps Stormchant and The Morus Isle·S will become available, along with Newly added pet equipment, unlocking more ways to Match equipment in battle! Clear the pet stage Stormchant to unlock Spirit Cat.

6. Obtaining 2 identical pet loadouts triggers an upgrade for that pet loadout. A single item can be upgraded to a maximum of 4 stars. All pet loadouts can be sold to the Shop for a 100% return in Paw Tally.
Main updates this time：
1. Pet levels and Fatigue will be shared across all pets, rather than calculated separately for each pet.
2. Newly added \[Paw Leaderboard]： Rankings are based on Ranked Points in "Martial Cutie." Players on the leaderboard will receive title rewards when results are finalized.
3. Newly added pet \, with the exclusive skill \[Qilin Slash]： Grants \ upon entering battle.

4. Newly added weapon type \[Heng Sword], with the exclusive mechanic \[Lethal Jab]： Triggers when a Charged Attack lands a hit, adding 1 extra Charged Attack that deals Damage equal to 0.5 times weapon ATK.
5. Newly added equipment and combat mechanics, along with adjustments to existing pet equipment effects, offer more ways to Match equipment in battle.
6. Pet stages have been completely revamped, with Newly added stage Omens.
7. Season Quests have been changed to Weekly Quests.
2. Devouring Breath
Seize and devour beast souls to nourish yourself, and refine true Qi to achieve the grand cause!
Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)
(1) During the event, complete Daily Quests and Weekly Quests to obtain Soulmeld Elixir. Submitting Soulmeld Elixir increases Chapter Progress, unlocking more chapters and stories.
(2) Chapters must be unlocked in sequential order. You can check \ at any time to view unlocked stories.
(3) Unlock all chapters to claim generous rewards including a Hero-exclusive Accessory, Devourer Treasure, and Serene Treasure Choice Gift.
3. Ashes of the Realm
Through endless trials to ease mortal suffering, a lone blade shatters delusion to calm the storm.
Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)
1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.
2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.
3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.
4. Cold Front's Aspirant
Tempered through a thousand trials, the blade is forged; only at the martial peak can one claim supremacy.
Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)
Event Rules：
During the event, you can gather the exclusive champion collection from the 2025 NARAKA： BLADEPOINT J Cup (Trios and Solo) to earn the champion team's avatars, signed cosmetics, and other rewards.
5. Devourer Treasure with bonus Star - Collections for a limited time
Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 04：00 (UTC) - Nov. 20th, 2026 04：00 (UTC)
Event Rules：
1. When opening Devourer Treasure, there is a chance to receive the Yoto Hime Extreme Collection \[Star - Null Pulse] and the Greatsword Legendary Collection \[Star - Null Vector].

2. How to obtain： Each time you open a Devourer Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you open more Devourer treasures. The maximum chance is 100%.
3. The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
4. Each account can receive a maximum of 10 \[Star - Null Pulse] and 2 \[Star - Null Vector].
5. The number of Star-collections that can be obtained from Devourer treasures is limited. They are available only while supplies last.
6. The Star-Collections granted through the Devourer Treasure are time-limited：
\[Star - Null Pulse] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Nov. 6th, 2026 at 04：00 (UTC).
\[Star - Null Vector] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Nov. 20th, 2026 at 04：00 (UTC).
Marketplace Adjustments
1. The character level required to list items has been increased from 10 to 50.
2. The cooldown before an item can be traded again has been increased from 24 hours to 48 hours.
6. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #11
With swords in hand, free and bold while exploring the world, unrestricted and unhampered. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #11 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration： Nov. 5, 2026 20：00 (UTC) - Dec. 2, 2026 20：00 (UTC)
Event Rules：
Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Cloud Medal - NOV. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows：
1st place： 300 Medals
2nd place： 200 Medals
3rd-4th place： 100 Medals
5th-8th place： 50 Medals
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.
Time
Server
Monday - Friday (UTC)
Saturday - Sunday (UTC)
Start Time of the First Tournament：
7. PlayStation Challenge：
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #32 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
How to participate：
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration： Nov. 5, 2026 00：00 (UTC) - Dec. 2, 2026 23：59 (UTC)
V. Season Exclusive： Devourer Treasure
1. The Devourer Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Kael Extreme Outfit \[Urban Hunt·Echofold Domain] and the Whipsword Extreme Skin \[Silent Frost].

2. While wearing the \[Urban Hunt·Echofold Domain] Outfit, there will be an exclusive \[Data Devour] effect when you defeat enemies. Performing a Double Jump switches between Entropy mode and Dreadshade mode. This form cannot be imprinted.
3. Equipping the \[Silent Frost] weapon Skin changes the Attack Effects of Counterstrike Combos and Souljade \. Once you are out of combat, Silent Frost enters its Aquatic Blossom form.
4. Minimum Guarantee：

(1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

(2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee： Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.

(3) Wishing Legendary Reward： If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.

The first 10 Devourer Treasures that you open will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Devourer Treasures have been opened, subsequent Devourer Treasures will undergo a rollback to their Standard price.
6. Devourer Treasure will be available on Nov. 5th at 04：00 (UTC)!
After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Devourer Treasures will remain locked until the specified time.
The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Spring Lantern·Hua.
VI. Collection Rotation： Removals

The 2023 J Cup·Champion Collection items will be removed from sale on Dec. 30th at 00：00 (UTC). From Nov. 19th to Dec. 30th, we will offer discounts on selected Collections from this series and bring back selected Collections from previous Champion tournaments. Stay tuned!
The following collections will no longer be available：

Champion Forged·Shepherd of Torrents, Champion Forged·LYD, Champion Forged·Wind Guardian, Champion Forged·VVV, Champion Forged·Ethereal Glow, Champion Forged·Leo, Champion Forged·Dire Omen, Champion Forged·TXJ, Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Scepter, Champion Forged·Aetherwing, Champion Forged·Evilbreaker, Champion Forged·Heaven and Earth, Champion Forged·Vastview, Champion Forged·Sandalwood, Champion Forged·Scales, Champion Forged·Pride, Champion Forged·Shimmer Tail, Champion Forged·Shimmer Wings, Champion Forged·Dragon Horns, Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Crown, The Breaker·Bumblebee, The Breaker·Bumblebee Dog, Champion Forged·Feathered Victory, The Breaker·Mike, 2023TE, 2023AOW.
VII. Showdown Event Level \[Demonbane Realm] Returns
Event Duration： Nov. 4th, 2026 20：00 (UTC) to Dec. 2nd, 2026 20：00 (UTC)

(1) During the event, you can select this level on the Showdown Map. Complete each event challenge to get an exclusive Hero Badge, Breakthrough Aura, Exhilarating Elixir and other rewards. This time, the original Carved Crystal and Souljade Fragment rewards have been replaced with a Showdown Material Choice Gift.
//Dev Note： Showdown Material Choice Gifts allow players to replenish whichever materials they need, giving them more flexibility in managing progression resources.

2) Showdown Level in the event will not impact damage dealt or received, and the event levels are split into two chapters. A new rating system has been added, along with many combat items and interactive mechanisms.

Rating System： Team rating is determined by the performance of all players. While basic actions like damage dealing contribute to the team's score, advanced techniques like Counter and Defuse are essential for achieving higher ratings. There are 5 tiers of ratings： C, B, A, S, and SS. Rating decreases over time.

Navigation： After defeating a Boss, airstreams appear to transport you to the next battlefield. If you fall from an airstream, use a Rising Wind mechanism to take off again, or use a Summon Stone mechanism to teleport to the battlefield.

· Environmental interactions： Attacks cause Crimson Mist to release red Toxic Mist. Contact with it briefly increases attack Damage but inflicts the \ status; each time the Thunderstorm Array opens, it creates a circular Thunder Array centered on itself, dealing Thundershock Damage. This can be blocked with a Counter; the Ice Mound can be attacked and recovers on its own, periodically launching frost attacks at nearby heroes.
(3) The two chapters share the same loots including：
Items \[Carved Crystal], \[Phase Rune]
Souljade \[Critical Transmutation] \ \[Venom Tempering] \[Primal Starfall] \[Ice Ring Break] \[Thunder Rove] \[Defuse·Surge] \[Star-Shattering Force] \[Polesword·Blistering Edge]
(4) Each chapter has two difficulty stages that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. Choose difficulty based on your capabilities.
(5) Event stages offer trial access to Kurumi, Viper Ning, Inor Wan and each hero comes with a fixed preset Souljade loadout for trial use.
Hero Adjustments
I. Yueshan
1. During the Rush of the skill \[Scorching Dash], the user can block all types of strike Damage. Enemies hit by the Ram have their Attack reduced by 20% for 6 seconds.
2. The Damage Multiplier of the skill \[Scorching Dash] has been reduced from 1.0 to 0.7
II. Kylin Zhang
Adjusted Ultimate \[Qilin Slash： Rend]：
1. Slash's Health cost adjusted from 300 to 250
2. Health Recovery when a slash hits 1 enemy adjusted from 150 to 125, and Health Recovery when it hits multiple enemies adjusted from 350 to 300
3. Health threshold for triggering \[Qilin Guard] adjusted from 300 to 450

//Dev Note： We have reduced the Health cost of Kylin Zhang's slashes during his Ultimate and increased the Health threshold for triggering \[Qilin Guard]. These changes aim to let Kylin Zhang maintain relatively higher Health in combat while keeping the number of slashes he can perform roughly unchanged, improving his survivability during his Ultimate.
III. Underwater Combat Adjustments
1. For heroes who use special weapons after activating their Ultimate, including Yoto Hime, Ye Xiu, Yueshan (Almighty General), and Inor Wan (Thunder Lord)：
Optimized the impact effects of their basic underwater horizontal and Vertical Strike attacks so that enemies' hit reactions better reflect underwater physics.
2. The Vajra, Bronze Mech, Xunhuan Li in Flying Knives Aim mode, and Cyra in her Ultimate state can Jump repeatedly while underwater.
IV. Other Adjustments
1. Newly added the \[Hard Control] skill tag. Control effects from skills with the \[Hard Control] tag can affect Ultimate Focus, as well as the Bronze Mech and the Vajra.
・Includes skills： \[Moonbane Control], \[Rising Tide], \, \[Light's Mercy： Field], \[Fate Rewritten： Backtrack], and \[Maw of Ruin].
Souljade Adjustments
1. Polesword Souljade
1. Optimized the reactions to the attacks from \[Thunder Portal]
The Herald's Trial Rank and Points Rule Adjustments
I. Newly Added Ranks
1. The minimum rank score in The Herald's Trial has been adjusted from 1,000 to 0 points.
2. Newly added two ranks below Bronze： \[Plain Stone] (0 - 499 points) and \[Gray Lead] (500 - 999 points).
II. Earn Rank Points in Quick Match
1. Rank points have been updated. Quick Match and Ranked Mode now share Rank Points.
2. Quick Match only awards points and never deducts them, allowing you to reach up to 1,500 points.
3. After reaching 1,500 Rank points, play Ranked Mode to continue earning more.
III. Hero Score Adjustments
1. Quick Match now also grants Hero Score for The Herald's Trial, with the calculation capped at 1,500 points.
2. Playing Quick Match will not deduct Hero Score.
IV. Rerank Challenge Adjustments
1. Unranked players can still play Quick Match, but it will not progress the Rerank Challenge.
2. The Rerank Challenge must still be completed through Ranked Mode.

3. Added a new trigger condition for the Rerank Challenge： players must reach at least 1,500 points in The Herald's Trial. The Rerank Challenge will no longer place players in Bronze rank. Players who have already unlocked Ranked Mode and triggered the Rerank Challenge can still complete it.
V. Points Carryover Rules
1. Players who have unlocked Ranked Mode will retain their existing Rank Points in Solo, Duos, and Trios.
2. Players who have not unlocked Ranked Mode will receive initial Rank Points based on their account level before the update, ranging from 0 to 1,000 points.
3. Below 1,000 points, Solo, Duos, and Trios share Rank Points, and no points are deducted. Above 1,000 points, points are tracked separately for each mode.
In-game Adjustments
I. Wanchu Adjustments
1. Cerulean Crystal Palace and its surrounding buildings have risen above the water. The water depth in Dark Pearl Abyss has been reduced to 35m.

Dev Note： Legend has it that when Nuxin raised Wanchu from the seabed, the Dark Pearl Abyss in the bottom-right corner could not fully surface. It was pinned down by the "Heaven-Supporting Jade Pillar." Over time, however, the seal has gradually loosened.
2. Adjusted the distribution of resources and Soul Altars in Dark Pearl Abyss.
3. Slightly increased the chance of Starry Night weather occurring.
4. Increased the number of Golden Flame and Violet Coralline spawns, and reduced the number of Coralline Branch items required to craft Armor.
5. Simplified rock formations in several locations to make movement and climbing easier.
II. The Evolution Adjustments
1. Increased the EXP and BP EXP gain rates for Defeats, Rescues, and Damage in The Evolution;
2. Increased the chance of obtaining Epic and Legendary Technique rewards after winning in the Realm of Yang;
3. Increased the quantity and spawn rate of \[Valiant Challenge] and \ Quest Scrolls in The Evolution;
4. Increased the EXP and BATTLEPASS EXP gain rates in The Evolution.
Out-game Adjustments
I. Talents Feature Optimization
Talents can now be modified during th preparation stage.
Newly added a "Change Potential" button to the existing Glyph Plan switching interface. Tap this button to open the adjustment interface.
Each change is saved immediately and will also carry over to your out-of-match settings or your next match.
II. World Chat Channel Optimization
Increased the maximum number of players who can chat simultaneously in the World Chat channel.
III. Profile Interface Adjustments
Newly added Martial Artist Duel·Competition statistics to the My Info and Season Stats interfaces.
The highest win streak and average Damage per match for this mode only count matches played after this update. Historical data from before the update is excluded.
I. Kaleidoscope Parasol
1. The final hit of the Parasol-form charged Horizontal Strike move now knocks airborne enemies farther away.
2. Reduced the stagger inflicted on knocked-down enemies by the \[Kaleidoscope·Shift] moves in all forms.
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. In-game Gameplay Optimization
1. Adjusted some quests on the Stormchant Bulletin Board.
2. Optimized the interaction prompts for \[Treasure Coffin]. The opener's priority looting period has been adjusted to 30 sec.
3. On the Stormchant map, reduced the time required to open \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] in the Cave.
II. Weekly Contract Reward Adjustments
The Advanced Century Chest Trial Card reward from Weekly Contract has been replaced with a Storage Choice Gift. Open it to choose either an Advanced Century Chest or an Advanced Key Case.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Adjustments to Viper Ning's Ultimate \[Moonbane Control： Showdown]：

① Newly added effect： Summons \[Moonbane's Eye] to gaze at nearby enemies for 25 sec. During this time, \[Moonbane's Breath] continuously surges forth to strike gazed enemies. Hitting an enemy with an Aegis-break Martial Skill or Defuse (Counterattack) triggers an additional \[Moonbane's Breath].
② Viper Ning is immune to Freezing during summoning.
③ Viper Ning's Ultimate cannot be canceled midway.
2. Adjusted Yueshan's skill \[Rampage： Showdown] while in Almighty General form： After a hit on an enemy, he can instantly perform his exclusive Charged Attack.
3. Adjusted the damage multiplier of Yueshan's charged heavy strike in Almighty General form from 20 to 30

4. The effect of the \[Thunder Rove] Souljade has been changed to： "When your team's Thundershock Meter is full, the summoned Divine Thunder can be Countered and no longer causes Stagger. Divine Thunder reflected by a Counter strikes back and forth in a straight line. Increases Elemental Accumulation efficiency by 60%. (Incompatible with Souljade： \[Thunder Counter])"

5. Increased the Damage Multiplier of all basic Defuse (Counterattack) moves to 3 times their previous values and reduced their Astral Aegis multipliers to 50% of their previous values. These changes improve the overall Damage output and Astral Aegis Damage performance of Defuse (Counterattack).
II. Function Adjustments
1. Optimized Souljade Deconstruction
When deconstructing an individual Souljade in your inventory, you can now directly deconstruct it even if it is equipped or locked.
Feature Adjustments
I. Client
1. Refactored the game's underlying resource-loading mechanism, significantly reducing main-thread stuttering during heavy loading for smoother loading and more stable performance.
Store Updates
I. New Packs

1. Newly added Viper Ning exclusive Pack \, which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Cold Front·Cinderbloom] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Cold Front·Emberplume]. Standard price： 2,600 Gold; Now： 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

2. Newly added Cyra exclusive Pack \, which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Cold Front·Godsgrace] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Cold Front·Light-hearken]. Standard price： 2,600 Gold; Now： 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

3. Newly added Justina Gu exclusive Pack \, which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Cold Front·Rimewing] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Cold Front·Silver Abyss]. Standard price： 2,600 Gold; Now： 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

4. Newly added Kael exclusive Pack \[Void-Eater], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Void-Eater], Legendary Hairstyle \[Ominous Splendor] and Legendary Hero's Theme \[Ravenous Taotie]. Standard price： 3,400 Gold; Now： 2,250 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Heng Sword Legendary Skin \[Cold Front·Frostshade]. Standard price： 1,500 Gold; Now： 1,000 Gold.
2. Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Pose \[Cold Front·Blade of Judgment]. Standard price： 900 Gold; Now： 600 Gold.

6. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Background \[Candlelit Tale·Shattered Crimson Moon]. Standard price： 600 Gold; Now： 400 Gold.
7. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Background \[Neon City Night]. Standard price： 600 Gold; Now： 400 Gold.

11. Newly added Zenda Wu Legendary Hairstyle \[Creatures Myth·Dire Conquest]. Standard price： 800 Gold; Now： 600 Gold.
12. Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle \[Bestiary of Wonders·Chaos Waste]. Standard price： 800 Gold; Now： 600 Gold.
13. Newly added Kael Epic Outfit \[Heavenwoven Brocade]. Standard price： 600 Gold; Now： 400 Gold.
III. New Items in Item Store
1. Newly added item \[Nom-Nom Crate] with a price of 240 Gold. Limited to 4 purchases.
Using it randomly unlocks an unowned Kael Urban Hunt Collection item (4 in total). Crate rewards will not repeat. Once you own all Collection items, opening a crate grants Spectral Silk*2400.
See the NARAKA： BLADEPOINT Direct-Sale Gift Rates for full details and drop rates.

(1) Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Accessory \[Cold Front·Inkthorn] with a price of 240 Jade Disks;
(2) Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Accessory \[Cold Front·Rimetear] with a price of 240 Jade Disks;

items.text: Brand New Content
New Chapter in Rift Traversal：Stormchant, Hongmen Banquet

As the Qin dynasty fell, Xiang Yu crushed its armies at Julu, overawing the feudal lords. Liu Bang entered Guanzhong first, guarding Hangu Pass and encamping at Bashang. Upon hearing that "the Duke of Pei intends to rule Guanzhong," Xiang Yu flew into a rage and planned to attack the next day. Knowing he stood no chance, Liu Bang went to Hongmen to apologize. During the banquet, Fan Zeng had Xiang Zhuang perform a sword dance to assassinate Liu Bang. Liu Bang had no choice but to excuse himself and escape along a side path...
I. In-game Adjustments
1. Activity：\[Preparing the Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Outerworld 2 minutes after the match begins.
1) Return the scattered dining tables, seats, long tables, and other furnishings to their places to set up this important banquet.
2) Once preparations are complete, you can claim a Crate reward and take a seat at the banquet to receive 1 additional reward.
2. Activity：\[Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Innerworld 8 minutes after the match begins.
Activity Overview：Dark undercurrents stir at the Hongmen Banquet. The hero must stay vigilant at all times and resolve Fan Zeng and Xiang Zhuang's treacherous plots against Liu Bang.
1) Stage 1：Use a Blue Focus Strike to interrupt Fan Zeng's \[At the Drop of a Cup]. Successfully stopping him grants rewards and reduces the number of attacks Xiang Zhuang launches.
2) Stage 2：Use Counter to block the repeated deadly attacks aimed at Liu Bang during \[Xiang Zhuang's Sword Dance].
3) Receive 1-3 Crate rewards based on Liu Bang's remaining health at the end.
3. Activity：\[Escape from Hongmen]. Spawns in the Innerworld 11 minutes after the match begins.
Activity：Liu Bang leaves the Hongmen Banquet on a pretext. The hero must escort him past the pursuing Chu Soldiers and back to the Han Camp. Reach the destination to receive a Crate reward.
II. Newly Added In-Match Mechanisms
1. Rewind Device

After activating the device, offer Relics worth the required value to reset Lootable Containers within range once the countdown ends. Eligible containers：Lootable Containers, \[Legendary Crates], and \[Epic Crates] (excluding Crates obtained from Caves, quests, or puzzles).
2. Treasure Coffin

Newly added the interactive Lootable Container \[Treasure Coffin] to the Stormchant map. Opening it requires the special key \[Coffin Crowbar], grants high-value Relics, and consumes \[Coffin Crowbar] durability. \[Coffin Crowbar] can be found during matches or obtained from the Trading Market.
III. Xiling Seal Art Society Crossover

1. New in-match gameplay added to the Stormchant map：Pick up a \[Seal Casket] in the Outerworld to unseal the map's August Banners and collect Duke of Pei Tokens. ​III. Cyra

​IV. Matari

​V. Tara Gan
​1. \[Fate Rewritten]'s Glyph duration has been adjusted from 18 seconds to 20 seconds.

​1. For the Ultimate \[Mech Mayhem], the Bronze Mech's enhanced cannon damage has been increased from 3.2 to 3.5.
​VII. Xunhuan Li

​1. For the Skill \[Petal Knives] and Ultimates \[Untouched Leaf] and \[Untouched Leaf： Flow], under Resolved stance, using a Horizontal Strike or Vertical Strike could now fire Flying Knives, instead of merely using the Skill.

​2. Decreased the continuous Rage cost of the Ultimate \[Saving Grace： Aegis]. When cast at full Rage, the duration is adjusted from 16 seconds to 18 seconds;
​IX. Zenda Wu

​X. Shayol Wei

I. Katana Adjustments

​II. Congeneric Skill System Adjustments
1. Now, Congeneric Skill can only be used after equipping the Souljade \[Switch·Radiance].

​12. Increased the stagger caused by Short-handle Weapon Resonance Strikes.

items.text: Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 16th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 17th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
I. Casual Mode: Martial Artist Duel·Competition
· In Martial Artist Duel·Competition, every Hero's initial Rage will start at 100%.
· The competition will be played in a best-of-five format. The first player to win three battles is the winner.
· Players need to select the Heroes and weapons they will use in the preparation phase before the match. The same heroes and weapons can't be selected.
· The winner of each battle must be decided within a certain period of time. If both players are still standing at the end of the battle, then:
(1) The player who deals more damage wins;
(2) If the above values are the same, the player with the higher remaining Health and Armor wins;
(3) If they are still the same, the player who deals damage to the opponent first wins.
· Each player's Health, Armor, and Skill CDs will be reset after each battle.

items.text: Chaos descends on Lin'an. The Nexus Gate opens. Heroes raise their blades to cut down the Enchanted, dispel the darkness, and restore peace to the mortal world.
1. Basic Rules

Chaos seeks to corrupt Lin'an City. Heroes must wipe out monsters under the pressure of the chaotic Shadow Corruption, grow stronger, and finally pass through the Nexus Gate to defeat the Enchanted boss within and dispel the chaotic corruption.
Some Showdown heroes are available in this mode. None of the Showdown out-of-game progression carries into this mode.

· Each match randomly assigns a weakness to the final Enchanted Boss (weak to Melee/Element/Ranged). Plan your route based on your spawn location, the Boss's weakness, and the resource stronghold drop tendencies for that match.
· Clear an entire resource stronghold or defeat an Elite/Boss monster to obtain Souljades from stronghold chests. These Souljades apply to your in-match gear.
· Defeat monsters to gain EXP and raise your team Level. Each resource stronghold has a recommended Level, attacking one above your team Level will be extremely difficult.
· The Realm of Eclipse appears after a set time each match. Challenge the boss inside for generous rewards! If you fail, well... there's always the next run!
· In the late game, a Nexus Gate leading to the final Enchanted Boss appears within the safe zone. Watch the timer and head there. As Shadow Corruption spreads, the area will be affected as well.
· There are also some surprise items in the scene waiting to be discovered!
2. Out-of-Game Progression
Skyfall Cataclysm progression only takes effect in this mode.
· Complete matches or quests to earn "Calamity Crystals", used in the Skyfall Fateboard system to unlock fateboards and boost strength.
· Defeating monsters may also yield "Lingering Artifacts". One artifact can be activated per match for powerful extra effects.

Skyfall Cataclysm boosts only take effect in matches, but Fatigue can still be spent to obtain various Showdown progression materials and secure the current version's top-tier set immediately.
Skyfall Cataclysm offers two difficulties with different Fatigue costs, but Souljade drop rates are the same across all stages.

I. New Hero: Ye Xiu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8d533b85142e32a0cf735e213929a18a37817e6a.png"]
He has stood at the peak and weathered the lows. Ten years of passion, unchanged at heart.
The master who forged a three-peat legend. The captain who rebuilt from nothing after a snowy night.
Thirty-seven straight wins. Four-time MVP. After leaving Excellent Era, he started over with Lord Grim at Team Demeter and climbed to the top once more.
Perhaps true glory was never about standing at the summit. It lives in the love that never fades.
II. New Weapon: Kaleidoscope Parasol
Legend speaks of a cunning artisan from Lunazra who, vexed by the weight of carrying many weapons, shaped this parasol — its ribs woven of fine machinery, its core housing a hundredfold of blades.
Open, it scatters like sudden rain and whirling petals. Closed, it returns to the wrist like a dragon curling back to its lair. There is no fixed state, only the seamless turn of strike and ward.
III. Showdown New Gameplay: The Boundless

On the path of Showdown, the heroes have fallen into "The Boundless," a trap laid by Omnius. As they break through layer after layer of illusions, they gradually gain the power to stand against the Omens.
1. Customized Omens and Scoring Rules
· Defeating monsters in The Boundless rewards different amounts of score based on monster type.

· During the preparation phase, you can customize the Omens activated for the match. Each Omen provides a score multiplier bonus—higher-quality Omens grant higher bonuses, and bonuses from different Omens are multiplicative.
· The Boundless quests have been added to Season Challenges, completing which unlocks more new Omens.
2. Challenge Rules

· The Boundless is divided into two modes—Solo and Trios. Each mode contains three stages: Celestra, Shadowjade Mine, and Shipwreck Expanse. Your final score is the sum of your scores across all three stages.

· Across the three stages of a mode with the same player count, reusing a Hero, Souljade, or Curio will incur a score deduction penalty each time (Souljades or Curios that share a name but are separate instances are not counted as repeats). Please try to bring different loadouts into battle.
· Trios mode does not automatically fill the party, so please pre-make a team before starting the challenge.
3. Gameplay Rewards
· Based on your all-time highest total score across the three stages in Solo or Trios mode, you can unlock deluxe rewards such as an exclusive Showdown Profile Background and Aura Effects.

· Each week, The Boundless leaderboard will also rank players based on their total Solo and Trios scores and the time they reached the leaderboard, granting limited-time Title rewards to players ranked in the Top 500, Top 100, and Top 10.

(1) The Spirit Deer will no longer appear in the Outerworld; it will only spawn in the surface areas of the Innerworld.

(2) Only Herb-type items can now be fed to it, and the rewards gained from feeding have been increased. There is also a very small chance to trigger a Petting interaction—after petting the Spirit Deer, you will receive a hefty reward.

4. Refurbish: Optimized the jump function when refurbishing Celestia equipment—clicking now takes you directly to the corresponding Fix Kit slot.

II. Preview of Upcoming Content

Since the release of "The Boundless," many Showdown players have been keeping an eye on the development progress of another game mode (codename: Chaos Outbreak) and content related to the new season. We have therefore decided to share part of our upcoming update plans with you ahead of time.
1. The brand-new mode "Formless Calamity" (former codename: Chaos Outbreak) will go live in a future version.

This time, the heroes of the Showdown will arrive at Lin'an City. As Chaos gradually closes in, they will level up and randomly obtain various Souljades, items, moves, and more, facing all sorts of random, powerful enemies.
Meanwhile, in Formless Calamity, heroes cannot carry over their Sense level or Souljade progression. Instead, it features an independent progression system to help resist the Chaos.
2. Comprehensive Optimization of the Recast System in the New Season
① Aura Points guarantee: Every time you recast a Souljade's attributes and values, you accumulate "Aura Points." Once the progress bar is full, you can directly claim a Flux Shard!
(Recast can no longer randomly roll rare attributes, and the rare-attribute pity will also be removed. After Aura Points go live, your existing pity progress will be converted into Aura Points.)
② New item "Jade Essence": Use "Jade Essence" to imbue a chosen attribute for a one-time, substantial value boost, directly increasing the attribute by a fixed percentage of its maximum value.

· The attribute values of Souljades produced in dungeons will be fixed within a set range, so attributes at or near the maximum cap will no longer appear. There is also a certain chance to produce Jade Essence.
· When recasting with "Jade Essence," if an attribute value would exceed its cap, a corresponding amount of progression items will be refunded based on the excess as compensation.

//Dev Note: With this Recast rework, our goal is to improve everyone's progression experience: 1. Thanks to the new Aura Points mechanic, you no longer need to consider recast order, greatly reducing the learning and usage costs of recasting Souljades. 2. With the new "Jade Essence," we hope to solve the problem where players currently need to hoard many Souljades, causing management difficulties and insufficient storage space; you also won't need to check the attribute values of every settled Souljade after each match.

Starting in the new season, you no longer need to complete all weekly quests. Completing each quest grants Activity Points, and once you reach the required amount of Activity Points, you can claim all weekly rewards.

items.text: Brand New Content
I. Rift Traversal New Chapter: Stormchant Part I

The Qin was rotting from within. Marching convicts to Mount Li, Liu Bang saw them scatter into the night — so he freed the rest and vanished into the Mangdang Mountains. But the peaks ran with blood: charlatans butchering villagers in the name of a Snake Emperor made flesh. So Liu Bang climbed, to burn out the evil at its root…
1. Gameplay
1) The Stormchant chapter will continue the dual-realm mechanism: Outerworld is in Co-op Mode and Innerworld is in Rival Mode
2) The Map structure will be divided into two layers, surface and underground, which can be switched freely on the Map interface
2. In-Game Quests
1) Regular Quests: Added new in-match map quests \[Secret Delivery], \[Tomb Search], \[Book Search], and \. Completing quests grants corresponding secret chests and Relics rewards.

(2) Snake Guardian: Jointly slay the Snake Guardian, the boss located in the Shaohao's Altar area of the Outerworld. Collect the Snake Emperor Token obtained from quests, place any two of them at Shaohao's Altar to force it to reveal itself. After defeating it, you can open the White Emperor Crate. The team that deals the highest damage to the boss will receive additional crate rewards.

3) Awaken Liu Bang: After defeating the Terracotta General in the hidden chamber, purple essence will guide players to Liu Bang's location. Find the unconscious Liu Bang and remove 3 seals to awaken him and activate the special evacuation points.
3. In-game Adjustments

1) Old Sophora: Heroes in the Outerworld can offer surplus relics to Old Sophora. Based on their accumulated blessings, Old Sophora grants global buffs active only in the Outerworld—two tiers total, with random effects each match.
Blessing Effect List

2. Blessing I - Complete in-match quests in the Outerworld to earn extra Void Coin rewards
3. Blessing I - Earn extra Void Coin each time you open a Lootable Container
4. Blessing I - Damage to monsters +10%

2) Bulletin Board: Heroes in the Outerworld can accept quests from the Bulletin Board to earn rewards.

3) ​The spirit deer wanders randomly throughout the Outerworld and Innerworld. Feed it any item, and it may give you an item in return; if you happen to feed it something it likes, there is a chance to improve the spirit deer's mood. At this time, petting the spirit deer will make it give better items in return.

(4) Fiendish Relic: When searching Lootable Containers in the Dang Royal Tomb of the Innerworld, there is a chance to find a chest entwined with fiendish bane. 8) Seller Sincere's Shop: Seller Sincere has opened a new gameplay shop in Stormchant for you. By betting on the heads or tails of two Void Coins, they can obtain Relics payout odds of up to 4x.

(9) Rift Gate Compass: Can be purchased from Rift Dealer during a match. After use, it can guide you by direction to discover the location of a hidden Rift Gate. The Rift Dealer sells 5 per match. Only the player who reaches the Rift Gate location first can submit the compass; subsequent compasses can only indicate the Rift Gate's location.

notes.title: The details for this update are as follows

items.text: Brand New Content
I. Introducing an all-new map: Wanchu!
Wanchu drifts on the vast sea, Twin Luminaries light the past.
Five major areas
Twin Luminaries City: A lost civilization that worshipped twin deities. Statues of the twin monarchs still stand within the royal city, sheltering this empty city that fell in the previous calamity.

Valley of the Colossus: The resting place of the ancestral elders from the previous calamity. Massive broken stone statues and ancient beast bones lie half-buried in the wild grass, silent and enigmatic.

Immortal-Seekers' Ruins: The old traces of the expeditionary force lie scattered between the shores and cliffs of a foreign land. The alchemy furnace has gone cold, the sails never returned, and only an unfinished old dream of immortality.

Wave Fort: An ancient settlement nestled against the mountains and beside the water. Its houses, docks, and star platforms have long fallen into ruin, yet still preserve a silent, orderly rhythm of life.

Dark Pearl Abyss: Beneath the Abyssal Depths, shadowy blue palaces emerge and fade from view. Giant White Jade pillars stand in the center of the Undercurrent, and amid the shifting pearlescent glow, whispers seem to rise from the deep waters.

1. Tide: Initial water level in Tidewater Channel varies by match weather. Each match has two tide cycles. At first shift, Tidehidden Cave's seal breaks — break the stone gate to enter and open high‑value Stashes. At second shift: high water spawns Tide Fish (attack for high‑value drops); low water spawns Spirit Clams (open for high‑value drops).

2. Conch Boat: On the 2nd Spirit Well refresh, the map prompt changes to a Conch Boat warning. After countdown, a Conch Boat appears in the warning zone. Board it and capture the Spirit Well for free rare items.
3. Oracle monarch
Ethereal Descent: Finish in the top 2 to fill progress. Once full, you can interact with \[Ethereal Descent] during the match to obtain \[Ancient Oracle·Ethereal Descent].
Primal Echo: Pick up \[Conch Pearl] in a match to fill progress. Once full, you can interact with \[Primal Echo] during the match to obtain \[Ancient Oracle·Primal Echo].
Divine Grace Vault: If both \[Ethereal Descent] and \[Primal Echo] are activated in this match, the vault will open, containing the Oracle Monarchs' treasure – \[Sea of Calamity].
4. Foundry: This map adds 6 brand-new Armor types, which can be crafted through the new "Foundry" tab at the Rift Dealer!
Soul-Devouring Armor: Can devour Armor of higher quality than itself, or special Armor effects, up to 3 effects
Habitat Armor: If not attacked for 3 seconds, restores 25 Armor per second.
Aquatic Armor: While underwater, oxygen is no longer consumed.
Rock-Steady Armor: Poison and Burn Damage are borne by Armor first, and you will not die from Poison or Burn Damage
Thick Hide Armor: Max Health +200
Sharp Bone Armor: Attack +8%
5. Unsinkable Cave: Deep within Dark Pearl Abyss lies a hidden cave. Defeat the guard and fight for the divine treasure that steadies the seas!
6. Remnants' Crate: A hidden crate in the main hall at the center of Valley of the Colossus. Only those who know its secret can open it.
7. Flame of Shoushan Spirit Well: Appears at Elder Plateau shortly after match start. Capturing it grants resources and a flame aura that burns enemies who enter its radius.

8. Sacred Ruins Blessing: A healing circle appears at Remnant Ruins early in the match. Reviving here restores recovery. Upon first near‑death, the Remains progress bar fills automatically until you revive.
1. Windstride Tether: Vines in Valley of the Colossus can be used with a grappling hook or interaction to slide, allowing special attacks.
2. Cache Hunt Map: Gold Stashes and Green Stashes have a chance to drop a Cache Hunt Map, revealing nearby treasure spots.
3. Gecko: A magical creature that changes color. Hitting it at different colors grants corresponding lasting effects.
4. Soul-Breath Coral: Stay close to continuously restore oxygen.
5. Iron Urchin: A curious item from Wanchu. Throw it quickly after picking it up, or it will explode and injure you.
6. Boiling Hot Spring: Players within its range can use the spring to quickly rush to the surface.
7. Pelican: Bring it some fresh small fish. Feeding them to the Pelican yields the treasure in its beak.
8. Ironback Turtle: Hitting the head deals damage; hitting the shell triggers a Clash. Two successful head hits reward you with its treasure.
9. Pufferfish: Hitting a Pufferfish underwater releases a large amount of poisonous gas.
10. Dive: Some platforms in deep-water areas can trigger the diving.
11. Water-Warding Fish: Appears in deep-water areas. Interact to be swallowed, restoring oxygen; upon being spat out, gain level-3 Momentum.
12. Golden Flame Coralline, Violet Coralline, Azure Wave Coralline, Stingtail Fish, Angelfish, Azure Finch Fish: Interact to collect into your Bag for crafting specific Armor at the Foundry.
II. ​Season Shop
1. Earn Season Weekly Activeness by playing any mode. Resets every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). Fill the progress bar to unlock Season Treasure Coins for the season Shop.
2. Myriad season Shop runs for two seasons. Available: Jul 2, 2026 Update – Dec 30, 2026, 00:00 (UTC).
3. During Myriad season, spend Myriad Treasure Coin on items, or combine it with next season's Treasure Coin when the new season arrives.
4. Some items unlock after specific times or conditions. Check the unlock requirements please.
III. Season events
1. Martial Cutie
Event Duration: Jul. 2nd, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 16:00 (UTC)
1) During the event, players can obtain Paw Tally by completing Daily Quests and Season Quests. In the pet shop, purchase equipment for your pets to increase their power!

2) You can challenge pet stages or match with other players for pet battle, and receive different rewards! You can also upgrade pets. Upgrading pets increases Skill grade, Max Health, Bag size, and Pet power.
3) In this event, Fire Pup is available by default. After clearing the pet stages Morus Isle and Holoroth, you can unlock White Rabbit and Spirit Cat respectively.
4) Obtaining 2 identical ​pet loadouts triggers an upgrade for that ​pet loadout. A single item can be upgraded to a maximum of 4 stars.
5) All ​pet loadouts can be sold to the shop for a 50% return in Paw Tally.
2. Baize Farm
Event Duration: Jul. 2nd, 2026 Update - Oct. 9th, 2026 00:00 (UTC)

3. Celebrate This Moment
Event Duration: Jul. 2nd, 2026 Update - Jul. 29th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)

1) During the event, players who complete The Survival Modes, Showdown, Rift Traversal, and Casual Modes will receive corresponding Soulbloom Coins at the end of the match based on in-match actions (including but not limited to dealing Damage, Counter, and Healing). Up to 1400 Soulbloom Coins can be earned from matches each week. notes.title: 2. You can now display your Photo Booth in the lobby

items.text: · Use the "Switch Lobby" button in the bottom function bar to switch to Photo Booth mode. In the Photo Booth interface, you can set a designated setup as the lobby for The Herald's Trial/Rift Traversal/Showdown;

· A Photo Booth can only be displayed in the lobby if it meets both of the following conditions: (1) it has 3 display characters; (2) the Character Pose in the Photo Booth are allowed to be displayed in the lobby (you can check the tags in the Gesture pop-up description in edit mode).

3. After forming a team outside a match, you can sync a teammate's lobby Photo Booth to your own lobby. Players can manually cancel the sync, or it will be canceled automatically after quitting the team.
4. Photo Booth Edit Mode Adjustments
· Added a new "Lobby Position" setting under characters, allowing you to set each character's corresponding identity in the team (yourself or teammate);
· Added a new filter option, "Available in the Photo Booth Lobby," for character poses, which can be used to quickly filter poses that can be displayed in the lobby;
· Added a new "Lobby Scene" category for scenes, allowing you to use past lobby scenes since the Righteous season to edit your Photo Booth.
VI. Fairyland Penglai Refresh

1. A new \[Shanghai Museum] collaboration theme and display mechanisms now grace the Seraphic Quartet in Fairyland Penglai. Explore the exhibition, interact with the displays, view the collection up close, and listen to guided narration — where ancient heritage meets The East.
2. A new explorable deep-water area is now at Tidewatch Shoal in Fairyland Penglai, with platforms that trigger the diving. Grab your swimwear and splash around with friends!
3. A new gameplay feature, \[Supreme Gift], has been added to Fairyland Penglai. Passing by with a "Rare Title" equipped can trigger an extra Easter Egg!
Location: North side of the Pantheon / Seraphic Quartet in Fairyland Penglai
1) When a player with a "Rare Title" passes in front of Bebu and Beba on the north side of the Pantheon in Fairyland Penglai, they will receive a warm welcome!
2) Bebu will wander near the Seraphic Quartet and toss up passing players. Having a "Rare Title" can trigger a surprise event!
3) When a player with a "Rare Title" dances on the dance floor in the Music Zone, a surprise event can be triggered!
VII. Rerank Challenge
A new returnee Rerank Challenge feature has been added to The Herald's Trial Ranked Mode.
1. Trigger Conditions

· Rerank Challenge activates upon returning to the game after missing 2 or more consecutive "The Herald's Trial" seasons. Your rank will be reset to "Unranked" and must be re-evaluated through ranked matches.
2. Rerank Challenge Duration
· The Rerank Challenge is valid for 30 days from activation.
· If the challenge remains incomplete at the end of this period, your rank will be automatically set to the season reset reference rank.
3. Settlement and Reranking
· Each ranked match contributes to Rerank Progress. At 100% progress, the system evaluates your overall performance and match quality to determine your final rank. Maximum settlement score: 3900.
· After the first-time settlement, you can choose to rerank again. Players whose initial settlement score exceeds 3800 are not eligible for a second-time rerank.
· The second-time Rerank Challenges are even more challenging. Completing all progress may yield a higher score than the initial settlement, though poor performance may result in a lower score.
4. Party Rank Restrictions
· During Rerank Challenge, you may party with players ranked between Bronze V and Astral I. Matchmaking will prioritize the highest rank within the party.

III. Multi-Mode Matchmaking Function
1. Function Overview: The three major modes—The Survival Modes, Casual Modes, and Rift Traversal—all support multi-mode simultaneous matchmaking now.

(1) The Survival modes: In Ranked Mode, Quick Match, Immortal War, and BOT Mode at each difficulty, Solo/Duos/Trios can be simultaneously selected for matchmaking, but cross-submode Matchmaking is not supported.
(2) Casual Mode: The Evolution, Capture the Spirit Well, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport can be multi-selected for simultaneous Matchmaking.
(3) Rift Traversal mode: Under Tranquil Path, Perilous Path, and Doomed Path, multiple options can be selected for simultaneous matchmaking.

3. Timeout Matchmaking: After enabling "Multi-Select Mode," you can enable the "Match All on Timeout" function. This function allows modes not in the checked list to automatically join the queue after Matchmaking times out (this function becomes invalid after the "Multi-Select Mode" function is turned off).
4. Special Restrictions: Modes currently in "Rerank Challenge" status do not support simultaneous Matchmaking.
​IV. The Survival Modes Map Rotation
1. Wanchu supports single selection;
2. The Morus Isle no longer supports single selection;
3. The Maelstrom has been temporarily removed, but can still be selected in the Custom Room.
V. Fairyland Penglai
1. Added weapon switching to the top function bar
VI. Chat Channels
1. Enabled the use of the World Channel, the nearby channel in Fairyland Penglai, and the nearby channel during the match preparation phase
​VII. Feature Adjustments to Some Red Dot-Related Functions
​1. Optimize the "Clear All Red Dots" function
The "Clear All Red Dots" function in the original settings has been moved to the lobby. At the same time, we have added some function red dots that can be cleared with one tap.
This function from the original settings will be temporarily retained.
2. The launch event red dots for Showdown and Rift Traversal have been changed to one-time red dots. They will disappear once you enter the event page.
3. The weekly refreshed red dot for Gold Hunt will no longer carry through to the lobby.
VIII. Teammate Highlight Pop-up
A new teammate highlight pop-up function has been added to The Herald's Trial mode (excluding Casual Mode).
1. After a match ends, if your current team performed well, a teammate highlight pop-up will appear to display your teammates' stats from that match.

2. The stats cover multiple categories, including Damage dealt, number of Counters, number of Revives, number of Ranged headshots, and Hero-exclusive performance (such as Cyra's Ultimate healing and Tianhai's Grab count). Up to 3 standout stats will be automatically selected and displayed after the match.
3. The stats come with ratings: "Extreme," "Legendary," "Epic," and no rating.
4. After the highlight pop-up is triggered, you can unlock an intimate relationship with your team members in advance within 24 hours.
IX. Intimacy System Revamp
1. The max Intimacy level cap has been increased to 100.
2. The friend memories interface has been revamped. You can now switch between viewing intimacy privileges, stats, and close friend events.
3. After forming an intimate relationship with a close friend, brand-new exclusive intimacy privileges will be unlocked based on your Intimacy grade, as follows:
① Weekly team-up privileges (can be triggered once per week in total; resets every Wednesday at 20:00 UTC):
· The Herald's Trial: Score protection is triggered automatically when ranked points would be negative
· Rift Traversal: The first time you find a Legendary item in a Lootable Container, you receive a double amount
· Showdown: After clearing, you additionally receive the \[Intimacy Privilege Showdown Gift Pack] item
· Advances once every 5 levels
· Advances to the highest-tier badge at Intimacy Lv. 46

③ Custom intimate relationship title: Unlocks after reaching Intimacy Lv.15. You can customize the intimate relationship name and choose whether to display it on your profile card and squad display interface.
4. Added friend event records to display your recent shared experiences with friends.
X. Notification Pop-up Decorations
1. A new \[Notification Decoration] tab has been added under \[Other Cosmetics] - \, where you can preview and equip notification decorations.

2. After equipping a notification decoration, when other players receive notification pop-ups such as your online alert, team-up invitation, or arena Challenge, the corresponding decoration will be displayed.
3. After equipping a notification decoration, system notification pop-ups received by the player themselves (such as Heroes Assemble opening) will also display that decoration.
4. The first notification decoration, \, can be unlocked for purchase by obtaining the brand-new Hero Badge \[Deep Bonds·Emerald].
​XI. Photo Booth Updates
1. In the Photo Booth, some Gestures will be expanded for use by all Heroes, providing more Inspiration for creation;
2. After unlocking the Outfit \[Mistveil Sorceress], you can also obtain the Photo Booth exclusive Gesture \[Melody in Arms];
3. Added 1 official multiplayer template and a new free universal scene \[Summer Party].
​XII. Platform Adjustment EPIC Platform Account transfer

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be officially delisted from the Epic Games Store on December 30, 2026, and the Epic version will no longer receive updates thereafter. After the Anniversary version update on July 2, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will no longer be available for additional purchase or download on the Epic Games Store.

From the July 2 update through December 30, Epic players can log into the game and follow the migration prompt to the account transfer page to complete registration. (If the prompt doesn't appear after you log in, don't worry — transfer will be rolled out in phases.) All data and game progress will be transferred to the new account.
·For more details, please visit the official website.
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. Shanghai Museum Phase IV Crossover Collectibles Now Available

Event Duration: July 1st, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC) to July 15th, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC) During the event, a new progress bar will be added to the bottom right of the Lobby interface: Crossover Collection·Shanghai Museum Phase IV. Search Lootable Containers in matches to accumulate progress on the bar. Once full, you are guaranteed to find a crossover collectible. After the event ends, you can still obtain collectibles from this series by searching Lootable Containers.
II. Out-of-match Optimization
Battle Edict: Optimized the loadout plans for the Advanced Battle Edict.

//Dev Note: We've received player feedback that the Advanced Battle Edict previously included off-hand weapons, Spare Weapon, and Combat Items with relatively low practicality, and that the positioning of the loadout plans was not clear enough. In this update, we removed redundant equipment and redesigned the loadout content around three clear directions: strategy, survival, and damage output. This makes the style of each plan more distinct and helps players quickly choose the battle configuration that suits them best.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
​1. Optimized the slashing effects of the echo form in Kylin Zhang's \[Qilin Slash·Showdown].
​2. Optimized the visuals of the Mystic Roar Formation in Shayol Wei's Curio \[​Suppression Scroll] effect.
Store Updates
I. Yin Yang Pool·Luminaries Available

​1. Each time you open the Yin Yang Pool, you need to consume one \[Ingot·Luminaries], priced at 400 Gold. Upon opening, you will have a chance to obtain 22 rewards including Cyra's Legendary Outfit \[Ethereal Descent], Zenda Wu's Legendary Outfit \[Primal Echo], Cyra's Legendary Gesture \[Radiance Shatterer], and Cyra's Legendary Pose \[Radiance Descends].
​2. The first opening is free, and you'll receive different rewards each time. You can open up to 21 times to collect all the rewards in the prize pool.
3. When obtaining a special reward, you will also receive Cyra's Legendary Gesture \[Radiance Shatterer] and Cyra's Legendary Pose \[Radiance Descends].

​4. While opening the Yin Yang Pool, there is a chance to claim all the remaining rewards at once. After obtaining all rewards, you can click the recycle button on the event page to enter the recycle interface and recycle any remaining unused \[Ingot·Luminaries] into free Gold.

Based on the above drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least one Gold (Legendary) reward within the first 4 draws. Another guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 5 more draws, followed by the next guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 7 more draws.
II. New Packs

​1. Added the limited-time Kylin Zhang pack \[Abyssal Descent], containing Kylin Zhang's Legendary Outfit \[Abyssal Descent] and the Repeating Crossbow Legendary Skin \[The Wavechaser]. Standard Price: 3,300 Gold; Now: 360 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger. (This pack and each cosmetic in it will be available for a limited time from July 2 to July 16)

2. Newly added Justina Gu exclusive Pack \, which contains Justina Gu Legendary Outfit \[Dragon Will·Seeking] and Justina Gu Legendary Hairstyle \[Dragon Arts·Diligence]. Standard price: 3,200 Gold; Now: 1,900 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

3. Newly added Lyam Liu limited-time Pack \[Lagoon Breeze], which contains Lyam Liu Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Lagoon Breeze], Lyam Liu Epic Hairstyle \[Summer Party·Tidal Breeze], and Lyam Liu Legendary Accessory \[Summer Party·Chic Shades]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 1,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger! (This Pack and each cosmetic in it will be available for a limited time from July 2 to July 16.)
III. Discounts
1. Newly added Hadi Legendary Ultimate Accessory \[Ancient Isle·Cinder Wraith] (Unlock to get a new appearance for Hadi's Ultimate). Standard price: 4,800 Gold; Now: 2,000 Gold.
2. Newly added Longsword Legendary Skin \[Wooden Fishing Rod]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
3. Newly added Legendary Mark of Victory \[Inkshadow Dragon]. Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
4. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture \[Thrilling Slide] for male heroes. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
5. Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Pose \[The Dragon·Eight Trigram Palm]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
6. Newly added Lyam Liu Epic Pose \[Summer Party·Toast]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold. (Only available for purchase during July 2nd to July 16th)
7. Newly added Legendary Stash Skin \[Golden Vengeance Cache]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
8. Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Hairstyle \[Ancient Isle·Violet Iris]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
9. Newly added Legendary Background \[Piacevole Seabreeze] for all heroes. Standard price: 600; Now: 400.(Only available for purchase during July 2nd to July 16th)
10. Newly added Xunhuan Li Legendary Background \[Ethereal Court]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
11. Newly added Legendary Base \[Cozy Vacation] for all heroes. Standard price: 1,200; Now: 800.(Only available for purchase during July 2nd to July 16th)
12. Newly added Xunhuan Li Legendary Base \[Jade Crest]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
​IV. New Collections
1. Newly added item \[Diving Surprise Box], limited to 6 purchases, priced at 120 Gold.

After use, you will randomly unlock an unowned accessory from the Diving Tank series (6 in total), including: Happy Soda, Bubble Tea, Wellness Brew, Eco Bottle, Beba Fluffy Cup, and Bebu Fluffy Cup. The Diving Surprise Box is limited to 6 purchases. If you already own all Collections, you will receive Spectral Silk*1200.
​V. Battlepass Update

\ Battlepass is now available, containing a large number of rare items and Collections! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking Advanced Hidden Treasure! The Treasure Scroll costs 1,200 Gold, and the Glory Scroll costs 2,840 Gold.

The Glory Scroll has been fully upgraded! Purchase it to instantly reach Lv. 29 and receive exclusive rewards: Avatar Frame \[Scarlet Wing], ​Myriad Boost Gift, Imprint Roller×5, Dye Cream×20, Glazed Crystal×10. You will also enjoy a 30% weekly mission XP Bonus. More content for the same price!
VI. Collection Rotation
​To welcome the massive amount of new Anniversary content arriving on July 2, the shop will undergo a collection rotation. Please see the official website announcement for the detailed list:

1. Themed Outfits Refresh: After the update, along with the launch of the Anniversary, we will rotate out the direct-sale Outfits of the \[Reversal Flows] and \[Timeless Beauty] collections, as well as the 2022 and 2023 direct-sale J Cup Champion Skins, to make way for brand-new themes coming soon.
2. Hero and Weapon Collections Refresh: After the update, we will add new Outfits and Weapon Skins into the collection rotation pools. Please stay tuned!
3. Packs and individual cosmetics will rotate out together. After the update, the packs and cosmetics related to the above collections will also be removed from the store temporarily.
4. Rotating collections out of the store will not affect the use or display of items already owned by players at all.
​VII. New Arrivals In Lunar Pavilion
Limited-time return of previous Anniversary limited Legendary Collections, available until 20:00 on October 8, 2026 (UTC)

1) Newly added Classic Outfit Choice Gift, priced at 360 Jade Disk, limited to 1 purchase. Includes Viper Ning - Jade Lady, Kurumi - Yamabuki Tea, Wuchen - Investiture of the Gods·Shen Gongbao, Matari - Reversal Flows·Wintertide, Tessa - Bountiful Spring.

​2) Newly added Classic Weapon Choice Gift, priced at 300 Jade Disk, limited to 1 purchase. Includes Dual Blades - Lacerator, Greatsword - Coiled Dragon, Staff - Spiked Tumbler, Repeating Crossbow - Powderkeg-Tech, Fan - Night Glow, Musket - Silent Judgment.

3) Newly added Classic Match Choice Gift, priced at 160 Jade Disk, limited to 2 purchases. Includes Viper Ning Legendary Accessory - Soulwreath, Tessa Legendary Hairstyle - Startled Sparrow, Background - 2nd Anniversary, Background - Honor Tresses, Background - 4th Anniversary, Base - NARAKA Cake, Base - Throne of Might, Base - Celebration Cake.
Bug Fixes
I. Battle-related Bug
1. Fixed an issue where the Grappling Hook could fire in an abnormal direction when aimed at fast-moving enemies.
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from June 4th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to June 5th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

II. Strange Turbulence
Artifacts adrift from distant seas have washed upon Fairyland Penglai; above Perdoria, a star array dormant for a millennium has reignited. Both anomalies may point to the same unknown land.
Hero Adjustments
I. Shayol Wei
1. After casting the \[Shield Bash], Shayol can now perform a special dodge without consuming Stamina.

2. The Rage consumption for Ultimate \[Justiciar's Guard] and \[Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit] has been adjusted to: 55% is consumed immediately upon casting, and 15% is consumed each time \[Black Tortoise Block] is triggered. The maximum number of blocks remains unchanged.
3. The counterattack move of Ultimate \[Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit] will no longer trigger \[Black Tortoise Block].
II. Matari
1. Slightly increased the attack range of \[Flash: Thrust] while in the Ultimate state.
III. Lannie
1. The airborne height of enemies hit by the Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce: Leap] finisher move is slightly increased, while damage is reduced from 3.2 to 2.8.
//Dev Note: After adjustment, using this move to knock enemies airborne can be followed up with combos or Trick Ball, so damage has been slightly reduced for balance.
IV. Kurumi
1. Using the Skills \[Healing Ray] and \[Healing Ray: Defense] to cast links has been adjusted to a Golden Focus, excluding the hold-to-aim phase.
2. Optimized the position selection logic for summoning the Light Parasol of Skills \[Healing Ray] and \[Healing Ray: Defense].
V. Xunhuan Li

1. For the Ultimate \[Untouched Leaf], the base damage multiplier range of Divine Intent-consuming Flying Knives has been adjusted from 2.1-4.2 to 1.8-3.6, and the maximum aiming duration has been adjusted from 6 sec to 4 sec.
VI. Temulch
1. In Solo mode, adjusted the cooldown time of Skill \[Zephyr Wisp] from 18 sec to 21 sec. It remains unchanged in Duos/Trios.
VII. Akos Hu
1. In Solo mode, adjusted the damage dealt by the charged attack of skill \[Roar: Blast] from 2.0 to 1.5. It remains unchanged in Duos/Trios.
VIII. Zenda Wu
1. Adjusted the visual effects when casting skill \[Winged Assault: Summon].
The Evolution Adjustments
I. New Techniques
1. General Techniques
\[Nine Lives] Every 5,000 hit damage dealt grants a \[Mortal Defiance] Souljade.
\[Aerobic Exercise] Every 1,500 hit damage dealt increases max Health by 100. Each time you are Countered, 40% of this bonus is deducted.
\[​Charge Investment] ​Each time a Melee Weapon Charged Move hits, Charge Damage +4%. Each time you are Countered, 30% of the bonus is deducted.
\[Hit a Brick Wall] ​​When an enemy clashes with you, they additionally lose 25 weapon durability.
\[Strength Speaks] ​If the enemy's durability is below 30% during a clash, they will be Stunned for 2 sec.
\[Erudition·Treading the Void] Obtain Souljade \[Erudition·Treading the Void], and one Rare "Spear"
\[Tai-Chi Fan·Domain] Obtain Souljade \[Tai-Chi Fan·Domain], and one Rare "Fan"
\[Benthic Descent·Falling] Obtain Souljade \[Benthic Descent·Falling], and one pair of Rare "Dual Halberds"
\[Palm Lightning·Extension] Obtain Souljade \[Palm Lightning·Extension], and one pair of Rare "Flying Knives"
\[Tempest Kick·Biting Cold] Obtain Souljade \[Tempest Kick·Biting Cold], and one pair of Rare "Fistblades"
\[Jabbing·Pierce] Obtain Souljade \[Jabbing·Pierce], and one Rare "Staff"
\[Heartstopper Kick·Eternal] Obtain Souljade \[Heartstopper Kick·Eternal], and one Rare "Spear"
\[Pride's Fall·Circling] Obtain Souljade \[Pride's Fall·Circling], and one Rare "Dagger"
2. Hero Techniques
\[Fate Rewritten: Protect] Ultimate \[Fate Rewritten]Triggering Rewind additionally grants a shield; when the Glyph remains untriggered, Recovery is increased.
\[Fate Rewritten: Fierce] Ultimate \[Fate Rewritten: Backtrack] Meteor inflicts Vulnerable on enemies it hits.
II. In-game Adjustments
1. A new \[Spirit Well] has been added in the mid game; after capturing it, the entire team gains a huge amount of cultivation essence;
2. In Omens matches, you can open the Bag interface to view Omens Details.
III. Technique Adjustments
1. Removed Techniques \[Counter Confidence] from The Evolution and Evolution·Capture the Spirit Well
2. In The Evolution, the Techniques \[Shopping Voucher] and \[Currency of Survival] have been removed.
3. Stats Adjustments
\[Moonbane Control: Engage] Adjusted the stun duration of Moonbane's Eye when triggered early from 2 sec to 3 sec.
\[Moonbane Control: Attach] Adjusted the Damage Multiplier of Moonbane's Eye from 1.0 to 1.8.
\[Titan's Call: Mighty Leap] Adjusted the stomp's Damage Multiplier from 2.6 to 3.0.
\[Mech Mayhem: Charge] Enabled automatic Charging for the Cannon and greatly reduced the cooldown for transforming into Cannon mode.
\[Qilin Slash: Shadow] Adjusted the spirit's additional slash Damage Multiplier from 0.5 to 1.0.
\[Thunderforged: Thunder Core] Increased Energy Recovery speed by 12.5%.
\[Arctic Wraith: Blizzard] Added additional Damage to Snowstorm with a 1.0 multiplier.
\[Untouched Leaf: Rest] Increased Resolved Energy Recovery by 25%.
\[General's Call: Rejuvenation] Adjusted the second-stage Ultimate's Damage Multiplier from 0.2 to 3.0 and the Recovery multiplier from 5.6 to 1.2.
4. Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue of Tianhai's Technique \[Titan's Call: Mighty Leap] where Jumping and Stomping times are abnormally restored.
In-game Adjustments
I. Easy Battle
In The Survival modes, the \[Full Pockets], \[Rift Dealer Discount], \[Souljade Expansion], and \[Instant Upgrade] Omens have been removed, and the following 2 Omens have been added:
(1) \: Melee weapons have a relatively high chance not to consume durability when attacking.
(2) \[Battle Ready]: Start with a random Common weapon, Rare Armor, and additional consumables
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. New Amulets
1. Spirit Seal·The Wandering Monk
\[Titan's Call: Restore] Continuous Recovery duration is extended by 5 seconds, and Jump stomp Damage is increased
​During the \[Titan's Call: Restore], Jump-Stomp's uses recharge over time. Hitting an enemy instantly grants another use immediately.
2. Spirit Seal·Yoto Hime
​\[Demon Blade: Combo] After the final extra combo hit lands, you can press the Vertical Strike button to continue slashing
\[Demon Blade: Combo] Ultimate Damage +25%
Amulet Adjustments
1. \[Spirit Seal·Justice Vigilant]
· Each Black Tortoise Block now consumes 20% Rage when triggered.
· Using a counterattack consumes 20% Rage.
2. \[Spirit Seal·Wuwei Marquis]
· New Effect: Increases \[General's Call] duration by 3 sec.
3. \[Spirit Seal·Echoes of Qilin]
· New Effect: While \[Qilin Slash: Rend] is active, Skill and Ultimate damage +10%
4. \[Spirit Seal·The Loyal Drunk]
· New Effect: While \[Fire Frenzy] is active, using Elbow Strike or Knee Strike restores damage dealt as Health or Armor for 5 seconds.
II. New Match Replay Function
1. Players can now download match replays for the Rift Traversal mode.
2. Match replays can be downloaded in \[Match History] - \[Rift Traversal]
· Only match replays within 7 days can be downloaded and viewed. After each game version update, old version match replays will expire and cannot be played.
· Replays are affected by network fluctuations and device specifics, and may not fully match the actual situation.

3. Currently only replays of your own team are available for viewing. You can view the spectated character's status and bag contents at any time. The replay will end after your own team is eliminated.
4. Currently only replays of your own team in Rift Traversal mode are available for downloading, and Rift Traversal mode replays cannot be shared.
III. Equipment Balance Adjustments
1. Celestia Armor \[Solid Bond Breastplate]: Adjusted the effective distance. Only teammates within 80 meters, when using Healing Berries or Armor Powder, will grant you 60% of their recovery effect.

//Dev Note: Previously, teammates could use recovery items at extremely long distances, providing healing to the holder. Now the distance is limited to 80 meters, requiring more reasonable positioning to provide a balanced battle experience.
· When a Celestia equipment is brought into the match with depleted Toughness, its Forged attributes will become invalid.
· Zero-Toughness Celestia equipment picked up in the match also has its Forged attributes invalid.
· Celestia equipment that has its Toughness depleted during normal combat in the match is not affected, and its attributes still take effect.
//Dev Note: Although restrictions had been made to the zero-toughness equipment before, it still bring a negative experience in combat. This adjustment imposes further restrictions.
IV. In-Match Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where drops in the original area could not be picked up after a new Lootable Container spawned.
2. Fixed an issue where the Alchemy Furnace could be interrupted during the Boost process.
3. Fixed incorrect description of the \[Great Fortune] effect in Relic Mysteries.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Curio Update and Yama's Abyss Leaderboard Settlement
Showdown is expected to launch new Curios on June 17th, along with balance adjustments to some Curios and Heroes.
1. New Curios can be directly crafted using Targeted Craft, but this will expire after the end of this season.

2. After the update, the challenge of Floor 10 will be temporarily suspended until the leaderboard is settled. At the same time, after Floor 10, we will increase monsters' HP and Astral Aegis, and reduce Attack, to optimize the current combat experience.
Feature Adjustments
I. Client

1. Added NVIDIA DLSS 4.5, powered by the second-generation Transformer model, for further AI-enhanced improvements to both image quality and performance. All of these technologies are continuously refined by NVIDIA's cloud-based AI supercomputers. Dynamic Frame Generation will be available in the next version—stay tuned!
2. Added Intel XeSS 3 integration, enabling Multi-Frame Generation on Intel graphics cards, with up to three AI-generated frames to further enhance game performance, smoothness, and visual quality.
Store Updates
I. Lucky Wheel
Event Duration: Jun. 5th, 2026 Update - Jul. 1st, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, you can select desired rewards from each tier to create your own unique exclusive prize pool, consisting of 10 rewards.
Brand-new rewards: Tessa Extreme Outfit \[Mistveil Sorceress], Lannie Legendary Outfit \[Strange Tales·Foxling], Fan Legendary Skin \[Ninefold Shadow], and more.

2. Use the corresponding number of \[Fiend-Binding Seal] to draw. Prizes drawn are removed from the current round's pool and will not be obtained again. A maximum of 10 draws guarantees all rewards in the pool.
