VI. Oracle Season's Immortal War is now available
Immortal War will be available on April 9th.

After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards. (Including Serene Treasure Choice Gift, Floral Dew, Legendary Weapon Skin and etc.)

Players who make it into the Top 500 in Immortal War will enter the Immortal Leaderboard. This leaderboard is updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, players that earned a special title this way will receive an Avatar reward as well. A player who is on the Immortal Leaderboard at the end of the season will receive an additional Avatar reward.
In addition, the Top 3 players of the last tally will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.
VII. Mr. Black Crossover related in-game items have been removed
Hero Adjustments
I. Kylin Zhang
1. Adjusted uncharged slash Damage Multiplier during the Ultimate \[Qilin Slash: Rend] from 1.8 to 2.0.
II. Shayol Wei
1. Ultimate \[Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit] now grants 70% Recovery on counterattack hit.
III. Zenda Wu
1. Improved arrow tracking performance for marking enemies with the derivative skill \[Penetrating Arrows] of Zenda Wu's Ultimates \[Spiritbound Bow] and \[Spiritbound Bow: Duskfall].
IV. Akos Hu
1. \[Roar: Blast] cooldown in Solo adjusted from 22 sec to 25 sec.
2. Ultimate \[Feral Frenzy] initial Rage consumption adjusted from 40% to 60%. Total Ultimate duration remains unchanged.
3. In Trios, \[Feral Frenzy] grants 10% Attack while active.
V. Xunhuan Li
1. In Solo, \[Petal Walk] cooldown adjusted from 22 sec to 25 sec.
2. In Solo, Divine Intent recovered through Resolved, Windstep, and Petal Walk during Ultimate adjusted from 15%/7.5%/20% to 10%/5%/15%.
3. \[Untouched Leaf] Divine Intent Flying Knives Damage Multiplier range adjusted from 2.25–4.5 to 2.1–4.2.
4. \[Untouched Leaf: Flow] Divine Intent Flying Knives Damage Multiplier adjusted from 1.1/0.9/0.9/0.9/1.6 to 1.0/0.8/0.8/0.8/1.4 (total Damage Multiplier adjusted from 5.4 to 4.8).
Weapon Adjustments
I. Dual Flintlocks
1. Slightly increased the charge speed of \[Bullet Hail].
2. When equipped with \[Rev Up & Buried Fire], releasing the Souljade \[Iron Lotus Bloom] allows planting bombs with the first 6 hits, and the final hit triggers an explosion.
Combat Adjustments
I.
1. Fixed a bug where hits from different directions could cause inconsistent stagger duration.
2. \[Spirit·Dash] can no longer be immediately canceled by walking. The combo window for the collision action has been moved earlier, and the hit stun duration when collided with has been increased.

Dev Note: While preserving gameplay consistent with other combat mechanisms, we have moderately delayed the pivotal moment for both parties in combat, providing more time for players to react, optimizing the dueling experience for both sides.
3. Fixed a bug with the damage calculation of the Anima Ring \[Fatal Finish] in Nirriti's Ruins.
II. Out-game Talents Adjustments
1. \[Strategy·Shared Fortune] has been deleted (original effect: increased Luck and Team Discount).
\[Strategy·Bounty]: In the Survival modes, + 5%/10%/15%/20% Dark Tide Coins when completing Scroll Quests.
Adjusted to: +0.35%/0.75%/1.1%/1.5% Team Discount, +10%/20%/30%/40% Pawnshop Buyback Discount.
3. \[Strategy·Spender]
Adjusted to: Every 1,000 Dark Tide Coins spent increases Attack by 0.3%/0.6%, up to 12 stacks. In Immortal War, every 2,500 Dark Tide Coins spent increases the number of stacks by 1.
4. \[Spirit·Agility] has been deleted. (Oiginal effect: Stamina Cost for Dodge, Quick Dash, and Wild Sweep Dash -5%.) The stamina consumption of all players has been reduced by 5%.
Replaced with: \[Spirit·Free]
5. Original \[Spirit·Free]
Replaced with: \[Spirit·Dash]. While sprinting, hold Dodge to Rush. You move faster and knock back enemies on start. Consumes Stamina every second.
6. Original \[Spirit·Dash]
Replaced with: \[Spirit·Counter Guard]. Upon a successful Counter, Silence enemies for 1/2 sec, and increase your own Attack by 5%/10% for 8 sec. This effect can be triggered once every 60 sec.
7. \[Body·Resolute]: Damage Reduction duration after activating Ultimate adjusted from 15 sec to 20 sec.
In-game Adjustments
I. Feature Adjustments
1. \[Martial Artist Solo·Ultimate] Optimizations
(1) In Trios, Custom Room settings now strictly require all heroes across different lineups to be unique.
(2) Each battle now starts with approximately 15 sec of free movement, during which a barrier separates the combat area.
2. In keyboard and mouse mode, Skills, Ultimates, and the Counter shortcut can now be used while the Bag screen is open.
II. New Combat Items Bag
The \[Extreme Weapon Shard Bag] from the \[The Maelstrom] map has been renamed to "Combat Items Bag." Combat Items such as \[Moonbane Charms] will now be stored in this bag.
This bag is also active in all Survival modes, The Evolution, and Capture the Spirit Well.
In The Evolution and Capture the Spirit Well, the Combat Items Bag is located below the Technique bonuses.
III. Gameplay Adjustments
1. Immortal War Duos/Trios will have a smaller initial safe zone radius.
2. The radius of the safe zones for the second, third, and fourth Shadow Corruption have been expanded in Immortal War Solo.
3. While carrying out the \[Sunwing Flagbearer] Quest, players will continuous recover Health.
4. Items dropped by first- and second-round Spirit Wells in Immortal War are now protected for a period of time.
5. Players will no longer get a Power of Beasts from capturing the second-round Spirit Wells in Immortal War Solo.
6. In Immortal War Solo matches, Divine Beast Spirit Wells will refresh at the same time as Yang Spirit Lines.
7. The number of Rebirth Charms per match in Immortal War Duos/Trios has been reduced from 5 to 3.
8. In Immortal War mode, the price of Bag Upgrade items has been increased from 2,500 to 3,000 Dark Tide Coins.
Out-game Adjustments
I. Match Replay Optimizations
1. Match Replay unlock level adjusted to Level 20.
2. Added Share Replay function. Tap the Share Replay button on the Match History screen to share a replay to chat channels.
3. Newly downloaded replays now display a notification dot.

4. In the Match History screen, modes that support replay downloads now include a \[Copy Match ID] button. Tap to copy the Match ID. In \[Match History] > \[Local Replays], tap the Download Replay button and enter a Match ID to download the specified replay.
II. Out-of-Game Chat Channel Interaction Optimizations
1. Updated the interface layout. More information is now displayed by default, such as avatars and titles.
III. Fairyland Penglai
1. While in Fairyland Penglai, opening the close friend list now shows recommended Fairyland Penglai islands and recently visited ones.
2. Added Fairyland Penglai Lobby IDs. You can now search for and visit a specific Fairyland Penglai by its ID.
3. Enriched Zenda Wu's idle animations.
IV. Season Quests
1. Completing quests earns "Season Quest Points," which unlock the season-exclusive Hero Badge "Oracle Season Challenge." Season Quest Points reset at the end of the season.
2. Stage 1 quests unlocked.
V. Close Friend List Dropdown Adjustments
1. The Add Nickname button has been added to the "Manage" menu.
VI. Hero Score Calculation Adjustments
The Threshold for Ranked Score has been increased from "Asura" to "Formless Dragon".
For detailed rules please check Hall of Fame interface.
VII. The Herald's Trial, Quick Match, BOT Mode, and other game modes now support map selection.
· You can select multiple maps simultaneously when Matchmaking.
· Select at least 2 maps The Herald's Trial; Select at least 1 map in Quick Match and BOT Mode.
· Interaction experience optimized with added map preview videos
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. Mode Adjustments
1. Solo and Trios Tranquil Path are available in the \[River Runs Red] now. Perilous Path unlocks at Reputation Lv. 8.
2. \[The Aquila's Past] Tranquil Path has closed.
II. Out-of-Game Adjustments
1. Optimized the sorting of Rift Traversal items in the inventory.
2. Optimized the \[Today's Rewards] calculation logic. When expanding the Storeroom or submitting collectibles to the Collections, the value of consumed items will still be calculated correctly.
3. Due to Rift Traversal map difficulty adjustments, the range of maps where main quests and season quests can be completed has been adjusted.
III. In-Game Adjustments
1. Added new Relic spawn points to some \[River Runs Red] Caves.

2. After triggering a \[River Runs Red] Mechanism Hall, a notification now identifies the triggering player. In addition, after successfully solving a Mechanism Hall in the Outerworld, the triggering player has priority interaction with the Secret Case.
3. After successfully solving a \[River Runs Red] hidden room puzzle using Relics, the solver has priority interaction with the Secret Case.
4. Slightly adjusted the timing at which certain Combat Items can interrupt Ranged Martial Skill shots.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Reduced Shayol Wei's Defuse stance recovery frames. Increased the Focus level of \[Justiciar's Guard: Showdown] counterattack recovery frames and optimized combo flow.
2. Justina Gu's follow-up attack after \[Shadowswipe: Showdown] no longer benefits from Defuse (Counterattack) bonuses. Changed to Aegis-break Martial Skill bonuses instead.
3. Kylin Zhang's \[Qilin Slash: Showdown] new effect: \[Wrath Slash] now counts as a Counterstrike and benefits from Counterstrike-related bonuses.
II. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
1. Removed the Anima Rings \[Bolt·White], \[Bolt·Blue], and \[Miasma·Lotus].
2. Adjusted \[Bolt Chain]'s effect to: After hitting an enemy with Bolt, there is a 25%/40%/50% chance to trigger an additional Bolt (the chance increases with the Anima Ring level).
3. Adjusted \[Bolt·Might]'s effect to: At each stage of charging, trigger 1/2/3 Bolts at the enemy closest to you (the number increases with the Anima Ring level).
4. Adjusted \[Bolt·Red]'s effect to: After a successful Counter, strike the Countered enemy with 1/2/3 high-damage Bolts(s) (the number increases with the Anima Ring level).

5. Adjusted \[Bolt·Defuse]'s effect to: On successful Defuse against any attack, trigger 1/2/3 high-damage Bolts at the source of the resisted attack(s) (the number increases with the Anima Ring level).

6. \[Element·Lotus] is now a Dual Anima Ring, with its effect changed to: Summon a Lotus that lasts for 40 sec when triggering Elemental Burst or inflicting \ on monsters. Lotuses follow you and cast \[Lotus Impact] at enemies. Up to 4 can be summoned per second.
7. Adjusted \[Bolt Blessing I]'s effect to: Weapon Attacks trigger Bolt.
8. Adjusted \[Thundershock Blessing II]'s effect to: Successfully countering Divine Thunder grants a 50% Attack bonus for 15 sec.
III. Drop Rate Adjustments
Nirriti's Ruins Fatigue per run increased from 45 to 60. \[Carved Crystals] earned per clear increased to 8 (9 for Nirriti's Ruins Innerworld).
Drop rates for certain main campaign stages, including Fatigue cost and Carved Crystal amounts, will be further adjusted in future updates.
IV. Yama's Abyss Exploit Penalty Policy
Last season, we observed some players exploiting a bug to skip monster phases in order to climb the leaderboard.

This season, we have improved our development process to prevent such bugs while also upgrading our detection systems for Yama's Abyss violations. All attempts to skip phases will be logged. We have also strengthened our enforcement policy:
Confirmed violations will result in score removal and a temporary ban from the Yama's Abyss Leaderboard. Severe cases may lead to tournament suspension or account penalties.
Store Updates
I. New Packs

1. Newly added pack \[Vegetables Fairy Pack (All)], containing the Legendary Heng Sword Skin \[Vegetables Fairy·Scallion Eel], Legendary Fistblades Skin \[Vegetables Fairy·Durian Bunny], and the Epic Bubble \[Vegetables Fairy·How Could This Be]. notes.title: New Hero and Weapon: Zenda Wu and Dual Flintlocks Ignite the Battlefield

items.text: The brand-new hero, Zenda Wu, is set to make her official debut in this update, alongside the ranged weapon, "Dual Flintlocks".

Zenda Wu is a formidable female hero who can summon a spirit bird companion to assist in battle,. her own archery skills are devastating, allowing her to fire a single, high-powered arrow or unleash a wide-area arrow storm.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/520581174a4a832c6d3b078df25897fceb263849.jpg"]

The Dual Flintlocks offer tactical versatility with two distinct firing modes. In "Alternating Fire" mode, the pistols can fire left and right in a continuous cycle. In the "Bullet Hail" mode, players can charge and then release to fire bullets at an extremely high speed.

notes.title: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/52de4e8fb6b899c20a6a959d93e4cb63aa47fd4d.jpg"]Extensive In-Game Events & Rewards: All Heroes Unlocked and Treasures Galore

items.text: Beginning February 4th PT, a series of in-game reward events will be going live in Naraka: Bladepoint. After this update, every hero in the game will be unlocked and freely accessible to all players for 35 days. Additionally, players can obtain two exclusive skins—Justina Gu's "Ink Dyed·Spring Ripples" and Dagger's "Sugarcoated Sweetheart"—by participating in daily login and regular activities. Throughout the entirety of the event, players will have the opportunity to earn a total of more than 50+ Treasure Boxes. A special Spring Festival Treasure Pool will also be available, offering chances to acquire premium cosmetics including Zenda Wu's new Extreme Outfit, Dagger's Extreme Skin, and other exquisite appearances.
Two New Game Modes Update: Strategic Battles and Chaotic Fun

Two distinct new game modes will also be launched within Naraka: Bladepoint, offering players a fresh in-game experience. The first new mode, River Runs Red, features a unique dual-realm structure: the Outer World and the Inner World. Players can engage in PvE exploration and puzzle-solving within the Outer World, and seamlessly transition to the Inner World to participate in large-scale PvP battles. This innovative design delivers the thrills of both solitary exploration and multiplayer combat within a single, cohesive mode.

The entertainment mode - The Evelotion focuses on a more chaotic and ability-powered spin on the battle royale formula. With more revival opportunities and lower stakes, this mode encourages players to engage in more diverse and entertaining gameplay. Players can adhere to the fundamentals with powerful strikes and bare-handed counters, or master skills instead of relying on ultimates, or even focus on defense, strengthening your dodge to weave unscathed through the fray.
The February update for Naraka: Bladepoint is now live. Jump into the game and experience the new gameplay！

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Feb 4th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Feb 5th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
Brand New Content
Brand New Content
I. New Hero: Zenda Wu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/24d7ef5682f15d17e772cd9072c0fd2896e0dca6.png"]
She has no name and no memory, only Chaos Qi and a bow that never misses. She drifts through the world like smoke in search of answers.
The Wu speak to what lies beyond and trace all things to their source. In their village, hidden deep in Arbott's sinkhole, she found a hearth, a name, and something worth fighting for.
To keep that hearth burning, she will leave it behind. She will step into the rift and face the darkness that made her, with her bow drawn and ready.
History will not repeat itself.
II. New Weapon: Dual Flintlocks
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/b8cb6b4815b2f9034d49dbfc6b15100e3b217124.png"]
The artificers of Lunazra have reforged the musket into compact dual-wielded form—now capable of alternating barrage fire or channeling devastating charged shots.
Alternate. Barrage. Detonate hidden flames. Now... heed the echoes of oblivion.
III. Rift Traversal New Chapter: River Runs Red
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/66a4ebbcc52ff401f0aa14745464f6806009299e.png"]

In the tenth year of the Shaoxing era, General Yue Fei routed the Jurchen army against impossible odds. Yet twelve golden tablets of decree arrived from the Emperor, commanding his retreat. The court clung to its fragile peace. Though he fought to turn the tide, he was undone by scheming ministers and imperial suspicion. As talks of surrender loom, the dream of reclaiming the north fades to nothing. But among the people, resentment still smolders, and dark undercurrents stir beneath the surface...
1. Dual World System
Players spawn in Outerworld. After a certain time, the Sundial will be unlocked for you to interact and enter Innerworld.
Outerworld: All teams are allied and cannot deal damage to each other. Proximity chat and voice channels are enabled.
Innerworld: All teams are hostile and deal normal damage. Quests offer richer rewards and more extraction opportunities. Proximity chat and voice channels are disabled.
Once you enter Innerworld, there is no return. Choose wisely.
2. Hawker System

When your Risk Trophy Value exceeds the \ threshold, you enter a state of \. While in this state, you cannot extract from Outerworld Rift Gates and must use Innerworld Rift Gates instead. A \ icon will appear above your head.
Calculation of Risk Trophy Value: Current Trophy Value - Century Chest's Trophy Value
\ Threshold: 1.5 Million in Perilous Path, 1.8 Million in Doomed Path
(When your Risk Trophy Value drops below the threshold, \ state is removed after 10 sec)
3. In-Game Quests
1) Added in-game quests: \, \[Get Treasures], \[Get Items], \, \[Sneak In], \[Letter Search], and \. Completing these quests rewards Crates and Relics.
2) Added in-game quest \[Prison Break]. Follow Yue Fei to the dock to gain rewards and a chance to escape by taking a ship.
4. In-Game Mechanics
1) The Execution Ground event triggers at Innerworld execution site. Participate to claim rewards.
2) Spring Piercer·Divine Soul spawns in Innerworld. Defeat the Jurchen soldiers who have come to confirm Yue Fei's death, honor his spirit, and claim rewards.

3) The King Qian Bow spawns in Outerworld. Offer relics to King Qian Bow to activate it, and then capture it to gain its might: the power of the tides, making the waters by Snowbank Hall recede. Head to the exposed area to fight the boss together.
The team that deals the most damage to the boss receives bonus Crate rewards.
4) Keys to Qin Estate Dungeon can be obtained from other quests. Use them to explore the dungeon and claim rewards.
5) During matches, Seller Sincere’s Shop will occasionally appear in the Outerworld, letting players bet Relics. Successful bets reward Relics with varying multipliers based on match results.
6) The Outerworld and Innerworld may spawn the City Deity Pavilion—defeat its gatekeepers to unlock the Mechanism Hall.
7) More puzzles and secrets await daring players.
IV. New Casual Mode: The Evolution
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/995c7135eccfa7238e261d2a033ac03d846a0b1c.png"]
1. The Herald's Trial mode with fewer players and faster pacing: raise your rank, choose Techniques, and defeat your enemies!

2. Accumulate Cultivation Essence to raise your tier. Each raise lets you choose a Technique that grants bonus stats, unique effects, or stronger Ultimates. The first time you open a Cave or win in the Realm of Yang, your whole team can choose an extra Technique!

3. Complete mode-exclusive external quests to earn Epiphany Notes and raise your Evolution Challenge Level. Higher levels boost hero stats and unlock more Techniques. (Talent effects do not apply in this mode.) Quests are divided into three groups: \[Evolution Challenge·Initiate] is unlocked by default. \[Evolution Challenge·Temper] and \[Evolution Challenge·Forge] unlock on 02/11/2026 20:00:00 (UTC) and 02/18/2026 20:00:00 (UTC) respectively.
4. Mastery Leaderboard now includes an Evolution sub-leaderboard, ranking players by mode-specific ranked points.
5. Personal stats and match history now support The Evolution mode.
V. New Limited-Time Gameplay: \[Lotus Ding]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d5a0569d7e639c90bdd78ed870287e98f84f134f.png"]
After the February 5th update, the all-new Lotus Ding mode will be available in The Herald's Trial, Rift Traversal, and Showdown!
1) In The Herald's Trial and Rift Traversal modes, there's a chance to trigger the special mechanic \[Lotus Descent], where unique \[Lotus Ding] will appear during matches.

Interact with Lotus Ding to obtain \[Tarnished Lotus]. Open the map and find 3 Treasure Appraisals. Have the Lotus appraised and refined to Radiant Lotus. The Radiant Lotus obtained goes directly into Inventory.

2) Heroes carrying a Tarnished Lotus will have their location constantly revealed and periodically detect nearby enemies. If a Tarnished Lotus is dropped on the map or in a Remain, its icon will be displayed on the minimap.
3) \[Radiant Lotus] can also be obtained from some Showdown (excl. Yama's Abyss) matches that consume Fatigue.
· Open the \[Radiant Lotus] may get \[Wonder Chest], \[Riches·Cavalry Treasure], \[Riches·Tidal Treasure] or \[Banner·Prized Lotus Gift].

· Riches·Tidal Treasure, Riches·Cavalry Treasure, Banner·Prized Lotus Gift can be traded on the Steam Market place. The corresponding Treasures will not return in the future, and can only be acquired via \[Radiant Lotus].
· The Lotus Ding arrives in the February 5th update! Wonder Chests will no longer drop directly. No weekly cap on Lotus Ding – play more, earn more!
VI. Season Exclusive: Spring Lantern·Bao
1. The Spring Lantern·Bao is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Zenda Wu Extreme Outfit \[Abyssal Warden] and the Dagger Extreme Skin \[Five Phases].
2. While wearing \[Abyssal Warden], there will be a Luminance Eclipse effect when you defeat enemies. Cannot be Imprinted: When combat begins, enters a special form: Lord of Ghosts.
3. Equipping the Extreme Skin \[Five Phases] changes the hit effects of the Souljade \[Pride's Fall]. Cannot be Imprinted: Quick Dash switches the phase effect.

(1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

(2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.

(3) Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.

The first 10 Spring Lantern·Bao that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Spring Lantern·Bao have been purchased, subsequent Spring Lantern·Bao will return to their standard price.
6. Spring Lantern·Bao will be available on Feb. 5, 2026 at 04:00 (UTC)!
After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Spring Lantern·Bao will remain locked until the specified time.
The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Spring Lantern·Bao.
VII. Showdown Event Stage Returns: Suffer No Demon
Event Time: Feb 5th, 2026 00:00:00 (UTC) to Feb 18th, 2026 20:00:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, access the event stage from the Showdown map. Complete challenges to earn limited Hero Badges, Exhilarating Elixirs, Legendary Souljade Choice Gifts, and more.
2. Sense level difference does not apply in event stages. The event has two chapters:
· In "Mystic Waters," the Omen Water Spears is active: You summon massive water spears when using skills to attack a wide area for rapid clearing.
· In "Toxic Shroud," the Omen Miasma Burst is active: Defeated monsters explode into poison clouds that inflict miasma toxin on nearby enemies and trigger chain reactions.
3. Event stages have their own Souljade drops, suitable for farming specific Souljades. Drops by chapter:
Mystic Waters: \[Element Surge], \[Toxin Seep], \[Toxified Chain], \[Thunder Charge], \[Thunder Chain], \[Chill Spike], \[Frostbite Chain], \[Depths Blast], \, \[Element Rush], \[General·Sap]

Toxic Shroud: \[Defuse·Frostbind], \[Ice-Edge Seal], \[Defuse·Thunder Charge], \[Thunderbind Spell], \[Defuse·Poison Charge], \[Miasma Boon], \[Depths Blast], \[Frost Quake], \[Phantom Charge], \[Mushroom Summoning], \, \[General·Sap]
4. Each chapter has two difficulty levels that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. Choose difficulty based on your capabilities.
5. Chapter 1 stages are available immediately upon event start, while Chapter 2 stages unlock on Feb 11th, 2026 20:00 (UTC), at which point Chapter 1 stages close.
6. Event stages offer trial access to Wuchen, Kylin Zhang, and Temulch, each with preset Souljade loadouts and Curio.

1. Galloping Blessing
With the speed of a swallow, the divine steed gallops. With the guile of a dragon, it leaps to the top.
Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 Update - Feb. 26th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules

1. During the event, players can get Horseshoe Gold*50 by signing in on specific days during the event and can make up for the last day if you missed it. If you sign in for 1, 10 or 15 consecutive days, you will get extra rewards such as Hero Coin*100, Legendary Gesture, or Legendary Background.
2. Fortune Rolls In
Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 00:00 (UTC) - Mar. 4th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Claim rewards until Mar. 11th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules

1) During the event, earn Sweet Rice Flour by opening Stashes in the Survival modes, searching supplies in Rift Traversal, and playing Showdown or Casual Mode (excluding Bloodsport). Up to 400 can be earned from matches per week, resetting every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).

2) You may consume 1 Sweet Rice Flour to drop a selected filling into the soup pot. When two of the same fillings collide, they merge into a higher-tier filling and grant Fortune Points. The red frame marks the soup pot area. If any filling spills outside the pot, after your current round ends, you can start a new round.
3) As your Fortune Points accumulate, you will unlock corresponding threshold rewards.

4) You may enlist heroes to assist with filling merges. Each successful merge builds Rage for the selected hero. Once Rage reaches 60, the hero's assist ultimate can be unleashed. Each of the four heroes has a unique ultimate, and you can switch heroes at any time.
5) Infinite Tangyuan is available for players who wish to freely experience the mode. In Infinite Tangyuan, Sweet Rice Flour is not consumed, but Fortune Points are not awarded.
3. Lin'an Wanderlust
In taverns upon taverns high, when will the revels finally run dry?
Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 Update - Feb. 18th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1) During the event, players can explore five regions and find the treasures hidden in each region.

2) By opening the event page and by completing exploration quests in each region, you can obtain the event item Huizi. Huizi is the Action item for the event, and you need to consume Huizi to explore.
3) In addition to the completion reward, each region also contains other exploration rewards. Be sure not to ignore locations beyond the goal for each region.

4. Galloping into Spring
Event Duration: Feb. 5, 2026 Update - Mar. 11, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Event rules
Gain Spring Festival Score Horseshoe Gold by completing the Spring Festival event. A certain amount of Horseshoe Gold owned grants the corresponding rewards. Obtain through:

Event Duration: Feb. 5, 2026 Update - Mar. 11, 2026 20:00 (UTC)
Event rules
Gain Spring Festival Score Horseshoe Gold by completing the Spring Festival event. A certain amount of Horseshoe Gold owned grants the corresponding rewards. Obtain through:

2) You can spend New Year Subsidy to send Red Packets to your friends. The Red Packets can be sent to your offline friends. When sent, you will get Jade Disk*10.

6. Blessings Abound

1) During the event, a Blessing Group Dance will be held at the Seraphic Quartet on Fairyland Penglai every 15 min. Join the Blessing Group Dance to get \[Blessing Red Packet] of the Year of the Horse. Keep an eye out for countdown notifications in Fairyland Penglai.

At the Seraphic Quartet on Fairyland Penglai, you can interact with the Wealth God's Ingot and consume Grace Card*10 to give a Luck Group Dance in your name to all players, or consume Grace Card*100 to give an Ever-luck Group Dance in your name to all players. Join the Blessing Group Dance or the Ever-luck Group Dance to get \[Lucky Red Packet].

3) During the Group Dance, you will receive Red Packets by going to Seraphic Quartet on Fairyland Penglai and joining the dancing. Blessing Red Packet*10 and Lucky Red Packet*15 can be claimed every day on Fairyland Penglai.

4) After triggering a certain number of Luck Group Dance, you will receive custom cosmetics, including Avatar, Bubble, Aura Effect, Profile, Chat Bubble, and Moonbane Charm Skin! One Ever-luck Group Dance is equal to 10 Luck Group Dances.
5) During the Blessings Abound event, every Blessing Red Packet or Lucky Red Packet opened guarantees Galloping into Spring event point - Horseshoe Gold*1.
7. Spring Lantern·Bao with bonus Star - Collections
Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 04:00 - Feb. 20, 2026 04:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. When opening Spring Lantern·Bao, there's a chance to obtain the Extreme Yueshan Outfit \[Star - Waves and Hills] and Legendary Fan Skin \[Star - Clear Mind].

\[Star - Clear Mind] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Feb 20th, 2026 at 04:00 (UTC).
8. 2026 Spring Festival Giftbox
Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 Update - Mar. 11, 2026 20:00 (UTC)

Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 Update - Mar. 11, 2026 20:00 (UTC)

The taut bow sings a bright cry, one arrow splits the sky.

Event Duration: Feb. 5th, 2026 0:00 (UTC) - Mar. 11th, 2026 23:59 (UTC)
VIII. New Mechanism - Pod

1. Treasure Steeds have been added to Quick Match, Ranked, and Bot mode. Players can interact with them to get random rewards. Each instance can be interacted with twice, and they go on cooldown for 90 sec after being interacted with. Turn that horseshoe toward the sky to catch endless good fortune!
Hero Adjustments
I. Feria Shen
1. Increased the Swarm shot damage multiplier of Ultimate \[Mech Mayhem] and \[Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot] from 0.17 and 0.18 to 0.19 and 0.2 respectively.
2. Optimized the recovery frames of \[Gunplay: Aim] aerial shot animation.
II. Cyra
1. Reduced dodge distance during Ultimate. Slightly increased the descent speed while firing continuous beams in the air.
2. Adjusted the radius of Ultimate \[Light's Mercy: Field] light field from 10m to 8m.
III. Other Hero Optimizations

1. When Vajra, Almighty General, or Thunder Lord uses certain moves (including Vajra's smash, Almighty General's Rampage and follow-up Dragontail moves, Thunder Lord's execution, etc.), if their transformation duration ends mid-move, they will now complete the full move animation before exiting transformation.
IV. In-Game Optimizations

1. Team info panel optimization: When a Hero activates their Ultimate, an Ultimate duration timer now appears beside their avatar icon. For Ultimates with variable duration, a continuous active status is displayed instead.
In-game Adjustments
I. Maelstrom Adjustments
1. New system: Fortune. Increase your Fortune level for the Morus Isle, Holoroth, or Perdoria to unlock map-exclusive combat effects:
· Stay on a map fragment for 15 sec, open 3 Stashes, get 1 elimination, assist, or complete 1 quest to gain that map's Fortune buff, which grants special effects when fighting on that map.
· Disordered Wasteland Fortune gained converts to Fortune for the Morus Isle, Holoroth, or Perdoria based on your existing Fortune levels.
· Fortune effects only apply on their respective map fragments. After a certain match duration, no new Fortune can be gained.

2. Monsters on the Chaos Sea's Floating Stones are easy to defeat at match start. Once any team forges an Extreme Weapon, these monsters upgrade to powerful variants and become much tougher. However, teams wielding Extreme Weapons can still defeat them easily.
3. Adjusted Recurring Realm refresh times to 240 sec and 720 sec.
4. Adjusted Round 1 Nexus Realm warning time to 130 sec and opening time to 190 sec.
5. Players who die in the Nexus Realm now receive one \[Health Souljade II], one \[Attack Souljade II], and two \[Damage Reduction Souljade II] upon rebirth.
6. In Maelstrom BOT Mode, some AI opponents may now carry Extreme Weapon Shards. AI opponents also now appear in the Nexus Realm.
III. Mechanism Adjustments

Maximum participants adjusted to 2. Participants receive one \[Health Souljade II], one \[Attack Souljade II], and two \[Damage Reduction Souljade II]. Weapons inside the Realm of Spirit upgraded from Common to Rare.
Out-of-Game Adjustments
I. Casual Mode Rotation
The Evolution mode is now available. Shadow Surge, Capture the Spirit Well, and Golden Roc Escort are temporarily closed.
II. Out-game Treasure Rewards Upgraded
1. Splendor Treasure Choice Gifts have been changed to Serene Treasure Choice Gifts, and added Steed Treasures in:
1) Showdown Store
2) Hero Badge Store
3) Gift Store
4) Justice Store Updates
5) Heroes Assemble Rewards
2. The Season Treasure Choice Gift in the Justice Store can be used to pick one of the following rewards: Fortune Treasure*1, Dawn Treasure*1, Echelon Treasure*1, Immortal Treasure*1.
III. Feature Optimizations
1. Title order optimization: Titles gained through gifting have been separated from other titles.

2. Friend Search Optimization: When searching for friends, no distinction will be made between capital and lowercase letters. You will always be able to search up players that you have added as friends.
VI. Achievements

1. Added Extreme Weapon rewards. In Maelstrom, accumulate team Extreme Weapon forges to claim rewards including Serene Treasure Choice Gift, Legendary Bubble \[Extreme Weapon Forged], and Epic Avatar \[Nexus Gate].
2. Optimized interaction experience by consolidating the Moonbane Treasures and Sunwing Treasures interfaces.
V. Season Quests
Stage 3 Season Quests now unlocked.
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. New Rift Traversal Equipment
1. New Legendary and Extreme Longsword: Longsword·Engage
· Extreme: Heavy Snow Chill

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Solve" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Vertical Strike to cast "Heavy Snow Chill." Can attack repeatedly, and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Cross Skies."
2. New Legendary and Extreme Katana: Katana·Engage
· Extreme: Fang Severing Slash

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Solve" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Vertical Strike to cast "Fang Severing Slash," and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Severing Gust."
3. New Legendary and Extreme Greatsword: Greatsword·Engage
· Extreme: Crimson Burning Roar

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Solve" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Vertical Strike to cast "Crimson Burning Roar," and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Summer Night Cry."
4. New Legendary and Extreme Spear: Spear·Engage
· Extreme: Heavenly Flaming Strike

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike or tap Vertical Strike while performing a "Nezha's Might" to enable the special technique "Defuse·Solve" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Vertical Strike to cast "Heavenly Flaming Strike," and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Winter Frost."
5. New Legendary and Extreme Fan: Fan·Engage
· Extreme: Spirit Blade Seal

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Combo" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Horizontal Strike to cast "Spirit Blade Seal," and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Horizontal Strike "Yin Yang Seal."
6. New Legendary and Extreme Dual Blades: Dual Blades·Engage
· Extreme: Blazing Phoenix Flash

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Combo" to defend a monster's attack, and automatically cast "Blazing Phoenix Flash." After a vertical charged attack, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Blazing Tempest."
7. New Legendary and Extreme Staff: Staff·Engage
· Extreme: Brahma Seal

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strikes, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike to enable the special technique "Defuse·Combo" to defend a monster's attack, and automatically cast "Brahma Seal." After an Onslaught or a Knee Breaker, you can perform the special Vertical Strike "Arhat's Fury."
8. New Legendary and Extreme Heng Sword: Heng Sword·Engage
· Extreme: Windchaser

Deals 10% more damage to monsters. While charging Horizontal Strike/Vertical Strike, tap Vertical Strike/Horizontal Strike or tap Horizontal Strike during a "Aurora Burst" to enable the special technique "Defuse·Solve" to neutralize a monster's attack. During this move, you can use Horizontal Strike to cast "Windchaser," and after a charged attack, you can perform the special Horizontal Strike "Cyclone Slash."
9. New Armor Rubrics
· Defuse·Flaming Blade
Burns enemies hit with Defuse (Counterattack), dealing damage over time for the next 5 sec.
· Defuse·Draco Stride
After a successful Defuse, you can dodge and then unleash a counterattack, summon a mighty wave that leaves all enemies hit Soaked, reducing their Attack by 15%, for 5 sec.
· Ride the Winds
After hitting an enemy with a ranged weapon, subsequent ranged attacks in the next 1 sec will deal 3% more damage. Can stack up to 12%.
10. New Dual-Purpose Rubrics (Weapons: Bow, Musket, and Repeating Crossbow only)
· Final Stroke
Ranged Weapon Headshot Damage +4%/8%/11%/13% (values correspond to Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary Rubric quality).
11. New Amulets
1. Spirit Seal·Echoes of Qilin
· During \[Qilin Slash: Rend], Common Attacks can also trigger the echo form's extra slash.
· Restore some Health when the echo hits an enemy.
2. Spirit Seal·The Vixen
· \ 2 sec after a Soul Vessel is created, triggers a shockwave at its location to strike enemies.
· During \, enemies whose souls are snatched will take 20% more damage.
II. New Collectibles

Added 7 new collectibles: Spring Piercer, The Qingming Scroll, Emperor's Yellow Robes, Book of Wumu, Cosmos Cup, Cold Food Festival, and River Runs Red·Seal. Each collectible has a unique inspection animation.
III. New Rift Traversal Exclusive Music: Traversal Music
1. View, preview, and equip in Collection > Audio > Traversal Music tab.
2. It plays when obtaining Extreme or higher quality Relics, weapons, armor, or keys. Available for all Heroes.
3. It interrupts \[Combat BGM] and doesn't interrupt \[Hero's Theme] that is effective during the Ultimate.
4. Added \[Traversal Music - Glowing Free Man], obtainable by reaching certain Treasure Point milestones this season.
IV. Item Adjustments
1. In Rift Traversal, Solo mode is now a permanent feature with a separate ranking system from Trios mode. Available daily from 08:00 to 17:00 (UTC), aligned with The Aquila's Past season schedule.
2. Trios Doomed Path will be removed in The Aquila's Past map, while Solo Tranquil Path, Solo Perilous Path, Trios Tranquil Path, and Trios Perilous Path will soon be available in The Aquila's Past.
3. Solo Perilous Path, Trios Perilous Path, and Trios Doomed Path are available in the River Runs Red map.

4. To counter cheating and smurfing, level requirement of the Doomed Path now varies by account type: players with Standard/Deluxe/Ultimate Edition remain at Level 25; players with Free Edition raised to Level 50.
V. New Gallery Halls and Exhibition Stands
1. Spend Void Coins to unlock the new hall \[Celestial Collection Gallery], which includes some exhibition stands.
2. In \[Celestial Collection Gallery], spend Void Coins to unlock new exhibition stands. Different stand types can display special collectibles such as paintings and garments.
VI. New Daily Earnings Display
1. Added a Daily Earnings Summary panel to the Lobby in the Rift Traversal Mode, providing a clear overview of the day's earnings.
2. You can tap the panel for detailed earnings data, including currency changes and Extreme/Legendary item counts.
3. Basic Stats refresh every day at 20:00 (UTC)
VII. Relic Weight Adjustments
To improve inventory management, we have adjusted the weight and icon sizes of some Relics:
Brocade, Box of the Exquisite, and Mooncake weight adjusted from 1.5 lbs to 1 lb.
Scales of Karma weight adjusted from 2.5 lbs to 2 lbs.

Sauced Beef, Beggar's Chicken, Broken Sword, Nightcry Birdcage, Glazed Lantern, Starbrew Pot, Bamboo Inkslab, Eaglebone Flute, and Silver-inlaid Dice weight adjusted from 3.5 lbs to 3 lbs with smaller icons.
VIII. Prestige and Storeroom Level Cap Adjustments
1. Prestige level cap increased to 50. Storeroom level cap increased to 15.
IX. Items Adjustments
1. Equipment Stats Adjustments
· Celestia Weapon Attack increased from 250 to 260.
· Extreme Weapon Attack increased from 210 to 220.
· Legendary Weapon Attack increased from 175 to 185.
· Epic Weapon Attack increased from 150 to 155.
· Celestia Rattan Armor max Health increased from 1720 to 1810, max Armor increased from 1620 to 1710.
· Celestia Scale Armor max Health increased from 1800 to 1900, max Armor increased from 1800 to 1900.
· Celestia Iron Armor max Health increased from 1880 to 1990, max Armor increased from 1980 to 2090.
· Extreme Rattan Armor max Health increased from 1540 to 1585, max Armor increased from 1440 to 1485.
· Extreme Scale Armor max Health increased from 1600 to 1650, max Armor increased from 1600 to 1650.
· Extreme Iron Armor max Health increased from 1660 to 1715, max Armor increased from 1760 to 1815.

2. After Thundershock, Frostbite, or Toxin Meters reach their maximum and trigger an Elemental effect, the time that players are immune to Elemental Meter increases has been changed from 5 sec to 8 sec.
3. \[Immortal Thunder] increases Divine Thunder damage by 14%.
4. The Poison Blasts created by \[Venomous Serpent] have had their damage increased by 7%, and had their healing reduction effect removed.

5. Slightly reduced the knockup inflicted on enemies in mid-air by Mole Hooks when burrowing into the ground or while burrowing underground. Increased the knockup inflicted on mid-air enemies who are hit with Uppercut Slashes from players who were burrowing underground.
6. Combat Item \[Convoy Flag] Adjustment: Cannot be used while in the Outerworld
X. Monster Adjustments
1. Slightly reduced Attack and Health of some boss-tier monsters for balance.
2. Slightly reduced monster Health while slightly increasing monster Attack and Astral Aegis.
XI. New Drops
44 new drop items added to the map after the season update.
XII. Craft Blueprint Changes

items.text: Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Dec 29th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Dec 30th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
I. The Herald's Trial Adds The Maelstrom, A Map Being Reconstructed Infinitely
The God of Khaos tore space apart, gathering fragments of countless worlds here. With The Maelstrom descending, who shall escape?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8de3669b8c1fcc51e49f1bc1456818c51d777ebd.png"]
1. In \[The Maelstrom], every match is a new adventure. This perilous land is randomly assembled from shattered fragments of multiple maps.
New area \[Disordered Wasteland] may appear in The Maelstrom:
Disordered Wasteland: Celestial union births the primal, divine forms entwine as chaos yields to our dominion.
Primeval Shrine: Sunwing's feathers burn into ash. Moonbane's bones collapse as beams. Blended Blood and souls engulf the sun and the moon. The Great Wilderness is eventually a wilderness.
Ruined Court: There's a heaven-and-earth furnace for battlers. Some are in fire and some are in boiling water. Sharp claws tear each other. The new king is the winner of all killers.
Diviner's Rocks: Ghosts dwell in large numbers in the rock holes, gloomy and shadowy. At night the instrument playing may be ghosts wailing.
Primordial Pool: Primordial Pool melts all things, let alone flesh and bones. Purified, they are combined with the God, and aware of the furnace of the mortal world.
City of the Unseen: The city is prosperous as expected, with streets and buildings well-organized. Gloomy is the wind across your face. Awakened, you find it's no human's place.

2. Chaos Sea: Between the gaps of shattered continents surges the Chaos Sea. \[Chaos Poison] permeates it. Once fully corrupted, Heroes will continuously lose Health and recover less Health. This effect disappears after leaving the Chaos Sea for some time.
3. Monsters: Monsters roam the Floating Stones in the Chaos Sea. Avoid combat with them before obtaining an Extreme Weapon.

4. Extreme Weapon: \[Chaos Stashes] may drop \[Extreme Weapon Shards]. Teams holding the \[Extreme Weapon Shard] of the same type of Extreme Weapon will have their positions displayed on the map. After obtaining all three fragments of the same Extreme Weapon, you can craft the Extreme Weapon in your bag. Teams wielding an Extreme Weapon are immune to Chaos Poison, deal increased damage to monsters in the Chaos Sea, and can temporarily reduce enemy maximum Health when attacking with the Extreme Weapon.

5. Nexus Realm: The Nexus Realm is the hub connecting all major areas and also contains \[Chaos Stashes]. Purchase a \[Nexus Key] from the Rift Dealer to enter the \[Nexus Realm] when \[Nexus Gates] appear. When the Nexus Realm closes, all Remains within it will be moved to random Soul Altars outside.
6. In \[The Maelstrom], Blue Stashes now drop 25% more loot, while Gold and Green Stashes yield 33% more loot with an increased chance of higher-quality items.

2) Dark Plume (Matari): When using an Aegis-break Martial Skill, fires \[Eagle Feathers] that strike enemies along their path and remain embedded in the ground and walls. Successful Defuses recall all \[Eagle Feathers], striking enemies along the way. Up to 6 \[Eagle Feathers] can exist at the same time.
3) Amicus Casket (Feria Shen): While in \[Bronze Mech] state, the enhanced Cannon mode uses laser strikes.

The \ can be hit and shot out by the 1st-stage charged Vertical Strike \[Wild Windspout] to enhance it, up to 2 times. The Charioteer, disguised as an Icurian cultivator, journeys west to seize the Herald's lost scrolls and witnesses Holoroth's downfall.
The princess of Holoroth sacrifices herself for her kingdom, and the royal bloodline was scattered into exile.
Once prosperous and mighty, Holoroth now lies like prey awaiting slaughter. Or salvation...
1. Map Area Changes
1) Added Empyreal Village area
2) Modified building structures in the Plumed Castle main district.
3) Modified Thunder Isle area
2. In-Game Quests
1) Added in-game quest - \. In the basement of Holoroth, help the Charioteer clear attacking enemies within the time limit to obtain Drunken Fire Crates.
2) Added in-game quest - \. Return the lost kasaya to its owner. Head near the Charioteer and wait for quest progress to fill, then submit the kasaya to obtain Drunken Fire Crates.
3) Original \[Cargo Escort] quest replaced with \. Capture and escort the prince's carriage to the station to obtain Drunken Fire Crates.
4) Added Empyreal Village to monster stronghold areas. Boss strongholds adjusted to include new bosses: Huanyue and Astral Deer Sorcerer.
3. In-Game Mechanics

1) Added new underground exploration area: Drunken Fire Chamber. Enter the chamber through various entrance conditions to find items that ignite the Sacred Flame Tree. Make offerings to the tree to obtain Drunken Fire Crate rewards and activate Rift Gate extraction points.

2) Added Holy Beacon Altar mechanism on Thunder Isle: Offer the Relic \[Crown of Holoroth] at the Holy Beacon Altar to summon a friendly Beast soul - Manticore at the designated location. (Can only trigger once globally, Relic is not consumed).
3) Mound mechanisms are corrupted by the Mask of Immortality's power. You must now interact with them only by cleansing corruption to claim rewards.
4) Added rarer Advanced Ore scattered across map corners. Some Advanced Ore is hidden underground and can be detected with Treasureseer.
5) Added the Aquila's Might - Can be acquired from the Drunken Fire Crate that is granted by the Holy Blaze Tree.

Effect: Enhances the wielder's Grappling Hook and Mole Hook, converting Vertical Grappling Strikes into Eagle Glide. During the effect, allies within range receive an Attack bonus. At set intervals, enemies within 100m of the Hero with Aquila's Might are made visible. Aquila's Might lasts 300 sec.
1) Greatly increased Drunken Fire Crates and map resources.
5. Combat Item Adjustments
1) Treasureseer can now detect Advanced Ore. Detected Drunken Fire Crates and Advanced Ore will be marked.

6. For the new rift, Tranquil Path requires Preparation Score below 450,000; Perilous Path requires Preparation Score between 240,000 and 1,750,000; Doomed Path requires Preparation Score above 700,000.
7. Season Settlement
The Trailblazer Season will end on Oct. 23, 2025 at 00:00 (UTC)

notes.title: For more details, please see the Season Settlement Notice

items.text: II. Brand-new Gameplay
1. New Limited-Time Gameplay: \[Voidwhisper Hospital]
This place blurs the line between reality and illusion, filled with mad ravings and insane whispers. If you wish to escape with your life, you must tread carefully.

1) The \[Rift Portal] in Survival Mode (excluding Immortal War) and Rift Traversal Mode will open after a certain period following the start of the match. Once opened, players can interact with it to teleport to \[Voidwhisper Hospital]. The \[Rift Portal] only allows 2 teams to enter and will close after a period of time.

2) Players can explore \[Voidwhisper Hospital] and find the real Li Huowang to receive the Extreme Weapon \[The Unruly Immortals·Spine Bone Sword] in Survival Mode, or unlock a Rift Gate to escape in Rift Traversal Mode. This gate is only available to the team that finds the real Li Huowang. Players can choose to escape immediately or return to Holoroth. Whatever you do, beware of the fake "Li Huowang"!
3) When the countdown ends, \[Voidwhisper Hospital] will be filled with toxic fog. Players can exit \[Voidwhisper Hospital] through the \[Rift Gates] located within the hospital.
2. Unknown Martial Artist
A mysterious warrior appears outside the Rift Portal. Approach and speak with him - you might receive unexpected rewards.
3. New Fairyland Penglai Gameplay
\[Mahjong Stack Up High]
Location: Some areas of Fairyland Penglai
1. Approach players that have Oblivion Path headgear and initiate a Stack Up High and create a Mahjong Stack Up High Team.
2. Only certain areas allow for this gameplay. It is not supported in the areas near the Pantheon and the Songbird Arena.
3. Combine with other players to create a \, \, \, \ or \[Special Win] and get rewards!
\[Seven Pairs]: Seven pairs of tiles.

\[Thirteen Orphans]: East Wind, South Wind, West Wind, North Wind, Red Dragon, Green Dragon, White Dragon, One Myriad, Nine Myriad, One Dot, Nine Dot, One Bamboo, Nine Bamboo and one dupe of any of them.
1. Bizarre Quest for Truth
Wield the sacred talisman to banish corruption, and drink the elixir to steady your spirit. Shatter illusion, reclaim your truth, cleanse your mind, and glimpse reality.
Event Duration: Oct. 23, 2025 Update - Nov. 12, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

1. During the event, visit daily to obtain Talismans. Each week, you can also earn Talismans by opening Stashes in the Survival modes, searching for supplies in Rift Traversal, or playing Showdown or Casual Modes (except Bloodsport). Weekly Talisman limit: 200. Resets every Wednesday at 20:00 UTC (first reset: October 29, 2025 at 20:00 UTC).
2. Tap Start to Explore to explore the map. Open as many Fate Chests as possible before your Mind Maze Points reach 100% to collect more Longevity Elixirs.
(1) Tap a tile to move. Each tile moved increases Mind Maze Points by 5%.

(2) Fu Sheng Tian moves 1 tile for every 2 tiles you move, always advancing toward you. When Fu Sheng Tian lands on your tile, you will be attacked, and your Mind Maze Points are increased by 50%. Choose your path carefully.
(3) Opening each Fate Chest grants Longevity Elixir*5 and may yield 1 Curio. There are 4 Curios in total. Using the right Curio offers a chance to survive Fu Sheng Tian's attack.
3. Accumulate enough Longevity Elixirs to claim corresponding event rewards.

4. The exploration map will change based on the total number of Fate Chests you've opened. The maximum number of Fate Chests available per match will gradually increase, so open as many Fate Chests as possible to unlock new maps!
2. Dreadful Nightmares
Moonlight gleams and the heart trembles...
Event Duration: Oct. 29th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Nov. 11th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Players who sign in a total of 7 days during the event can receive a limited Gesture, Valiant Treasure, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, and more rewards.
3. Aquila Song
The flame eventually went out before her eyes. Holoroth...
Event Duration: Oct. 22nd, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Nov. 4th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Earn Sacred Flames by completing quests during the event.
2. The rewards are redeemable till Nov. 5th, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.
4. Easy Battle
Fortune's favor with easy rewards.
Event Time: Every Thursday at 20:00 (UTC) to Sunday at 20:00 (UTC)

1. During weekends, players who log in can claim check-in rewards from the event page. You can check in up to 3 times, resetting weekly. Completing weekly quests also grants a large amount of Jade Disks.

2. During weekends, a Special Omen takes effect in each game mode, altering the match experience. Some Omens that affect match results have limited activations and reset weekly. Each mode's weekly Omen will be updated from time to time.
5. The Unruly Immortals Wardrobe
New look and new path to immortality!
Event Duration: Oct. 23, 2025 Update - Jan. 21, 2026 23:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: Collect The Unruly Immortals cosmetics during the event, exchange for exclusive event rewards, and claim valuable Gold Chests!
6. Sentimental Blades
They speak of heartlessness, yet the heart yearns still. What is life without feeling?
Event Duration: Oct. 23, 2025 Update - Nov. 5, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

1. By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Xunhuan Li's Tokens: Blossom, Fang, Hairpin, Coin and have additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Glazed Crystal, Jade Disk, Valiant Coin.
2. There are 4 Sections, which can be unlocked with the corresponding Tokens.
3. You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Sections. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned.

4. Each day, you can help a player obtain a Token (by tapping the "Share Xunhuan Li's Token" in your contact list, selecting a Token, and confirming to share it). You won't consume your Tokens by doing so. However, each player can only be given one Token per day.

5. After the event ends, you can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page within the remaining time to claim rewards. But you can no longer complete Quests or Share Tokens during that period. Once the Tokens expire, they can be disposed into 160 Tae each in the Inventory.
IV. Valiant Season's Immortal War is now available

After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards. (Includes Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Floral Dew, Legendary Weapon Skins, etc.)

Players who make it into the Top 500 in Immortal War will enter the Immortal Leaderboard. This leaderboard is updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, players that earned a special title this way will receive an Avatar reward as well. A player who is on the Immortal Leaderboard at the end of the season will receive an additional Avatar reward.
In addition, the Top 3 players on the leaderboard at the time of the final settlement will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.
Hero Adjustments
I. Akos Hu
1. Adjusted moves during Ultimate \[Feral Frenzy] as follows:
Recovery multiplier of the 1st-stage charged Pounce adjusted from 0.72 to 1
Recovery multiplier of the 2nd-stage charged Pounce adjusted from 0.79 to 1.1
Recovery multiplier of the 3rd-stage charged Pounce adjusted from 0.86 to 1.2

In Duos/Trios, the 2nd-stage Ultimate lunge move damage multiplier is adjusted from 2.6 to 3.6, and that against enemies with transformation traits from 2.0 to 3.2. In Solo, this damage multiplier is adjusted from 2.6 to 3.0, and that against enemies with transformation traits from 2.0 to 2.7. Cooldown time is adjusted from 5 sec to 3 sec.
2. Optimized startup frames for tap horizontal strike Pounce during Ultimate \[Feral Frenzy].
3. Optimized the 2nd-stage Ultimate \[Feral Frenzy] activation detection. Now it releases immediately upon pressing Ultimate.
II. Wuchen
Adjusted Blade Storm effect generated after Ultimate \[Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm] hits enemies:
1. Large spirit blade damage multiplier increased from 1.6 to 2.0.
Adjusted derivative skill \[Spirit Blades·True Edge] from Ultimate \[Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm]:
1. Recovery frames Defense Focus when directly shooting spirit blades increased from Blue to Purple.
2. Spirit blades shot directly or after the 2nd-stage charge can now clash with all melee weapon moves.
3. The 3rd-stage charged spirit blades can now break weapon Golden Focus instead of Blue Focus.
4. Added 30% damage reduction during spirit blade charge and release.
5. Optimized auto-exit mode for Wuchen's Ultimate \[Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm]. When skill \[Spirit Blades·True Edge] is not on cooldown, this Ultimate will not end automatically.
Weapon Adjustments
I. Whipsword
1. Optimized \[Ground Crusher] animation.
2. Increased airborne distance from charged vertical strike and \[Blazing Cyclone] hits.
3. Increased airborne distance from charged horizontal strike hits.
4. Optimized hit range of Counterstrike Combos.
5. Reduced stagger duration from repeated \[Sin Cleaver] hits.
II. Dual-wielded Weapons
1. Added Congeneric Moves.
III. Short-handle Weapon
1. Added Congeneric Moves.
x
IV. Long-handle Weapon
1. Optimized charged attack animation when attacking from trees.
V. Single-edged Weapons
1. You can now switch weapons during charge to unleash Congeneric Skills.
VI. Flying Knives
1. Slightly increased startup frames for the 3rd vertical strike
2. The 1st-stage charged horizontal strike \[Sunder The Stars] damage multiplier increased from 3.94 to 4.17, but it decays to 3.76 with distance
3. The 2nd-stage charged horizontal strike \[Rend The Moon] damage multiplier increased from 3.24+1.94 to 3.43+2.06, but it decays to 3.09+1.85 with distance
4. The 1st-stage charged vertical strike \[Rapid Throw] damage multiplier increased from 1.5*3 to 1.59*3, but it decays to 1.35*3 with distance
5. Souljade \[Palm Lightning] damage multiplier increased from 1.36*4 to 1.44*4, but it decays to 1.22*4 with distance
6. Souljade \[Moonshards Storm] 1st hit damage multiplier increased from 2.32 to 2.4, but it decays to 2.21 with distance
In-Game Adjustments
I. Gameplay Adjustments
1. When Vermillion Bird's Might wielders are eliminated, they no longer drop Vermilion Bird Essence and instead drop Soulbloom Essence.
II. Glyph Adjustments
1. For \[Spirit·Dash], reduced Stamina consumption during sprint start and full sprint.
2. For \[Body·Lightstep], reduced Disengage threshold in Duos/Trios and increased the Disengage gain for Souljade moves with longer control duration.
III. Rift Dealer \ Adjustments
1. Dark Tide Coins gained from pawning Epic weapons/Souljades, Legendary weapons, and Legendary Souljades reduced from 500 to 400, 800 to 600, and 1600 to 1200 respectively;
2. Dark Tide Coins required to buy back Epic weapons/Souljades, Legendary weapons, and Legendary Souljades reduced from 5000 to 4000, 8000 to 6000, and 16000 to 12000 respectively;
3. Time limit for buying back Epic weapons/Souljades and Legendary weapons/Souljades moved earlier to 2nd Shadow Corruption start and 2nd Shadow Corruption end respectively.
IV. Limited-time Armor Hero Crossover Items
The Armor Hero crossover limited-time in-game item event has ended. \ will no longer drop in matches.
Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Champion Fight Match Adjustments
1. Improved the ranked points algorithm for non-Asura players who enter Champion Fight Matches early and increased the score compensation ratio from 30% to 35% in this scenario.
II. Lunar Pavilion Adjustments

1. All cosmetics from the Rebirth Seal Shop will be moved to the Lunar Pavilion, where you can redeem them using Jade Disks. Rebirth Seals will expire on October 23rd and each will automatically convert to 800 Spectral Silk. Hero Return event rewards will now feature Jade Disks instead of Rebirth Seals.

2. Jade Disk rewards have been removed from \[Daily Quests - Weekly Rewards]. While players can earn Jade Disks based on their performance and survival duration in any mode excluding Bloodsport and Yama's Abyss modes, with a weekly limit of 30.
III. Fairyland Penglai Hero Adjustments
1. Optimized Tarka Ji's and Zai's idle animations.
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. New Equipment
1. Midst flexibility, there is resolution, and attack and defense feed one another. The Nunchucks have arrived in Rift Traversal.
Brand-new Celestia Nunchuck: Wild Scale
· Arcane: Dragon's Wrath

For each stack of Biding Fury, damage taken is reduced by 5%. Upon triggering a Horizontal Block or consuming Biding Fury, Attack is increased by 10% for 10 sec. When taking fatal damage, if at least one stack of Biding Fury remains, consumes all stack to gain Biding Shield for 2 sec. During Biding Shield, you become immune to critical hits and gain 8% of your maximum HP upon landing a hit. This effect can trigger at most once every 60 sec. Successfully blocking resets the Biding Shield cooldown.
New Legendary and Extreme Nunchucks: Nunchucks·Dance
· Extreme: Dragon Roar·Demon Quelling
Alters the Nunchucks' Dragon Flurry attack, if Biding Fury has more than 1 stack, a 1st-stage charged Vertical Strike can release the Dragon Flurry and build Biding Fury.
New Legendary and Extreme Nunchucks: Nunchucks·Wind
· Extreme: Stick of Yang's End·Thunderstrike

Adds a 2nd-stage move to Nunchucks' charged Horizontal Strike and changes the counterattack after a successful Horizontal Block. Attacking enemies rapidly builds Biding Fury and prevents enemies from dodging for 1 sec. While charging, Horizontal Block's range is increased to 360 degrees.
Nunchucks Rubrics
· Velocity Untold&Trigger: Alters Nunchucks' charged Horizontal Strikes. Using Horizontal Block no longer consumes Biding Fury and triggers when hit by ranged attacks.
2. Deadly accurate and never missing a shot! The Flying Knives are coming to Rift Traversal!
New Celestia Flying Knives: Twilight
· Arcane Effect: Phantom Edge
Charged Strike DMG +18%, and can trigger Hidden Barbs on enemy charged attacks.
New Legendary and Extreme Flying Knives: Flying Knives·Burn
· Extreme Effect: Moonshards Storm·Burn
Alters 2nd-stage Charged Horizontal Strike. It will burn enemies hit, dealing damage over time.
New Legendary and Extreme Flying Knives: Flying Knives·Pain
· Extreme Effect: Fleeting Strike
Adds a 2nd-stage move to the charged Vertical Strike, throwing flying knives that are faster and travel further.
· Palm Lightning: Alters Flying Knives' charged Vertical Strikes.
3. New Legendary and Extreme Armor: Rattan Armor·Swallow
· Extreme Effect: Featherlight
When staggered, Disengage is accumulated. When Disengage is full, you can tap \ to use Disengage to escape.
II. Rift Traversal New Item Type: Amulet
You can carry one amulet into each match. Unlike existing equipment, amulets enhance hero skills and ultimates, and can even change the effects of certain heroes' skills or ultimates.

III. Added New Tactical System: Courier Pact

Before each match, you can purchase one of three Courier Pacts. The selected contract will affect the entire match. Each Courier Pact offers unique effects, introducing new pre-match tactical decisions and shifting in-match gameplay strategies.
Void Coins will not be deducted immediately upon selecting a Courier Pact. The required amount will be deducted after the match begins.
Each Courier Pact has a different cost, and whether a contract takes effect will influence the cost of subsequent contracts.
The Traveling Merchant will periodically offer discounts on Courier Pacts.
2. Description of Courier Pacts

Guardian Courier Pact: The higher the equipment value, the more Void Coin the contract requires. Takes effect only when escape fails. When triggered, it has a chance to return some of your equipment. This Courier Pact covers the following equipment: weapon, secondary weapon, spare weapon, armor, and amulet.

Fortune Courier Pact: When searching any lootable container, you will receive two copies if an Extreme Relic appears (excluding crossover collectibles). Can only trigger once per match. This Courier Pact will not trigger through in-game activities such as digging, clearing monsters, redeeming/buying, or killing other players.
Loaded Courier Pact: Increases the in-game weight limit for the Fragile Rift Gate from 10 lb to 20 lb.
IV. New Collectibles
Added 6 new collectibles: Eclipsing Eagle Lord, Holoroth Crown, Glass Peacock, Wolf King's Seal, Sirius Horn, and Garuda, each with its own unique inspection animation!
V. Equipment Adjustments
1. Melee Weapons of Epic quality or above gain a new trait called Vajra's Grip, which prevents you from dropping your weapon when Countered a specified number of times:
· Celestia weapons can only trigger once every 90 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 times per match
· Extreme weapons can only trigger once every 120 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 times per match
· Legendary weapons can only trigger once every 300 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 times per match
· Epic weapons can only trigger once

2. Celestia armor now supports forging with Extreme armor. You can consume Extreme armor to gain Extreme buffs. Note that Rattan Armor·Transform and Iron Armor·Slough cannot be forged due to their unique effects.
VI. In-game Adjustments
1. Adjusted the sound attenuation range for \[Grappling Hook] and \[Mole Hook] during firing and flight, allowing you to hear other players using these items from greater distances.
2. \[Vajra's Sobriety]'s effect has been changed to: When being Countered within 300 sec after drinking, restore 450 Health and gain a 60% Damage Reduction for 3 sec. Can be triggered up to 2 times.
VII. Feature Adjustments

1. The Advanced Battle Edict now includes amulets, with corresponding values adjusted: total value increased from 1.15 million to 1.2 million Void Coins, Preparation Score increased from 650,000 to 750,000, and Void Coins from recycling increased from 130,000 to 150,000.

2. Changed the looting restriction for Remains Bags from 5 sec to 10 sec: For 10 seconds after a bag appears, only the players who participated in the kill (including assists) can claim items from it.
VIII. Heroes Adjustment
1. Ziping Yin's ultimate \[Saving Grace] healing effect bonus decreased from 20% to 10%, while the health recovery multiplier per second increased from 0.42 to 0.46.
2. Temulch‘s ultimate \[Storm Prison] duration increased from 12 to 13 seconds, and \[Storm Prison: Reload] duration increased from 9 to 11 seconds.
3. Tessa's ultimates \ and \[Enchant: Group Prey] now require 65% rage instead of 75%.

4. The duration of the \[Inspiration Shield] granted by Ziping Yin's Skill \[Nature's Touch: Protect] has been adjusted from 8 sec to 5 sec, and the healing multiplier has been changed from 1.0 to 1.1.
IX. Season Contract Redo
1. Simplified Season Contract difficulty. In S1, Travelers will progress through three parallel quest lines at once, preventing any single difficult task from blocking their overall progress.

2. Improved how you obtain Mastercraft Century Chests: They will begin “crafting” at the start of the season and can be claimed once complete. All players start with the same initial crafting time. You can obtain \[Boost Hammers] through Season Contracts. Each one accelerates the crafting time by 1 day. Once claimed, the Mastercraft Century Chest remains available until the season ends and resets when the new season begins.

3. Added abundant rewards: Complete Season Contracts to earn \[Honorable Tokens], which unlock Celestia equipment crafting materials, Void Coin, Aquila Traveler's Chests (containing random Extreme equipment, Extreme keys, and other items), Advanced Century Chest Trial Cards, Martial Arts Manuals, and more. \[Honorable Tokens] and related rewards reset with each season.

4. Martial Arts Manuals: \[Honorable Token] rewards also unlock a new content called \[Martial Arts Manuals], which provide in-game bonuses such as increased Stamina recovery speed, faster searching, and Rift Dealer discounts. \[Martial Arts Manuals] reset with each season.
X. Collection Gallery Multiplayer Mode
1. The Collection Gallery now supports multiplayer mode, allowing up to 30 players in the same gallery simultaneously.
2. The Collection Gallery now includes new features such as photo taking, voice chat, and text chat.
3. Added \[Visit Collection Gallery] and \[Invite to Visit] options to the friends menu, letting you quickly visit others' Collection Galleries or invite them to yours.
4. Added collectible collection display in \ - \[Rift Traversal]. You can now quickly visit others' Collection Galleries through their profiles.
5. You can set who is allowed to visit your Collection Gallery in \ - \[Invite Settings] - \[Collection Gallery Privacy Settings].
6. You can change who can send you Collection Gallery visit invitations in \ - \[Invite Settings] - \[Collection Gallery Invitation].
XI. The Unruly Immortals collection progress
1. Progress bar in the lower right corner of the lobby: Collection·Mind Maze. When the progress bar is full, you're guaranteed a crossover collectible.
2. After finding a crossover collectible, progress will be reset and the remaining attempts will decrease by one.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Rimeflame Season Enigma Peak Now Open

1. Enigma Peak features three types: \[Thunder-wielding], \[Ice-wielding], and \[Poison-wielding]. All three will open simultaneously after the update. Each Enigma Peak type features auspicious omens matching its element. Using the corresponding Souljades can make these encounters easier.

2. Any Showdown Souljade may drop in Enigma Peak, with higher-quality Souljades having better drop rates. Defeat enough bosses in a single run to earn valuable rewards, including Legendary Souljade Choice Gifts, exclusive achievements, and more.
3. Some bosses in Enigma Peak now have special moves.
4. In this season's Enigma Peak, progress gained from defeating bosses, regular monsters, and opening camp chests has been adjusted to match that of Topaz Enigma Domain.
II. Battle Adjustments
1. The sand cone rain attack when \ steps back during the first phase has been changed to only one strike.
2. Adjusted the startup frames for the \[Twisted Twins]' opening double-strike combo.
3. Improved the sound effects and hit feedback for Ranged Weapon Counterstrike Combos, and optimized the sound effects for the Deadeye Martial Skills.
III. Function Optimizations
1. Adjusted the Souljade Random Gift icon to make it easier to distinguish from Souljade Choice Gifts.
2. Added a confirmation prompt when using Legend Jades for imprinting.
3. Optimized Souljades Import Code: valid codes will be recognized and applied even when embedded in other texts.

items.text: Akos roars like a tiger and knocks back nearby enemies. The tiger offers new attack ways that last for 22 sec in Solo, 25 sec in Duos and Trios modes.

· During the ultimate, tap Jump to launch tiger leap, then tap horizontal strike after landing to \. Hold horizontal strike to charge a \, increasing damage and recovering Health or Armor. Gain a damage reduction during tiger leap and pounce.
· Repeated tiger leaps increase jump speed and enhance the Focus and attack of \.
· Non-Focus strike or Grappling Hook cannot interrupt tiger leap.
· Horizontal and vertical Strikes are enhanced as Tiger-Claw strikes during a Scale Rush or tiger leap.
· Can be used under attack.

//Dev Notes: Akos Hu's unique tiger leap and pounce mechanics had decent pressure and offense but lacked burst potential. We've added charged pounce to his lunging moves from \[Feral Frenzy] and merged them with \[Feral Frenzy: Grab], keeping the 2nd-stage and tap pounce performance from \[Feral Frenzy: Grab] to boost his burst and flexibility.

The effect to knock enemies airborne of skill \[Roar: Blast] after charging was difficult to initiate/continue combos in certain combat situations. We've changed the hit effect to the control effect \, keeping the long stagger from tap releases for more stable hit effects and stronger initiative in Duos/Trios modes.
II. Wuchen

notes.title: Adjusted Ultimate \[Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm]

items.text: 1. Adjusted the blade storm effect after Ultimate hits enemies: Overall blade storm timing remains unchanged, but mid-sized spirit blades that could interrupt White Focus moves are changed to small spirit blades that cannot interrupt any actions. Large spirit blade count remains unchanged with damage changed from 2.1 to 1.6.
2. Slightly increased strike detection intervals for Sword Arrays when Ultimate misses enemies.
3. Increased Ultimate release interval from 6 sec to 8 sec.
4. Ultimate activation refreshes skill cooldown and grants new move \[Spirit Blades·True Edge]
· Wuchen manipulates Qi to create 5 Spirit Blades, lasting for 60 sec.
· Tap Skill again to shoot the blades. Spirit Blades can clash with melee weapon attacks without reducing weapon durability.
· Hold Skill to charge Spirit Blades. Charged shots enhance stagger based on charge time and can interrupt Blue Focus moves.
· Can be used under attack.

//Dev Notes: Wuchen's \[Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm] spirit blade pressure was too strong, while complete misses had poor returns. Missing left Wuchen without effective means to counter enemy Ultimates.

To fix this, we reduced the rewards from hitting and removed mid-sized spirit blades. As compensation for these changes, we're giving Wuchen a more powerful derived skill during his \[Blade Storm] Ultimate.

We hope this change enhances interactivity between Wuchen's Ultimate and skills and creates more exchanges between Wuchen and enemies. For example, Wuchen can use his Spirit Blade to disrupt enemies attempting to evade Blade Storm, or charge Spirit Blades to stagger enemies, making it easier to land Blade Storm.

This change should reduce vulnerability windows after missing Ultimates for better experience while adding \ to give Tessa combat advantages and enhanced survivability after successful hits. items.text: 1. When Qilin Guard triggers while being hit or controlled, blast will be produced to knock enemies back;

//Dev Notes: The charged slash dash speed of Kylin Zhang's \[Qilin Slash: Rend] was too fast without startup frames indicators. We've reduced the slash speed and made it blockable with counter while improving Kylin Zhang's attack indicators. This would help opponents observe his attack more clearly for better counterplay.
