(2) Replaced \[Lotus Lock] with \, which can still be unlocked by upgrading the Chaos Furnace. \ effect: When used, it will taunt enemies within a 15m area for up to 20 sec.
(3) Replaced \[Thunder Elixir] with \[Storm Elixir].
\[Storm Elixir] effect: When used, it will continuously reduce enemies' Astral Aegis within a certain range for 5 sec.
(4) Two new Omens have been added: \[Copper Crisis] and \[Muzzle Flash]
Following Tempered Inferno level updates, the types of monsters will also change.
II. New Contents in Rift Traversal Mode
1. Limited-time Crossover Collectibles

(1) Added 2 limited-time crossover collectibles, each valued at 2,888,888 Void Coins. They can appear as drops in Tranquil, Perilous, and Doomed Paths of Rift Traversal mode after the August 21, 2025 update until September 16, 2025 at 22:00 UTC.
(2) These crossover collectibles have fixed Treasure Points and cannot be appraised or traded. Upon unlocking their entries, you will permanently gain 28,888 Treasure Points.
(3) Each crossover collectible features an exclusive examine Emote Gesture. Upon submitting them in the collection, you will obtain the corresponding Emote Gesture.
2. Newly Added Collection Gallery
(1) A personal collection gallery feature has been added to the camp, where unlocked collectibles from your collection can be displayed.
(2) When crossover collectibles are displayed, they also feature background information, which can help you figure out the answers to Relic Quiz questions in the Land of Treasures event.
3. The Pistol is now a part of Rift Traversal!
New Celestia Pistol: Thunderclap
Arcane Effect: Thunder Blast Barrel
Gains Blue Focus while charging, exploding once fully charged to damage enemies in front within range. Staggers and fills the enemy's Thundershock Meter.
New Legendary and Extreme Pistol: Pistol·Burst
Extreme Effect: Detonating Rounds
Reduces Charged Shot damage, but bullets lodge inside enemies hit and explode after 2 sec.
Quick Charge & Thundercall: Charged Pistol shots fire with larger explosion range and higher damage, allowing you to load up to two shots at a time and the charging will be muted.
4. Replaced system-spawned \[Convoy Chest] with \[Dragonsteed Chariot]
(1) Mid-match, \[Dragonsteed Chariot] spawns randomly on the battlefield
(2) You can store your Relics in the Chariot Bag. A Chariot has 3 Chariot Bags in total, and each can only be used by 1 person.
(3) Unless it's destroyed, the Chariot will send out its stored items when the corresponding countdown ends. The Chariot Bag function will then be disabled for the remainder of the match.

(4) If attacked and reduced to 0 HP before the countdown ends, the Chariot's Bag will drop its contents and be destroyed. The Chariot Bag function will then be disabled for the remainder of the match.
5. Added Thunder·Drunken Fire Crate
When sandstorms or snowstorms arrive, air currents will appear. Ride them to reach Thunder Isle above Plumed Castle and break the seal to open Thunder·Drunken Fire Crate.
6. Cross-Platform Matchmaking On
Rift Traversal now supports partying up with Cross-Platform players.
III. New Fairyland Penglai Feature: Bamboo Raft
You can now board the Bamboo Raft on the north side of Seraphic Quartet and the west side of Mystoland (former Kiteboarding sites) in Fairyland Penglai to enjoy the island sights with your teammates!
IV. Limited-time Event: Artisanal Wonder
Glazes of blue and white, delicate cloud patterns so fine as if crafted amid the heavens...
Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 3, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, earn Gemstones by opening Stashes in Survival modes.
2. Gemstones are also obtainable through Casual Modes (excluding Bloodsport), Showdown, and in Rift Traversal. You can acquire up to 360 Gemstone per week through these methods.
3. Tap the Treasure Hunt button on the event page to randomly receive Pottery Shards of the same type. Collect five of the same Pottery Shards to claim corresponding rewards.

4. Claim 30 extra Gemstones upon first entering the event page each week. The weekly Gemstone limit and extra Gemstones reset every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). (First reset: Aug 27, 2025, at 20:00 UTC.)
V. Limited-time Event: Land of Treasures
Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 16, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, Extreme Relics obtained have an increased chance to be collaboration Relics.
2. Sign in to the event page daily to earn Museum Scrolls and unlock 1 question about the crossover collectibles.

3. Answering a question costs 1 Museum Scroll. The first question does not cost any Museum Scrolls. Correct answers will yield generous rewards. Answer a set number of questions correctly to earn Ziping Yin's Legendary Outfit.

4. During the event, Extreme Relics obtained from Rift Traversal have an increased chance to be crossover Relics. Playing a Rift Traversal match daily will yield 1 Museum Scroll and 1 Relic Chest, which may contain an Extreme Relic.
VI. Limited-time Event: Celestus Furnace
Earthly fires and heavenly craftsmanship forge weapons of wonder, as ashes of fallen demons drift down to lands below.
Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 3, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 10, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Gain Celestus Tokens by completing quests during the event. Celestus Tokens can be redeemed for great event rewards.
2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
4. The rewards are redeemable till Sep. 10, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.
VII. Limited-time Event: Gifts from the Sea
Event Duration: Aug. 27, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Sep. 10, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Avatar, Legendary Base, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Fission Treasure etc.
VIII. Limited-time Event: Season Treasures Return
Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 4, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, Aeon Treasure will return for a limited time.
2. The content and drop rate of rewards in Treasures will remain unchanged.
3. The number of times to trigger a Guarantee for the Treasures will not be reset, and the progress you made on the current season's Guarantee will carry over.
Go to the Treasure Pavilion for more details!
I. Inor Wan
1. Adjusted Inor Wan's Skill \[Bolt Dash]'s derivative slash move Focus to Golden Focus, added Dodge frame detection during slash startup frames, and improved movement control.
2. Slightly extended the damage reduction druation after \[Bolt Dash: Pact]'s dash; adjusted maximum dash distance from 25m to 30m and optimized sound effects.
3. Significantly advanced the timing when Thunder Lord can chain skills after airborne and ground vertical strikes, and slightly reduced the recovery frames for ground vertical strikes.
4. Optimized \[Lightning Execution] set-up move homing performance and slightly reduced the recovery frames for Thunder Lord's \[Lightning Execution].
II. Kurumi
Optimized visual effects for the Healing Circle summoned by the Ultimate \[Purified Circle] at close range.
III. Lyam Liu
Slightly extended the recovery frames for Lyam Liu's ground-cast \[Magnet Repel] and \[Auric Core] that can be interrupted by weapon attacks by 0.05 seconds and 0.03 seconds respectively.
I. Dual Blades
1. Increased the knockback for \[Sunder The Stars] and \[Rend The Moon] charged Horizontal moves, as well as \[Rapid Throw] charged Vertical moves when they hit mid-air enemies.
2. Reduced the projectile speed of the 1st stage charged Horizontal move \[Sunder The Stars].
3. Slightly increased the start-up frames for 1st stage Vertical strikes.
4. Increased the grappling buffer for the charged Vertical move \[Rapid Throw].
In-Game Adjustments
I. In-Game Adjustments
Expanded initial safe zone range in Champion Fight Match Solo mode and increased high-tier loot zone count.
Out-of-Game Adjustments
I. Rank Preview
Added rank preview for Ranked Mode and Immortal War. Click rank icons in mode selection interface to view them.
II. Out-of-Game Inventory
1. Expanded out-of-game inventory capacity from 300 to 510.
2. Modified stack amounts for some items.
III. New Feature: Reserve Hero
1. Added the ability to reserve heroes for The Herald's Trial Duos/Trios and Immortal War Duos/Trios. Select your preferred hero in the mode selection page.
2. Reserving heroes includes selecting one primary hero and two secondary heroes. Matchmaking prioritizes your primary hero to reduce teammate hero conflicts.
IV. One-Click Clear Prompt Red Dots Feature
Optimized one-click red dot clearing to include red dots from Justice Chamber, Event Center, and more.
V. Champion Fight Match Changes
Significantly increased ranked point deduction reduction when entering Champion Fight Match early.
Rift Traversal Adjustments
I. Beginner's Trial Ground
Added special Tranquil Path mode for beginners (players below Explorer V may automatically match into \[Trial Ground])
(1) Reduced map access range with more concentrated resources.
(2) Simplified stage mechanics and reduced escape difficulty.
(3) Reduced Evil-Ent strength.
II. In-Game Adjustments
1. Players may continue spectating in-game after successful escape.
2. Significantly increased \[Wind Horn] flight time and distance; flight now supports ascending and descending.
3. Optimized resource distribution in some areas and adjusted map terrain.
4. Cargo Escort quests changed from 3 stations per round to 2. (The final reward remains Drunken Fire Crate·Legendary)

5. When chest rewards are distributed via dice roll, auto-pickup occurs after gaining pickup rights when countdown ends (auto-pickup won't occur if your backpack space is insufficient or you're in a special status).
6. Boss Challenge Quests now require only 1 Rune Stone instead of 2.
(1) Defeated players receive Yang Depletion status instead of being eliminated outright.
(2) Defeated players only drop items from Relic Bags.
(3) Advanced Realm of Yang spawn timing.
(4) Winners receive new Morus' Blessing rewards. They may choose between Draco Storm and Mystic Might.
(5) Interacting with Rift Gates also removes Yang Depletion.
8. In the Tranquil Path, the guaranteed quality of Relics in the Drunken Fire Crate·Epic has been upgraded to Rare quality.
9. Reduced escape animation length from 5.5 sec to 2.5 sec.
10. Added inspection animations for 8 Relics: Devastation Furnace, Moonscourge Boat, Crystal Crab, Sea of Calamity, Astrolabe of Stars, Sunwing's Breath, Eternal Lamp, and Bell of Annihilation.
11. Added Common Melee Weapon Lucky Bags to Rift Dealers. Purchase them to obtain a Common Weapon.
III. Free Training Adjustments
1. Resetting training ground now resets combat item cooldowns.
2. Durability auto-repair now also repairs current weapon toughness.
IV. Out-of-Game Adjustments
1. Significantly increased Relic shop recycling prices.
2. You may conveniently batch-list multiple items in Trading Market.
3. When selecting Century Chests and Key Cases in the storeroom or loadout interface, you can now quickly use the limited-time cards in your inventory.
V. Item Adjustments
1. Added 1 slot to the tactical bag and adjusted tactical bag position accordingly.
//Dev Notes: Two slots felt cramped with limited tactical item variety. We hope increasing tactical bag capacity will enrich strategic options.
2. Increased Dual Blades's flight speed during \[Dual Blades·Whirl]'s extreme effect \[Universe Slash·Whirling Blade]. Adjusted \[Universe Slash] in The Herald's Trial and Showdown accordingly.
3. Added an effect to the \[Dual Blades·Rush] extreme effect \[Belladonna Sprint·Rush]. Now, can charge Horizontal Strikes to the second and third stages, increasing hit count and hit Focus.

4. Added effects to the \[Polesword·Stomp] extreme effect \[Battle Stride·Unstoppable]. Now, can perform Battle Stride successively. Unyielding Hilt deals 25% increased damage and restores Health or Armor on hit.
5. Adjusted \[Heng Sword•Dash] extreme effect \[Aurora Burst•Shadow Step] silence duration from 1.6 sec to 4 sec.
6. Added effects to \[Heng Sword•Stab] extreme effect \[Lethal Jab•Loopback]. Now, Lethal Jab damage increased by 10%. These strikes disable enemies' Grappling and Mole Hooks on hit.
7. Added an effect to the \[Dual Halberds·Immerse] extreme effect \[Benthic Descent·Soaked]. Airborne vertical strikes now become \[Benthic Descent].
8. Each \[Dual Halberds·Burn] extreme effect \[Dragonlike Might·Burn] hit applies burn.
9. Adjusted the \[Charged Power Scale Rush] Scale Rush damage increase with charge time from 20%/25%/35%/45% to 25%/32.5%/40%/50%.
10. Increased the Vulnerable effect for \[Line Breaker Scale Rush] inflicted on enemies on hit from 15% to 20%.
11. Increased the \[Yang Decay] explosion damage from \[White-Blue: Yang Emergence] by 150%.
12. Increased the \[Yin Decay] explosion damage from \[Blue-White: Yin Resurgence] by 37.5%.

13. Increased the \[Yin-Yang Burst] explosion damage from \[Yin Yang Convulsion] by 14%. The explosion can stagger enemies that are Focused. Also added the following effect: when \[Yin-Yang Burst] hits, summon a \[Yin-Yang Jade] for an AOE blast strike that staggers non-Focused enemies. Lasts for 5 sec, can be triggered once every 10 sec.
14. Added an effect to \[Vajra Counter], making counters easier.
15. Increased the recovery effect for \[Spring Vitality Counter] from 200 to 300.
16. \[Quick Dart]'s Golden Roc escort speed bonus was increased from 2%/5%/10%/16.5% to 10%/16%/22%/33% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary), with a team max of 100%.
17. \[Golden Touch] gathering speed bonus increased from 3%/9%/16%/25% to 10%/15%/20%/30% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary).
18. \ max Health bonus increased from 4.5%/10% to 6%/12% (Common/Rare).
19. \[Damage Reduction] damage reduction bonus increased from 2%/4%/6.5%/9% to 4%/7%/10%/13% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary).
20. \[Divine Form] damage reduction at full Health increased from 10% to 15%.
I. Hero Adjustments
1. Yoto Hime
(1) Added Golden Focus (Skill) when skill \[Flying Edge: Showdown] throws the demon blade.
(2) Ultimate \[Demon Blade: Showdown] can home onto surrounding enemies when used.
(3) Defuse skill \[Annihilation Blade] and Aegis-break Martial Skill \[Annihilation Slash] damage increases with the number of charges you have.
II. Combat Adjustments
Improved the performance of the Combat Items
III. Free Training Adjustments
1. Entering Free Training now automatically sets elemental meter once based on equipped Souljade elemental attributes.
2. Added hotkeys to set maximum values and reset elemental meter in the custom elemental meter page.

3. When equipping Souljades that change effects based on imbued elements, automatically activates the effect corresponding to the highest current elemental meter type. You can select a fixed elemental type to activate for each such Souljade.
I. New Packs

1. Added Zai exclusive Pack \[Butterfly Reverie], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Butterfly Reverie], Legendary Dagger Skin \[Summer Party·Sound of Waves], Epic Hairstyle \[Summer Party·Refreshing] and Legendary Accessory \[Summer Party·Goggles]. Standard price: 5,000 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

2. Newly added Tessa exclusive \[Superstar Pack], including Legendary Outfit \[Laudation·Superstar], Legendary Nunchucks Skin \[Laudation·Rose Glass], Legendary Accessory \[Laudation·Nimble], Legendary Hairstyle \[Laudation·Starflame]. Standard price: 5,300 Gold; Now: 2,700 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Tessa Legendary Accessory \[Laudation·Soul Fox].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
2. Newly added Lannie Epic Pose \. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
3. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture \ for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
4. Newly added Tessa Legendary Background \[Dazzling Star]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
5. Newly added Tessa Legendary Base \[Sound-chasing Fox].
Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
6. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement \[Leafstep Grace]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
7. Kylin Zhang Legendary Background \[Moonbane Ghost]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.
8. Kylin Zhang Legendary Base \[Shadow Flame]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
III. Limited-time Items Removed
1. Cyra Exclusive Pack \[Aurora Night] and Cyra Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Aurora Night] have been removed from the store.
2. Kylin Zhang Exclusive Pack \[Sun-kissed Surf] and Kylin Zhang Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Sun-Kissed Surf] have been removed from the store.
IV. New Items in the Lunar Pavilion
1. Newly added Ziping Yin Epic Base \[Spring Reflection] with a price of 80 Jade Disks.
2. Newly added Ziping Yin Epic Background \[Peach Blossom Song] with a price of 40 Jade Disks.
I. Hero-Related BUGS
1. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord's strike detection didn't match visual effect ranges for some moves.
2. Fixed an issue where Inor Wan's projectiles might unexpectedly magnetize to enemies behind when using skill \[Bolt Dash: Pact].
3. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord couldn't execute \[Lightning Execution] on enemies affected by \ or \[Strong Dazzle].
4. Fixed an issue where Lannie's Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce: Leap] had lingering strike detection during some moves.
5. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord might unexpectedly clip outside the scene when teleporting with \[Voltaic Spear·Edge] second-stage.
6. Fixed an issue that would cause Inor Wan's \[Thunderforged: Edge]'s Voltaic Spear projectile to trigger clashes with enemy weapon attacks.
II. Rift Traversal-Related Bugs
Fixed an issue where high-quality Healing Berries/Armor Powder had abnormal recovery effects when equipped with \[Advanced Heal] Rubrics in Rift Traversal.
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 6th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 7th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
I. New Hero: Inor Wan

Thunder courses through his veins as he roams the land alone. Inor Wan is known as the Thunder's Voice among the martial artists. Upholding justice and honoring promises, he is also recognized as the Best Escort in Icuria.

He readily accepts commissions to aid the world and benefit the people and never shirks requests for righteous vengeance. Once he takes on an escort mission, he will see it through even if it means traversing mountains of knives and seas of fire!
II. Season Exclusive: Fission Treasure
1. The Fission Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Yoto Hime Extreme Outfit \[Doll Dream] and the Katana Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique].
2. While wearing \[Doll Dream], there will be a \[Waltz Finale] effect when you defeat enemies. Cannot be Imprinted: When combat begins, enters a special form: Crimson Puppet.

3. Equipping Katana Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique] changes the hit effects of Blink Strikes and the Souljade \[Swift Cut]. Cannot be Imprinted: Unleashing a charged strike with Blade Mystique will shift and change its appearance.

(1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

(2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.

(3) Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.
5. Fission Treasure 50% Discounts

The first 10 Fission Treasures that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Fission Treasures have been purchased, subsequent Fission Treasures will return to their standard price.
6. Fission Treasure will be available on Aug. 7th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC)!
After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Treasures remain locked until the specified time.
The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Treasures.
III. Reputation Score System

We have reworked the Reputation system. You can access the Reputation interface through Profile-Reputation. By maintaining a high Reputation score, you can earn rewards, including Legendary Bases, Ranked Score, and Score Keeper Cards.
IV. New Loadouts Available in the Rift Traversal Mode
1. The "King of Weapons" Spear is now a part of Rift Traversal!
New Celestia Spear: Azure Dragon
Arcane: Azure Dragon Break
Alters Vertical Strikes after a charged Horizontal Strike, Nezha's Might, or Dragonslayer misses.
New Legendary and Extreme Spear: Spear·Track
Extreme: Heartstopper Kick·Flash
Dragonslayer temporarily silences enemies hit, and can lead into a follow-up attack if it misses, up to 3 times.
New Legendary and Extreme Spear: Spear·Air
Extreme: Thunderous Smash
After hitting with an airborne Horizontal Strike, alters the next airborne Vertical Strike.
Razor Swift: Alters Nezha's Might's strikes.
Erudition & Spear Storm: Alters the Spear's Charged Vertical Strike and the 3rd Vertical Strike in the Spear combo, and Spear Storm can be used by unleashing a Vertical Strike after using Erudition.
Martial Art·Hexa-Harmony Spear: Alters Spear's charged Horizontal Strikes.
Congeneric Martial Skills: Long-handle Weapon Skills for Rift Traversal.
V. Newly added Extreme Collections Lock Feature
1.When previewing the Extreme cosmetics, you can now use the buttons to switch between different forms
2. The initial batch of cosmetics available for this feature:
(1) For Katana's Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique], there are 3 types of effects available: Blade Mystique·Flow, Blade Mystique·Brilliance Shine, Blade Mystique·Deep Shadow
(2) For Yoto Hime's Extreme Outfit \[Doll Dream], there are 3 types of effects available: Doll Dream·Default, Doll Dream·White, Doll Dream·Crimson
VI. Star-Collection Feature Optimizations
1. Added a preview function that allows you to set Constellations to display while previewing Star-Collections. (This preview function will only include a small number of Constellation attributes).
2. New Star Collections will have a Restyle guarantee. (Star Collections that have already been released will not change).
\[Star - Mountain Crusher] and \[Star - Wind's Whisper] will have a Restyle guarantee for their final Constellation of 2,000 and 1,000, respectively.
The upcoming Extreme and Legendary Star Collections will have a Restyle guarantee for their final Constellation of 2,000 and 1,000, respectively.
3. Added a toggle feature for the final Constellation. You can activate \[Ultimate Aura Effect] in the Collection interface.

4. Adjustment to Star-Collections in Season Treasure: From this Season, the Star-Collections in Season Treasures will be changed to limited-time bonus rewards. Star-Collections that are not given within a specified time period will be removed from and become unobtainable. Please refer to the corresponding treasure and event descriptions for details.
VII. Limited-time event: Thunder's Voice
This time, leave everything to me!
Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 Update - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Complete Daily Quests to obtain Inor Wan Trial Vouchers and Thunder Tokens.
2. Complete Event Quests to obtain Thunder Tokens. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
3. Consume Thunder Tokens to redeem rewards.
VIII. Limited-time Event: Source Awakening
Event Duration: Aug. 15, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Deadline: Aug 23, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Powers gather at Jinsha Site, blades tearing through the sky! The 2025 NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mid-Season Championship at EWC is underway!
1. Gain \[Power Core] by completing quests during the event. \[Power Core] can be redeemed for great event rewards.

IX. Limited-time Event: Day of Reunion
Event Duration: Aug. 13, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Aug. 24, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Avatar, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Fission Treasure etc.
X. Limited Time Event: Tao Gate·Opening
Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 Update - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, play any Survival Mode (excluding Immortal War), or interact with Rift Portals in Rift Traversal mode to obtain Rift Chests.
2. You can earn up to 1 Rift Chest per match, and up to 3 Rift Chests per day.

3. Open Rift Chests for a chance to receive rewards such as Legendary Outfit Choice Gift, Legendary Weapon Choice Gift, Legendary Accessory Choice Gift, Legendary Card Choice Gift, Fission Treasure, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Jade Disk, Advanced Battle Edict, Intermediate Battle Edict, Glazed Crystal, Fission Coins and more.

Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 04:00 (UTC) - Aug. 22, 2025 04:00 (UTC)
Event Rules

Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #17 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration: Aug 7, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Sep 3, 2025 23:59 (UTC)
I. Yoto Hime
1. Added Golden Focus (Skill) when skill \[Flying Edge] throws the demon blade to distant targets.

2. Adjusted the damage multiplier of charged moves of Ultimate \[Demon Blade] Horizontal Strikes from 1.0+2.0 to 1.8+1.3; that of ground Vertical Strikes from 0.5+2.5 to 0.2+2.8; that of airborne Vertical Strikes from 2.5 to 2.8.

3. Adjusted the damage multipliers of the first three strikes of Ultimate \[Demon Blade: Combo] against heroes with transformation traits to match those against normal heroes, from 2.6/3.2/3.8 to 3.5/3.5/3.5; adjusted the lifesteal multiplier from 30% to 40%.
II. Wuchen

Adjusted the Defensive Focus during the charging process of skill \[Spirit Blades] after charging the 1st stage from Blue Focus to Golden Focus (Move); adjusted the Defensive Focus when releasing the charged move from Blue Focus to Golden Focus (Skill).
III. Zai
1. Adjusted the Defensive Focus during the dash of skill \[Flame Ward: Firestorm] from Golden Focus (Move) to Golden Focus (Skill).
2. Optimized the pre-input timing for using movement actions to interrupt skill \[Flame Ward: Firestorm] while in aiming mode.
IV. Kurumi
Optimized the dodge interrupt timing when using Vertical Strikes during \ for skills \[Healing Ray] and \[Healing Ray: Defense].
V. Cyra
1. When she fires beam attacks when her Ultimate is active, a pursuit beam will be automatically released after 2 sec.

Players can now Counter Level 1 and Level 2 pursuit beams, but sustained beams cannot be blocked. A successful Counter blocks most damage while inflicting a brief stagger—Cyra herself remains unaffected by the Counter.

items.text: Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Jul. 23, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Jul. 24, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
I. Introducing Champion Fight and Champion Fight Point System

For players who've reached Asura and seek greater challenges, we're launching Champion Fight matches and the Champion Fight Point system in Ranked Mode. This is your gateway to a new era of competitive glory.
1. Champion Fight: A New Battlefield for Elite Players
(1) Prerequisites
In Ranked Solo, Duos, or Trios modes, teams with any player whose current mode rank ≥4500 points will match into Champion Fight by default.

Players with exceptional recent performance may access Champion Fight early, even below 4500 points. Early access grants bonus Champion Fight Points and a 30% rank score bonus or a 30% less rank score loss.
(2) Match Characteristics
Fewer players per match means sharper competition.
Strategic resource distribution changes keep every match more unpredictable.
Tighter initial safe zones in Solo create more intense encounters.
2. Champion Fight Points: Exclusive Reward System
(1) Unlock Requirements
Champion Fight unlocks the Champion Fight Point system. You can find it in your Ranked Mode interface.
(2) How to get Champion Fight Points
Your match performance determines Champion Fight Points earned at the end of each match. Better performance earns more points. Your points only go up, never down.
(3) Rewards

Champion Fight Points feature six different tiers. Stack your points and climb the ranks for exclusive rewards, including prestigious Champion profile backgrounds and Champion auras that mark true competitive excellence.
Reward Duration: Champion profile backgrounds and auras activate immediately and last until the end of the next season. Earn them again to extend the duration by another full season.
II. New Loadouts Available in the Rift Traversal Mode
1. A blade of gold refined, a cold glint so divine. The Heng Sword is now a part of Rift Traversal!
New Celestia Heng Sword: Golden Shatterer
Arcane: Auric Fracture
Each hit reduces the enemy's Max Armor by 8% for 60 sec, stacking up to 10 times.
New Legendary and Extreme Heng Sword: Heng Sword•Dash
Extreme: Aurora Burst•Shadow Step
Alters the Heng Sword's 2nd-stage vertical charged strike and the 1st-stage vertical charged strike after Shadow Step. Enemies hit with the first move will be temporarily Silenced.
New Legendary and Extreme Heng Sword: Heng Sword•Stab
Extreme: Lethal Jab•Loopback
After Shadow Stepping, Horizontal strikes become stabs for at most the next two horizontal strikes. These strikes mark enemies as Vulnerable on hit, causing them to take 5% more hit damage for 10s.
Rampage: Alters Heng Sword's charged Horizontal Strike, and its combo after a charged Vertical Strike.
Aerial Dash: Alters the Heng Sword's vertical Crouch strike. Landing the 1st strike will automatically follow up with the 2nd.
Congeneric Martial Skills: Single-edged Weapon Skills and Heavy Sword Skills for Rift Traversal.
2. New Armors
New Legendary and Extreme Armor: Scale Armor·Frenzy
Extreme: Madbone Demonbane
Defeating Evil-Ent/Elite/Boss respectively grants 0.25%, 4.5%, and 9% attack bonuses, up to a maximum of 15%. This effect only lasts for the current match.
Devil Slayer: Melee Weapon Focus Strike DMG to monsters' Astral Aegis +25%/30%/35%/50% (corresponding to the white/blue/purple/golden qualities)
Weapon Rubrics
Devil Slayer's Edge: Melee Weapons consume Durability 15%/20%/25%/40% slower when hitting monsters. (corresponding to the white/blue/purple/golden qualities)
Armor Rubrics
Heavenly Favor·Devil Extermination: Defeated monsters have a certain chance to drop items, and a smaller chance of dropping Relics. (Chance increases with Rubric quality)
//Dev Notes: We observed that players faced somewhat unbalanced costs and benefits when battling monsters, so we're providing new anti-monster gear for a wider range of choice.
III. New Features Available in the Rift Traversal Mode
(I) Treasure Appraisal and Collection Codex
1) Unlocks at Camp Prestige Level 7.
2. Appraised collectibles are separated into authentic and counterfeits.
Authentic collectibles have a Treasure Value; you can earn Seasonal Treasure Value by submitting Collectibles. Reach milestones to claim seasonal rewards after certain dates.
Counterfeits do not have a Treasure Value, but identifying one will slightly increase the drop rate of the next Collectible.
3. Appraised collectibles can't be traded. You can sell any extras to traveling merchants, who will give you 100% of the collectible's value.
(4) Each season has its own Collection Codex. Submit Collectibles to unlock their entries in the Codex. After unlocking an entry, the collectible can be traded.
5. For unlocked entries, you can earn Seasonal Treasure Value by submitting Collectibles with higher Treasure Value.
6. In future game updates, we plan on releasing a Fairyland Penglai collection viewing function. Only unlocked entries in the Collection Codex will be viewable.
(II) Free Battle Edict Everyday
1. Camp-Seller Sincere's store has new random items. 5 Beginner Battle Edicts and 1 Battle Edict of a random quality will refresh each day.

2. The 5 Beginner Battle Edicts can be claimed for free, while the random Battle Edict can be exchanged for using certain Relics. More random items will be added to this store in the future, so please stay tuned!
3. Random items will refresh every 24 hours at 00:00 (UTC).
(III) Controller and Console
Rift Traversal now supports controllers, and is available on console platforms.
IV. New Showdown Hero: Kylin Zhang
The new hero Kylin Zhang has now joined Showdown. Qilin's Slash shall smite all demons.

Kylin Zhang possesses a unique low-health buff mechanism: his martial skills \ and \[Cyclone Slash] deal higher damage at low health, while his Ultimate \[Qilin Slash: Showdown] gains damage bonus when consuming health.
V. Showdown Event Stages \[Suffer No Demon] Return!
Event Duration: Jul. 24, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
(1) During the event, you can select this level on the Showdown Map. Complete all Event Quests to get an exclusive Hero Badge, Exhilarating Elixir and other rewards.

(2) In \[Suffer No Demon], Season Showdown Level will not impact damage dealt or received, where Sense Level will not impact damage dealt or received. Defeat the Manticore to obtain Manticore Soul, which will allow all of your teammates to use the Manticore's moves in battle.
Manticore Soul·Stone: All team members' Downward Slashes will summon falling rocks on hit.
Manticore Soul·Thunder: allows Defuse (Counterattack) and Aegis-break Martial Skill to summon Divine Thunder waves.
(3) Event stages have their own Souljade drops, suitable for farming specific Souljades. Both chapters share the same drops, including:
\[Element Surge], \[Thunder Chain], \[Thunder Charge], \[Toxified Chain], \[Toxin Seep], \[Frostbite Chain], \[Chill Spike], \[Depths Blast], \, \[Element Rush], \[Element Aegis], \[Rampage·Element]
(4) Each chapter has two difficulty stages that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. Choose difficulty based on your capabilities.

(5) Chapter 1 stages are available immediately upon event start, while Chapter 2 stages unlock at 20:00 on Jul. 30, 2025 (UTC). Chapter 1 stages will close when Chapter 2 opens (you don't have to play any specific chapter to complete Event Quests).
(6) Event stages offer trial access to max-level Justina Gu, Feria Shen, and Ziping Yin, each with preset Souljade loadouts. You have 3 trial attempts per day.
VI. New Limited-timed Gameplay
(I) Dragonspring Well and Dragonspring Treasure

The Herald's Trial, Quick Match, and Bot Mode will feature new \[Dragonspring Well] spawns throughout matches. Capture these wells to unlock Dragonspring Sword. After Dragonspring Sword is obtained, \[Dragonspring Treasure] appears after some time, and only teams with Dragonspring Sword can find and unlock it. The treasure contains new combat item \[Seven Stars] and \[Meteorite Darksteel] that upgrades Dragonspring Sword to Extreme quality.
(II) New Combat Items
Seven Stars Tome: Charge up then release a sword qi forward, during charging phase using basic attack can release sword qi early. (Can be obtained through the Dragonspring Treasure.)
Heavenly Spirits Tome: Use martial arts to channel inner power to repel surrounding enemies, can be used when under attack. (Can be obtained through the Morus' Blessing.)
Qi Circulation Tome: Use martial arts to channel inner power to attack enemies ahead. (Can be obtained through the golden/green Stashes.)
VII. Fairyland Penglai
1. Bronze Tree stirs; something is brewing. Bronze Tree will become interactive at a certain time. Please stay tuned.
2. Fairyland Penglai now features the Degenerate decor, with a dragon throne mechanism at the center of Seraphic Quartet. Interact to sit on the throne, with a chance to trigger additional effects.
VIII. Fission Season's Immortal War is now available
After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards.

1. Season Reward Adjustments: New season rewards for Immortal War mode can now be earned simply by participating in Immortal War matches! Join Immortal War matches and earn Immortal War reward points based on your in-match performance to unlock Immortal War season rewards
2. Rank Icons and Names: Modified icons for all Immortal War ranks and renamed all of them except "Magnate."

Players who make it into the Top 500 in Immortal War will enter the Immortal Leaderboard. This leaderboard is updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, players that earned a special title this way will receive an Avatar reward as well. A player who is on the Immortal Leaderboard at the end of the season will receive an additional Avatar reward.
In addition, the Top 3 players of the last tally will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.
IX. Limited-time Event: Thunder and Demonslayer
Event Duration: Jul. 23, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Gain Soul Tallies by completing quests during the event. Soul Tallies can be redeemed for great event rewards.
2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
4. The rewards are redeemable till Aug 13, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.
X. Limited-time Event: 10,000 Mile Haul
Event Duration: Jul. 24, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

1. During the event, you can accept Courier missions on the event page and receive rewards upon completion. A total of 20 Courier missions can be accepted each week. The Courier mission limit refreshes every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).

2. You can consume Panther Sigils to quickly complete current Courier missions. Daily login rewards include 1 Panther Sigil. You can receive 1 additional Panther Sigil via mail for giving and receiving Panther Sigils daily.

3. After accepting a Courier mission, you can check Auto Courier to automatically accept the next Courier mission upon completion. Auto Courier cannot trigger during matches or while offline, but ongoing Courier missions will complete normally.
4. Completing certain Courier missions will reward you with Courier Chronicles written by Inor Wan and unlock corresponding rewards.
XI. Limited-time Event: A Play for the Throne
I was born Degenerate, I'll die Degenerate!
Event Duration: Jul. 24, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, complete quests to get The Degenerate Tokens and Xingyun Random Gift.
2. Collect a certain number of The Degenerate Tokens to obtain rewards and unlock the storyline.
XII. Limited-time Event: Qilin's Return in the Snow
Snow blankets the mountains, the seasons leave their marks. Suddenly, an old friend stands atop a wintry cliff.
Event Duration: Jul. 24, 2025 Update - Aug. 13, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

items.text: Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Jul. 8th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Jul. 9th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after maintenance is complete.
I. The brand-new treasure hunting mode, Rift Traversal, is now available (Trailblazer Season)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/17b4715fbc49d8be27bdfd820277aa8fd970faa8.png"]
Ancient deities stir. Rifts tear the world apart, and heroes converge upon this calamity.
Your goal: scavenge lost supplies, defeat opponents, and escape safely through Rift Gates.
Whatever you extract from the rifts enters your personal out-of-game storeroom and becomes resources for your next match.
1. Basic Rules
(1) Collect lost Relics across the fractured lands of Holoroth in Rift Traversal.
(2) While treasure hunting, you must deal with monsters and beware of prowling "counterparts". Bring your Divine Armory or travel light, but rebirth means losing everything you carry.
(3) Find Rift Gates on the map, awaken the Aegis Tree, restore yin-yang balance, and escape with your plundered treasures intact.
2. Out-of-Game Systems
(1) Preparation
Purchase and equip supplies in the Preparation interface before entering rifts. You'll spawn into matches with your prepared loadout.
(2) Storeroom
Store supplies extracted from matches in your storeroom, where you can organize and sell these resources.
(3) New Assist Gear "Mole Hook"
Switch between Grappling Hook and Mole Hook assist gear during Preparation or at Rift Dealers in-game. Both consume hook items.
a. Stealth Movement: Use on the ground to burrow and move stealthily. While burrowed, you can organize your bag, drop items, and even search for treasures underground.
b. Aerial Rush: Rush in any direction, even skyward.
c. Leap: Press dodge while burrowing to jump over obstacles and gain brief invulnerability at the cost of Stamina.
d. Underground Moves: Horizontal strike charges toward crosshair, vertical strike performs Uppercut Slash. You can charge underground, waiting for the right opportunity to burst forth!
3. In-Game Mechanics
(1) Spawn: After Preparation, you will spawn randomly on one of the map's two sides.
(2) Resource Searching: Interact with in-game objects to search for resources. Interactables have highlight outlines.
(3) Precious Resources: Drunken Fire Crates are precious, limited resources on the map. They are more likely to contain high-quality Relics.
(When opening some Drunken Fire Crates, you must seize the moment and use counters to weaken their seal meter.)

a. Blizzard: You build Coldness during blizzards. Your Rage is continuously drained when you reach a certain amount of Coldness. Find Campfires for warmth. Blizzards also spawn frozen treasures across the battlefield.
b. Sandstorm: Crouch to hide in the dust during Sandstorm for ambushes and retreats.
As matches progress, quests activate across the map.
a. Contract: Defeat specific targets like the heathens at Yushan Ruins, the horse bandits at Plumed Castle, and the shadow guards at the City of Tang per quest requirements.
b. Valiant Challenge: Reveals your position once picked up, but scouts for enemies within a certain range every once in a while. You have to survive for a certain period of time.
c. Revenge: Deal 1,000 damage to your teammate's killer and your party will gain 1 additional rebirth (Requires one of your teammates to have been eliminated).
d. Flag: Escort your party's flagbearer, and head for the target Spirit Well zone. Defend the area until progress reaches 100% to complete the quest and receive Drunken Fire Crates.
e. Cargo Escort: Capture and escort the Golden Roc to the station to obtain Drunken Fire Crates.
f. Clear: Clear out Evil-Ent strongholds to receive Drunken Fire Crates.
g. Guard: Protect the target boss from being defeated within the quest time.
h. Challenge: Collect 2 Rune Stone items from clearing Evil-Ent strongholds to unlock boss challenges. Defeat the boss to receive Drunken Fire Crates.
(6) Caves
More than 10 cave types await across each match, but you’ll need keys to unlock them. Keys have limited durability, and the amount used varies depending on the vault's and map's difficulty.
Special cave keys can be purchased from Rift Dealers. Keys with special descriptions cannot be extracted from matches.
(7) Escape
As matches progress, escape points—Rift Gates—gradually activate across the map.
Different Rift Gates have varying limits, activation times, and durations. Gates close when their duration ends.
Beyond regular Rift Gates, gates with special conditions include:
a. Weight-Limited Gates: Requires Relic Bag weight below a certain threshold

b. Triggered Gates: Requires triggering the Rift Gate Guides located in the West Wing, Forecourt, and East Wing of Plumed Castle, in that order. Once used, they enter cooldown and cannot be used immediately by other parties.
c. Quest Gates: Requires completing any quest
d. Hidden Gates: Requires purchasing specific items from Rift Dealers

Escape Rules: An escape point can be used to escape only if there are no enemies within its zone. Once the progress bar fills up, interact with the Rift Gate to escape. (Interacting with a Rift Gate to escape takes 5.5 sec)
4. In-game Items
1) Combat Items
Players can choose two of the following Combat Items to carry into the game:
·Morph Rune: It contains the Herald's Psylith shapeshifting secrets. Use to transform into nearby ordinary objects.
· Enigmatic Rift: Summons an Enigmatic Rift that connects a location in a valid area with the current location. (Only accessible for allies.)
·Demon Sealing Talisman: Summons a Forbidden Seal at the current location.
·Scout Eye: Detects enemies in the selected area
·Convoy Flag: Summons a Convoy Chest. After the countdown ends, if the chest is not destroyed, the items stored in it can be sent.
·Treasureseer: Reveals the Drunken Fire Crate nearby within 180 sec and increases looting speed.
·Wind Horn: A horn carefully crafted by the Herald. Use it to summon the flying eagle to ride on its back to move forward against the wind. The heavier the Relic Bag, the shorter the flying distance.

·Enchanting Incense: An incapacitating trap designed by the Herald. Puts an enemy to sleep, allowing you to steal from their Bag. Stealing might alert the enemy, possibly waking them up early. Becomes visible to everyone after 90 sec. Does not work on enemies in Ultimate Focus. You can slap affected teammates to wake them up.
·Wedding Wine: Within 600 sec after drinking it, increase Attack by 5% and Damage Reduction by 5%.

·Rejuvenation Nectar: Within 600 sec after drinking it, if being attacked, activate self Vitality and gain Armor Recovery for 36 sec, restoring 30 Armor per sec. This effect has a 60-sec cooldown and can be triggered up to 2 times.
·Vajra's Sobriety: When being Countered within 300 sec after drinking it, restore 450 Health and your weapon will not drop. Can be triggered up to 2 times.

·Green Plum Brew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, if you are airborne because of being attacked by Uppercut Slashes, flash Emerald Glow to interrupt enemies around. This effect has a 60-sec cooldown and can be triggered up to 3 times.

·Sorrow-free Dew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, when taking lethal damage, negate the damage and knock back nearby enemies. You will gain 30% Damage Reduction for 5 sec and restore 1000 health. This effect can only be triggered once.
·Mythic Dew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, increase maximum Health by 50%.

Throat-burning Hard Liquor: For 600s after drinking it, it warms your body and dispels cold, and your melee attacks will trigger fiery explosions, burning all nearby enemies. 120-second cooldown, up to 2 times.
5. The Trailblazer season is positioned as a trial season, with the goal of building a more refined gaming experience for the official first season.
Based on player feedback and data validation, the following content will be dynamically iterated during the season:
(1) Weapon Type Expansion: The first phase will introduce 11 weapon types, with more to be added in future updates.
(2) Collection System Refinement: The initial version includes 6 Collections and 110+ Relics, with more types of collectibles and relics to be introduced in subsequent updates.
(3) Gameplay Optimization: As the Trailblazer season evolves, gameplay mechanics and features will be dynamically adjusted throughout the season.
(4) Numerical Balance Iteration: To ensure a fair competitive environment, adjustments will be made to the balance of heroes/weapons/armor/support gear/rubrics as the season progresses.
(5) Economic System Tuning: To maintain market stability and pricing consistency, the cost of certain items will be dynamically balanced throughout the season.
(6) Other Adjustments: We will continuously optimize any content that impacts player experience—your feedback is our driving force!
Your feedback is crucial! Every piece of input during this trial season lays the foundation for the official season.
6. Rift Traversal currently does not have controller support, nor is it supported on console platforms. Optimizations are in progress, and we will make it available as soon as possible!
II. New Mechanism \[Dragonsteed Chariot]
1. Survival modes (except Immortal War) now feature \[Dragonsteed Chariot]. Each chariot carries three: one driver, two passengers;
2. The driver controls the chariot's direction, and passengers can hurl spears to attack;
3. Dragonsteed Chariots deal continuous ramming damage while moving and can charge into enemies to create a powerful impact;
4. Chariot movement and charging consume durability. Chariots will stop moving at 0 durability, but drivers can consume Weapon Repair Kits to repair them.
III. New Ranks
1. Ranks beyond \ will switch to a star-based system, with every 100 points converted to 1 star.
2. We're also adding two new ranks at 15 and 30 stars, above \[Unrivaled Asura]: \[Formless Dragon] and \[Infinite Nirvana].
Optimized Rank Display on Player Profiles – Players can now toggle the primary ranked mode shown.

Developer Notes: // Due to many players focusing on one ranked mode while leaving others at Bronze, the previous parallel display was not ideal. To address this, we’ve emphasized the primary mode’s rank and allowed players to manually select which mode’s rank is showcased. In the future, we’ll enhance multi-mode Asura displays to better highlight players who challenge themselves across all modes.

4. In the near future, the Champion Fight system will be introduced. Ranked matches above 4500 points will be classified as \[Champion Fight] matches. \[Champion Fight] matches have a maximum of 16 teams per game. Players earn Champion Fight Points based on combat performance in these matches. These Points accumulate throughout the season and never decrease. As your Champion Fight Points increase, you'll unlock rewards including Profile background and display effects to showcase your achievements.

items.text: Brand New Content
I. Showdown Season 3.0: Windstorm
1. New Hero: Justina Gu
The Herald stirs. Ancient shadows awaken. Three legendary blades cross paths for the first time.
What alliance could bring together Justina Gu, the Saint Eagle of Holoroth, and the Wolf King of the Prairie against impossible odds?
The new Hero Justina Gu has now joined Showdown. Her blade weaves frost and shadow, cleansing corruption from every realm.
2. New Boss and New Chapter
Something sinister awakens in the silent Empyreal Village. Beneath twisted totem poles, a woman clad in wolf pelts emerges from the darkness...
Three hundred years of desert storms could not bury Sirius' fury—Huanyue, one of the elders of the Herald, walks among mortals once more.
The brand new Showdown series [Tenfold Doom: The Herald Elder Council] officially begins, with the new chapter [Howling Gale] now live!
//Dev Notes: We're streamlining our storytelling approach and update cadence. While keeping the same 4 stages per 2 seasons, we're now delivering a steady 2 stages each season for better pacing.
Plus, starting this season, every new stage's Easy mode is unlocked from the get-go; no requirements, no level gates. You can all enjoy the Showdown saga and face our latest bosses right away.
3. Trial Heroes and Team Support

(1) When teaming up with other players, you can select 2 heroes displayed in your teammate's profiles and their corresponding loadouts during the preparation phase. As teammates, they can also directly configure loadouts and provide these support heroes during the preparation phase. System trial heroes are also available when not in a team.
(2) Initial trial attempts are 2 per week. Upgrade your Showdown season level to unlock more attempts.
(3) Provide support heroes for Popularity points, Souljade Fragments, and Scented Sachet rewards.
(4) This feature is available in Normal/Hard stages, Doom mode, and Topaz Enigma Domain.
(5) Trial attempts and reward progress reset every Thursday at 4:00 AM.
4. New Showdown Journey Quests
Starting with [Windstorm Season], each new Showdown season will feature exclusive Journey Quests. The existing beginner's Journey Quests will still be available.
How to Unlock: After completing the beginner's Journey Quests, participate in Showdown to automatically unlock the Journey Quest of the current season.

Quest and Rewards: Within the limited event period after the season begins, complete any Showdown stage daily to claim daily rewards. Complete 7 days of quests to receive generous Journey rewards: powerful Souljade sets and precious Showdown resources—Flux Jade Shards.
5. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss Reset
Yama's Abyss, Nirriti's Ruins, and season challenge progress and rewards have been reset.
Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Showdown Seal, Flux Shard, limited-edition avatars, and much more!
6. Brand-new Gameplay
(1) New "Element Surge" Souljades. Max out your elemental meter and unleash devastating power. Works with Ice, Thunder, and Poison builds.
(2) Bow and Musket now support Quick Counter.

(3) Ranged weapons now feature the "Cloudpiercer" mechanism. Build up your Deadeye meter through shooting, then enter Deadeye mode for advanced techniques. Bow and Musket lead the charge with weakness exploitation and signature Deadeye skills.
(4) Potential levels have been reset. We've overhauled all existing potential effects and added new ones for Element Surge and Deadeye, providing a wider range of combo selections!
7. Sense Level Redesigned as Showdown Level
Sense levels for Showdown Souljades and heroes are now unified as "Showdown Level", and we're merging Potential levels into it too.

Your maximum Sense level of Souljades in Might Season will be partially carried over and converted to your Showdown Level. levels 1050 and below don't transfer, but every 5 levels above 1050 becomes 1 Showdown Level (i.e., maxed Lv. 1120 becomes Lv. 15).
Earn Showdown XP through weekly Showdown quests or Fatigue usage to upgrade your Showdown Level. Higher levels mean more potential points and massive attribute boosts.
//Dev Notes: The new Showdown Level system removes barriers for newcomers.
Additionally, it eliminates the tedious grind when experimenting with different Souljade builds. No more wasted drops on upgrades, and there will be more recasting materials.
8. Season Settlements
Might Season will end on June 5th, 2025 00:00 (UTC)

II. Showdown Limited-time modes
Vinemire Gone Wild events
Vinemire has descended into madness, and rampages throughout Showdown! What path will you take?

1. There's a chance for [Vinemire Gone Wild] to trigger while facing the boss in main Showdown stages (excluding Immovable, None Shall Pass, Vibrations, and Buried Giant), Topaz Enigma Domain, and Nirriti's Ruins.
2. While Vinemire attacks all indiscriminately while on a rampage, its hatred of the boss far outweighs that of the heroes.
3. In some cases, the rampaging Vinemire may leave the battle of its own accord.
III. MVP Highlight

We're rolling out MVP highlight reels. In the end of Capture the Spirit Well, Golden Roc Escort, The Bloodbath, and Showdown Trios mode (Enigma Domain, Nirriti's Ruins, Doom, Tempered Inferno), the highlight clips of the MVP of that game will be displayed to everyone present.
IV. Safe Exit for Non-Premade Teams During Prep

In non-premade teams, if a teammate leaves during the preparation phase and the match begins with fewer players, you can now exit early without penalty or match result being recorded, as long as you have not engaged in combat within a set time after the match starts.

items.text: Brand New Content
I. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay: Fly High
Grab some friends and fly high above Fairyland Penglai. The scenery is perfect for a tour in the sky!
1. Approach other players to use gesture "Fly High" on them, forming a flight team.
2. The player that started the interaction is the flight leader, and controls its movement.
3. Beware of the obstacles in the air and on the ground, as the flight team will auto-disband if an obstacle is hit.
4. This is only available in certain areas. The areas around the Pantheon and Songbird Arena are not supported.

I. Client Optimizations
Ray Tracing Experimental Version Now Available

After this update, ray tracing can be enabled in the graphics settings after activating DirectX 12 mode. When enabled, ray tracing global illumination and ray tracing reflections technologies will greatly enhance visual effects across all maps and modes, providing more realistic real-time lighting effects and a more immersive gaming experience.

(1) Ray tracing is currently only available on NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards that support ray tracing acceleration. In future versions, Intel graphics cards with ray tracing acceleration will support ray tracing after deep optimization at the driver level. Players are recommended to upgrade to the latest driver version for their graphics cards.

(2) Enabling ray tracing will incur some performance costs. This can be offset by using image enhancement features (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) and Frame Generation to improve performance and get a better experience.

(3) This update integrates NVIDIA DLSS ray reconstruction technology, which uses AI to denoise sampling results, generating higher quality pixels and improving ray-traced image quality. Players can enable ray reconstruction in the graphics settings after enabling ray tracing. This technology is currently only available on RTX 40 series and above graphics cards.

(4) Ray tracing is currently in experimental version and will continue to be optimized in future versions. If abnormal crashes occur with ray tracing enabled, players can disable it in the settings on the login screen.

items.text: Brand New Content
I. New Showdown Gameplay: Tempered Inferno

In the Soul-forging Abyss hidden in the Shadowjade Mine, the "Chaos Furnace" that once refined the legendary weapons of the Herald used to be alight day and night. However, under the mad scheme of Omnius, a drastic change occurred.

After Omnius's plan to revert the Five Phases back to primordial chaos was foiled by the heroes, some formless chaotic Qi escaped and seeped into the Chaos Furnace. A bursting of energy flooded out because of the imbalanced Five Elements within, attracting countless evil spirits into action. Thus, a battle to protect the furnace began.

In this crisis, the heroes used Chaos Stones crafted by the Chaos Furnace to forge Curios imbued with the powers of Yin and Yang. These Curios then became their weapons to slay demons and eradicate evils.

However, as the energy of the Chaos Furnace continued to leak, the furnace fire gradually weakened. The heroes who sought more Curios could only wait for the Five Phases True Qi to return to balance on the Morus Isle before they could once again awaken the Furnace.
Defeat waves of enemies, claim numerous prizes, and revel in the power of the Curios!
II. New Showdown Item: Curio
Each hero has two Curio slots: Yin and Yang. One Curio can be equipped in each slot.
1. Crafting Curios
Chaos Stones, acquired in Tempered Inferno, can be used to craft Curios. There are two kinds of Curio crafting: Random Craft and Targeted Craft.
[Random Craft] produces a random Curio of the current season, and builds XP to boost its Crafting level.
Once you have raised a given Curio to Lv. 1, you'll be able to choose to craft that Curio using [Targeted Craft].

At the end of the season, Curios will be reclaimed, but Crafting Levels will be retained. In following seasons, players with Crafting levels will be able to craft Curios from past seasons. From time to time we will hold Rerun Events for players who missed out.
During the season, each Curio Crafting level you upgrade will increase the season progress by 1. Season progress rewards include Flux Shards, Curio crafting materials and more!
2. Curio Stars
Curios can be smelted into Chaos Extract, a resource used in leveling up Curios.
Each level gained grants an attribute of a random quality and type (that the Curio does not already have). A Curio can have at most 4 attributes.
3. Awakening Curios and Harmonic Balance
Extreme Curio raised to 3-Star level can be awakened with Tempered Essence.
If successful, the Curio gains random awakened attributes (these differ between Curios).

Failure will result in the loss of the lowest-quality or lowest-level attribute. You can still raise the Curio's stars to get a new attribute. Each failure boosts your awakening chance across all Curios.
With both an awakened Yin and Yang Curio, you unlock [Harmonic Balance] for all your heroes (whether you have the Curios equipped or not), boosting your Luck by 2,000, and your team's by 1,000.
Boosts can stack. Lasts until Tempered Inferno reopens next season.

items.text: Brand New Content
I. Brand-new Gameplay: [Golden Roc Escort]
Basic Rules
1. Each match is split into two halves, with teams taking turns playing as the Attackers and the Defenders.
2. During the first half, the Attackers must capture the Spirit Well, then summon and escort a Golden Roc to the destination to destroy a Border Stele. The Defenders must prevent this from happening.
3. In the second half, the teams swap roles and compete again.
Victory Conditions
1. After swapping sides, the targets and allotted time for the second half will be adjusted based on how well Attackers did in the first half.
2. If the second-half attackers can match the first-half progress within a certain time limit, they win; otherwise, it's a tie or loss.
Others
1. When defeated, select a Soul Altar on the map to revive.
2. Once the Spirit Well is captured, two Golden Rocs will appear with different routes. The Attackers only need to escort one of them to the destination.
3. The game will enter overtime if the Attackers are still within range of the Spirit Well or Golden Roc when regular match time expires.
4. Once overtime is up, the game will end immediately.

5. Soul Lantern: Across the map, you will find Soul Lanterns that can be activated to restore your Armor, Health, and Rage. Additionally, they provide a temporary boost to your Attack and Melee Resist. Once a lantern is used, it will go on cooldown.

The new Hungry Dragons mode is now available! Use whatever means you have at your disposal to defeat your opponents and make your dragon the longest one!
You can queue for this mode Solo or as a Trio, but this mode is always a free-for-all, with a maximum of 12 people.
Earn points by collecting Dragon Orbs (EXP items), defeating opponents, leveling up, and attacking opponents' tails.
Attacking tails degrade the level and grants Dragon Scales (Upgrade items).
EXP items provide EXP for leveling up and additional Rage. Reaching a higher level increases your maximum Health and Ultimates' attack range.
Periodic AOE attacks will be triggered by mechanisms in the scene. Use Jump or Crouch to evade as appropriate.
Winning Conditions: Players are ranked based on their total scores at the end of the match.
Small Dragon Orb: +1; Large Dragon Orb: +3
Defeating a player: +15
Attacking the tail once: +5
Each level at the time of settlement: +10
In the event of a tie in final scores, the winner will be determined by comparing the players' Kill Score, Level Score, and Item Score in that order.

Minimum Guarantee:

Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.

Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.

notes.title: III. Nirriti's Ruins (formerly Yama's Abyss) Adjustments

items.text: Nirriti's Ruins now has four difficulty levels: Normal, Hard, Nightscream, and Legend.
In Hard levels, Showdown Souljades that can be obtained in other Hard stages have a chance of dropping.
In Nightscream and Legend levels, any Showdown Souljades can drop, and the drop rates are the same for both difficulties.

Your Souljades, Sense levels, and Potentials will no longer take effect in Nirriti's Ruins, but the bonuses from hero levels will still apply. In addition, you can complete Season Achievements to obtain Fire Forge bonuses for Nirriti's Ruins.

New feature - Nirriti Codex: There is a chance to encounter the Nirriti Codex when completing area quests. The Nirriti Codex can enhance existing Anima Rings, provide new ones, or make the stage content change.

Souljades will no longer be available in Nirriti's Ruins. The effects of some Souljades will appear in the form of Blessings or Anima Rings.

//Dev Note: The skill design for Wuchen has always been a favorite among our team. Wuchen stands out as the only hero with three distinct ultimate abilities. However, we've noticed that Wuchen has a pick rate of just 1.03% in Trios mode, while 0.43% in Duos, and 0.43% in Solo. Among players who picked Wuchen, the skill Spirit Blades is chosen 5.6% of the time, and the ultimate Tai Chi Teleport: Portal is chosen 2.2% of the time. notes.title: I. Introducing an all-new map: Perdoria!

items.text: Seek eternal life in Perdoria.
With the new update, players can now explore our newest map: Perdoria.
Imperium: The Jiling Emperor, who spent his life in battle and unifying the land, moved his meticulously constructed Imperium underground to serve as his mausoleum, where he now rests eternally.
Arcadia: Built by the Jiling Emperor for his favored concubine, a Herald, it served as the place of their love story.
Azoth Peak: A serene and ethereal place where Qi cultivators practice. They pay special attention to cultivating medicine, hoping it will eliminate illness around the world.
Twilight Pass: Originally a remote forbidden area of Vesper Coven, is shrouded in thick miasma. The people here worship ancient gods and follow primitive rules.
Skygaze Cove: Formerly a place where craftsmen resided, it was later turned into a dock for mechanical vessels by Feria Shen's ancestors.

Fortune Lands: Appears randomly in each match and has the same environment as the match. Defeating players within the Fortune Land grants Dark Tide Coins. There are three types of Fortune Lands: Resilience, Rejuvenation, and Soul Revival. They will, respectively, provide automatic Remains recovery, Health and Armor recovery upon defeating players, and an extra rebirth chance. Additionally, a Gold Devourer always appears in Fortune Land, defeating it rewards players with advanced equipment.

Mercury River: Encircles the entire area, with floating piles refreshing periodically. Players can surf on the Mercury River using slide moves. By crouching, players can lurk within the Mercury River, but prolonged hiding will continuously reduce Health. While lurking and equipped with a melee weapon, players can execute enemies using Blue Focus moves.

Lava: Originates at Skygaze Cove and can be partially controlled by the Lava Conductor. Active lava will burn players on contact, reducing their Health. A player who interacts with a Lava Conductor can activate a portion of the lava in Skygaze Cove, making their team temporarily immune to the lava's burning effect. After activating the Lava Conductor is activated for the first time, additional resources will appear on the lava.
Sea Firefly: Striking it releases toxic mist, poisoning nearby players.

Carnivorous Yam: Interacting with it causes the player to be swallowed. While inside, the player is immune to attacks but takes continuous damage and can leave voluntarily. The Carnivorous Yam will eventually spit out the player after some time.
Spring Source: Interacting with it allows the player to play with water within it, continuously restoring Health. Once their Health is full, they will start to recover Armor.

Healing Willow: After interacting with the Healing Willow, a link forms between you and the willow. You continuously restore Health while linked, and gain a large amount of Ranged Resist. The Healing Willow can be connected with multiple players simultaneously.

Charred Wood: When attacked by players, Charred Wood collapses according to the attack direction. Players within range will be dealt damage and become . Falling Charred Wood can also destroy certain kinds of interactive terrain.

Clay Soldier: After interacting, you transform into a Clay Soldier, unable to open your inventory or use items. While in Clay Soldier form, performing an Attack will cause the soldier to unleash a damaging attack with a large range, as well as forcing you out of Clay Soldier form. While in Clay Soldier form, players take normal damage when hit.
Soaring Arm: Approaching it and using the interact button pulls the player to the starting position of a launch action. Players can then adjust the angle to launch themselves for rapid travel.
Celestial Barge: Located in the Skygaze Cove, players can spend Dark Tide Coins to interact with it and fire Celestial Fire at any area of the map.
Each match also guarantees Red Weapons, and Souljades. There are also numerous Easter Eggs waiting to be discovered!

A Justice Chamber's rank is determined by the sum of the points its members accumulate.

Play any feature or participate in group events in the Justice Chamber to earn points.
Points will be settled and reset to 0 at the end of the season. If your Justice Chamber has reached the highest rank (Scorching Justice), you will receive a Hero Badge.

Justice Chambers randomly search for treasures 2 times per week. Once your Justice Chamber has detected treasures, a round of treasure hunting will start, and players will have 24 hours to hunt for treasures.
Each player has 3 chances to hunt for treasures in each round. Any treasure found will be kept in the Justice Chamber.

After each round, every player who participated in that round of treasure hunting can claim all treasures that were found. Only one round of treasures can be kept in the Justice Chamber, so please remember to claim them quickly!

The Celebration has 3 levels, with higher levels offering richer rewards.

Each Celebration lasts 12 minutes and includes 3 rounds of Red Packet Shower and 3 rounds of Songbird Arena Challenge. Participate in the Red Packet Shower and win in the Songbird Arena to earn rewards.
You can get up to 3 Red Packets per round, with a maximum of 27 per week. Any Red Packets exceeding the limit will convert to Justice Chamber Points.
Hosting Celebrations will earn additional Justice Chamber Points and Heroic Coins.

notes.title: I. Preview of the Changes to Souljades Recast

items.text: In future updates, we plan to make changes to the Souljade recasting system (specifics will come in future update notices). Some of the general changes that we intend to make are as follows:
The recasting of Souljades will no longer be restricted by the attributes of the material Souljades.
Instead, Epic and Legendary Souljades will be decomposed into a general material (in different quantities), which can then be used for recasting.
There will be 2 types of recasting: [Attribute Type Recasting] and [Attribute Value Recasting]. Players can choose any attribute on a Souljade and recast its type or its value.
During the new system's initial phase, the old and new recast systems will coexist for a limited time.

We hope that in the upcoming seasons of Showdown, players can have more time to experiment with various Souljade builds with the new recasting system, where we aim to make the process more affordable and reduce the influence of luck, ensuring more promising results from recasting. We hope you can feel more at ease when trying out the new effects from the new Souljade recasting.

This expands the number of graphics cards supported by XeSS, meaning that all graphics cards that can support Shader Model 6.4 can also use XeSS.

notes.title: IV. New Mode: Hot Potato Counter

items.text: Description: Use various techniques to bounce the Hot Potato and defeat the opponent.
Players: 9 for Solo, 6 for Trios
Gameplay

1. The game has multiple rounds. Each round begins with a NARAKA Hot Potato spawning in the center, which starts by tracking a random player and then gains speed as it is struck by players. Being hit by the Hot Potato reduces Health.
2. In Solo mode, players have one Health point per round; in Trios, each player gets two.
3. Win by defeating all opponents or scoring the highest before the round concludes.
1. The Red Hot Potato is coming right for you!
2. Blue Hot Potatoes are friendly. You don't have to dodge them.
3. A Hot Potato will deal damage to anyone in its path. Even a White Hot Potato isn't safe.
4. Use different moves to rebound the Hot Potato faster!
Hot Potatoes struck by enemies/teammates can be struck again to change their trajectory and target.
When a teammate hits a Blue Hot Potato and it's nearby, you can use a charged strike to have it circle your body, then quickly toss the Hot Potato.
1. Vertical strike to pass a Hot Potato to your teammates (Trios Only).
2. Different moves will let you manipulate the speed and direction of the Hot Potato's movement:
· Common Attack - Regular rebound shot
· Focus Strike - Speeds up the Hot Potato a moderate amount
· Counter - Catch the Hot Potato and throw it in a curve to the aimed direction with an extra speed boost.
3. Skills and Souljades - More powerful rebound techniques!
4. Speed boosts from the same move can stack, but hitting the Hot Potato with a different move will reset the speed boost.
There's a chance that Souljades and items will spawn in the Exquisite Vessel:
· Armor - blocks one instance of Hot Potato damage
· Hot Potato·Rampage—hitting the Hot Potato will let you rebound it in a rightward arc with a speed boost

notes.title: I. New Morus' Blessing Combat Item Available: White Tiger's Prowess

items.text: The Heralds believe the mighty White Tiger's appearance to be a symbol of warfare, and that those with its blessing are destined for greatness in battle.

1. Effect Details: Instantly restores a set amount of Health, Armor, and Rage to all allied units, as well as restoring their Health over time (excess Health is restored as Armor). While the owner of White Tiger's Prowess survives, any allied unit will gain a permanent Melee Resist and Ranged Resist boost upon defeating an enemy. Additionally, whenever an ally defeats an enemy, the owner of the White Tiger's Prowess will unleash a shockwave with a range of 40m. Enemies hit by the shockwave will be dealt a percentage of damage to their Health. White Tiger's Prowess lasts for 180 sec.
2. The new item can be acquired from Morus' Blessings across all modes of Realm of Yang as well as during the first and second rounds of Trios Immortal War.

1. Songbird Arena
The Songbird Palace area in Fairyland Penglai has been updated and renamed as Songbird Arena.

Interact with the Arena Monolith to initiate a challenge request to all players on Fairyland Penglai or to specific players. (Challenges to designated players are not limited to being in the same Fairyland Penglai.)
After the player accepts, both parties will be teleported to the Arena for a 1V1 battle!
Other players in the room can spectate and send gifts to support players.
Rules Info
By default, the current hero and weapon used on Fairyland Penglai will be used in the Arena. If you want to change them, please change the displayed heroes and weapons in the lobby.
The player initiating the challenge can set the battle rules, such as the victory conditions, whether to enable the Grappling Hook, and whether to enable skills or ultimates.

"Public Challenge" can challenge all players in the current Fairyland Penglai; "Challenge" can invite the specified player (regardless of their current location), and they will automatically teleport to the current scene upon accepting the invitation.
Navigate to Settings - Social - Fairyland Penglai to customize your preferences for challenge invitations and battle notifications.
Players can only initiate or accept challenges once their account reaches Lv.10 or above.

During the event, explore each of the four chapters' maps to aid the Four Heavenly Kings in finding earthly delicacies.

Upon entering the event for the first time each day and by completing chapter quests of the event, players will receive some of the Action Item [Tasty Buns]. Consuming [Tasty Buns] enables players to explore the event maps. [Tasty Buns] can also be obtained through the [Splendid Spring] event.
Players can use [Heavenly Orders] to instantly complete a chapter quest. [Heavenly Orders] can be obtained through the [New Year Roll Call] event.
Each chapter features two Objectives. Upon successful exploration, players can unlock chapter Rewards.
In addition to chapter rewards, each chapter also offers other rewards for exploration. Remember to explore areas beyond the Objective Points for additional rewards.
After the event comes to an end, all remaining [Tasty Buns] can be redeemed into the same amount of Spectral Silk on the event page.

Event Duration: Feb 7, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 6, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
During the event, players can use Dragon Ingots to open exclusive Four Heavenly Kings Red Packets. Opening these Red Packets can yield a variety of great rewards.

Players can acquire Dragon Ingots by opening Stashes in the Survival Modes, joining in Heroes Assemble during the event time (will be available on Feb 22, 2024 at 03:00 UTC) or by visiting the Shop - Gift and redeeming Fragrant Jade for the Ingots.
The event runs for one round per week, four rounds in total. At the start of each round, the number of obtainable Four Heavenly Kings Red Packets and Dragon Ingots will be refreshed.
After the event comes to an end, players can still draw prizes until Mar 10, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC), but can no longer get Dragon Ingots.
