notes.title: I. Adjustments to the rules for calculating Hero Scores

items.text: We have adjusted the rules for calculating Hero Scores to enhance the impact of the Immortal War on these scores. Here are the specifics:

Upon completing a ranked mode or an Immortal War match, your Hero Score will be adjusted based on your performance and the current Rank Score. However, once you surpass the specified , the difficulty of earning Hero Scores will significantly increase.

: The base threshold equals to the current Rank Score, capped at a maximum of 7,500 points. In Immortal War, the threshold will be raised, with the increased ratio calculated as (highest score across various modes of Immortal War - 3,000)/8,000. For instance, suppose your score in Ranked Mode (Solo) stands at 1,000 points, and your peak score across various modes of the Immortal War is 5,000 points. In that case, when you engage in a solo Ranked Mode, the threshold for your Hero Score would be calculated as follows: 1,000 x (1+ (5,000 -3,000)/8,000).

items.text: The number of available levels in Yama's Abyss has been increased to 45, accompanied by a new challenge: the Yama's Abyss Leaderboard, a part of the Showdown Leaderboards.

In Yama's Abyss, reaching higher levels, trying different heroes, and completing stages with greater speed will help you rise to the top of the leaderboards and earn rare titles and Hero Badge rewards.
1. The leaderboards are separated into Solos and Trios. Getting records in different modes will be registered on the respective leaderboard.
2. We hope that each hero will shine on the leaderboards. For this reason, each hero will have their own leaderboard for Yama's Abyss.
3. After leaderboards open, completing a stage will create a record. Data from before leaderboards are opened will not be recorded.

4. Leaderboards will consider both the stage reached and the time taken, reaching higher stages will increase your rank; when there is a tie in stage reached, ranking will occur by the time taken, down to the second. If there is still a tie, then the player who created the record first will be given a higher rank.

After the settlement of the season's final week, the top 3 players will also receive a unique Hero Badge, with only 1 Hero Badge per player based on their highest rank.

At the same time, we will also optimize the Speedrun Leaderboard: The Speedrun Leaderboard will also be separated by Hero. We hope that this will let everyone use their favorite hero to get the appropriate glory.

I. Showdown Season 1.0: Chasm

Seasons have now been introduced in Showdown mode: After each Showdown season ends, all levels and the base Sense Level of Heroes will change. Also, the Potential progress and content will be reset. Showdown Season 1.0: Chasm will end on March 7, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC).

//Dev Notes: The idea behind switching to a season system is based on the gap that has emerged between experienced players and newer players in Showdown. Seasons will let us keep a stream of new rewards and fresh stages, while also making necessary changes to various stages and minimum/maximum sense levels. Furthermore, it will allow newer players to integrate into the Showdown community without feeling a large gap with more experienced players.
1. New Gameplay: Yama's Abyss

This is a brand new roguelike iteration of Showdown Mode. In Yama's Abyss, all players start on equal footing, taking on an unlimited number of random stages. Players can obtain a wide variety of temporary enhancements to strengthen themselves as levels get progressively more challenging.

When playing Yama's Abyss, Souljades that you have equipped will not initially appear in your Souljade Bag, but instead will randomly appear in the in-game Rift Dealer. Explore Yama's Abyss, discover various enhancements, and challenge countless random levels!

Advancing through the tiers of Yama's Abyss and increasing your rank in the Showdown Season will earn you valuable rewards, including the Regular Treasure Choice Gift and the Rank Avatar. At the end of each Showdown Season, both your rank and rewards progress will be reset.
2. New Boss: Omnius·Vortex
Water, is the source of all things, the fountain of countless changes.
Take on the ferocious beasts of Omnius and 3 new levels at the Shipwreck Expanse on the Morus Isle.
3. New Hero Introduced in the Mode: Feria Shen
Pilot her Bronze Mech and obliterate all enemies that stand in your way!
4. Potential System and Huge selection of new Showdown Souljades

There is a brand new Potential System where you can play Showdown mode to get Potential XP and Potential Points. Level up your Potential and build your Souljades to create your own play style in Showdown.
The progress of the Potential System will be reset at the start of every Showdown Season, offering a fresh battle experience with new content and challenges.
5. Fatigue system
After this update, Showdown will be available at all times and will have a new Fatigue system.

By playing a stage of Showdown, Showdown Souljades, Quench Crystals, and other items can be obtained as drops. At the same time, Fatigue will increase up to a maximum of 2,000. While below the first threshold of Fatigue, drops will be increased by 150%. Each time that Fatigue passes a threshold, in-game drops will decrease. Fatigue will reset to 0 every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).
(Showdown Scroll items will expire after the update, and there will be no way to use or acquire them again)

Newly added Legendary Weapon Skins [Calamity Forge·Blade], , etc. and Enhancement Items.

Upgrade your Showdown Pass to claim plentiful rewards.

Tons of Showdown Seals, Rebirth Beads, Enhancement Materials, and other rewards in the Showdown Pass are claimable; Unlock the Legendary Weapon Skin [Chasm Vortex·Surging], Martial Skill Cosmetic [Severing Gust·Plum], [Fang Severing Slash·Ocher] and bottomless exclusive rewards!

Event Rules: Players can get Aqua Pearls by completing quests during the event. Aqua Pearls can be redeemed for great event rewards.
Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.

I. Zai
Added a flash cue for the Gold Focus move of the Ultimate Weapon [Chain Scythe].
Optimized the special effects of the third Horizontal and Vertical Strikes of the [Chain Scythe].
II. Hadi
Enabled the mechanism for Hadi to counter while in flight.
Optimized the hit performance of the Charged Attack during flight.
Optimized the sound effect during flight.

Optimized the damage calculation mechanism that exits flight status upon accumulating certain damage during flight. Now, the damage dealt by Armor Pierce is properly included, while the damage dealt by Shadow Corruption is not included.

//Dev Notes: Hadi has a unique flight mechanism, adding new experiences and challenges to the battlefield. We'll continue to monitor the players' evolving control and strength performances. Hadi can now counter while in flight, with the same effect as his 3rd stage of charged attack. We hope these adjustments will introduce more tactics and variations in battles between Hadi and other heroes.
I. General Souljades
Newly added Souljade (Consumable) [Vajra's Grip]: When being Countered, restore some Health and your weapon will not drop.
I. Feature Optimizations
Now, using emotes and gestures immediately can interrupt an ongoing emote or gesture.
Optimized the perspective view selection mechanism when the spectator is the last team member eliminated and all their teammates are in the Remains.

Optimized the transition mechanism between the hero selection screen, spawn point selection screen, and map screen during the preparation phase. You can now quickly switch to the corresponding screen by pressing the respective keys on each above-mentioned screen.
II. Bot Mode Adjustments
Optimized AI Counter use at each difficulty level.
Hard difficulty AIs have received differentiated playstyles, AIs with different playstyles will behave differently in combat.
III. Controller Adjustments
During the preparation phase, press L1 + Touchpad (PS) / LB + View Button (XBOX) to view hero skill descriptions in the hero selection screen.
I. Added Scoring System in Casual Mode
Added scores to Shadow Surge, Capture the Spirit Well, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport modes. The scoring system is added only to reflect your proficiency in these modes.
The initial score is 1,000, with each 500-point increment moving up a tier, up to a maximum of 9 tiers.
Scores will be reset proportionally at the season update.
II. Personal Information
Your scoring stats are now included in the Casual Mode.

Showdown Mode will now have Yama's Abyss Rank information. Starting from Showdown Season 1.0, related stats will be collected in accordance with the new Showdown Season format. Previous stats will temporarily not be visible.
III. Rank

Added a Mastery Leaderboard to reflect your proficiency in different modes, ranking based on Casual Mode scores in the following four modes: Shadow Surge, Capture the Spirit Well, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport.
Added a Collection Leaderboard, ranking based on Collection Points.
IV. Hero Badge
Added the expanded stages for several Hero Badges, including [Morus Legends], [Divine Treasures], and [Admirable Collection].
V. Star - Collections System
Viper Ning exclusive Star Collection Outfit[Star - 2P] will be tradable after 04:00 (UTC) on November 30, 2023. It can be traded on the Steam Community Market.
VI. Fairyland Penglai
Players can now teleport to the Fairyland Penglais of players that they are not friends with.
I. Combat Adjustments
Shortened the rebirth and revival time in all Showdown gameplay.
Now, monsters with Astral Aegis won't roll to get up after being downed.
Optimized some combat effects.
II. Souljade Adjustments

1. Removed the Rage recovery effect from additional hits of Souljades, such as [Stormstride Sword], [Thunder Sword], and [Ice Bomb], while increasing the damage multipliers in certain strikes. Specific adjustments are as follows:
[Draco Stride]: Increased the damage multiplier of the wave from 0.6 to 0.72;
: Increased the damage multiplier of the icicle from 0.75 to 1.0;
: Increased the damage multiplier of the lightning strike from 1.5 to 1.6;
[Stormstride Sword]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunderbolt from 0.25 to 0.27;
[Thunder Sword]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunderbolt from 0.2 to 0.24;
[Frost Cannon]: Increased the damage multiplier of Frost Wind from 0.11*6 to 0.13*6;
[Ice Bomb] Increased the damage multiplier of Frost Wind from 0.08*5 to 0.1*5;
[Thunder Cannon]: Increased the damage multiplier of the electric sparks from 0.4 to 0.5;
[Thunder Shot]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunder from 0.17*2 to 0.21*2.

//Dev Notes: With the new Souljades and Potential System, hits beyond weapon moves provided excessive Rage. Therefore, in the new version, we have removed Rage recovery effects from these hits. To maintain the strength of relevant Souljades, we have increased their damage multipliers.
Reduced the speed at which damage dealt increases Thundershock for oneself at low Thunder-wielding levels.
3. [Jabbing·Ice-wielding]
Increased the Damage Multiplier from 4.29 to 5.21.
4. [Defuse·Solve (Counterattack)], [Defuse·Combo (Counterattack)], and [Defuse·Dash (Counterattack)]
The method of filling the Defuse slot changed from "dealing damage with uncharged attacks" to "dealing damage with melee attacks or triggering the Defuse".
III. Elemental Effect Adjustments
Removed the Rage recovery effect from element-triggered hits.
Reduced the accumulation speed of elemental effects by 48%.

//Dev Notes: The Potentials in the new season will bring in a lot of gameplay and enhancements around elemental effects. Therefore, we have lowered the frequency of triggering elemental effects, hoping that the rising elemental mechanic in current gameplay won't become the only solution in the version.
The cooldown for accumulating elemental effect points after monsters trigger elemental effects has changed from a 2-second team-shared cooldown to a 6-second individual cooldown.

//Dev Notes: In the previous version, triggering an elemental effect on a monster paused the entire team's elemental accumulation on that monster for 2 seconds. In the new version, only the player who triggers the elemental effect will pause their own elemental accumulation on the monster. This pause will no longer be affected by your teammates, therefore allowing more control over your triggering time.
IV. Hero Adjustments
1. Viper Ning
The Damage Multiplier of skill [Yushan Strike: Showdown] has increased from 1 to 9, with Aegis-break ability increased from 2,200 to 3,150.
The Aegis-break ability of Ultimate [Moonbane Control: Showdown] has increased from 9,500 to 11,000.
2. Tarka Ji
The Damage Multiplier of the fireball in the skill [Flame Force: Showdown] has increased from 4 to 5, with Aegis-break ability increased from 400 to 500.
The Rage consumption ratio of a single fireball in Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Showdown] has reduced from 8% to 6.5%.
3. Valda Cui

The Aegis-break ability of the Horizontal Strike water spear in Ultimate [Rising Tide: Showdown] has increased from 200 to 1,200, with the Damage Multiplier of the Vertical Strike water spear increased from 3 to 5.

Aegis-break Martial Skill [Severing Gust] can now be unleashed by using a horizontal strike after a charged strike.

The total Damage Multiplier of Ultimate [Zephyr Wisp: Showdown] is increased from 1.35 to 4.2, with Aegis-break ability increased from 1,350 to 4,200.
6. Yueshan
The duration of enemy Attack reduction in skill [Scorching Dash: Showdown] has increased from 6 sec to 8 sec.
7. Tianhai
Skill [Divine Bell: Showdown] grants 50% damage reduction to self for 8 sec upon release.
V. Omens Adjustments
Monsters with Omen can now use Blue Focus moves more frequently and will lose more Astral Aegis when hit by a counter.
Adjustments to Frostbite accumulation caused by some Frostbite Omens:
[Ice Blast]: Frostbite accumulation for each explosion has increased from 100 to 320;
[Frozen Earth]: Frostbite accumulation per sec has increased from 200 to 300;
VI. Anima Ring Collections

VIII. Souljade Recasting Adjustments

The chance of getting an extra attribute when recasting a Souljade will increase with each recast that has not yielded an extra attribute. A Souljade that has not reached its attribute limit is guaranteed an extra attribute after 50 recasts.

//Dev Notes: Enhancement of Souljades is an important part of Showdown Mode. To deal with cases where it is difficult to acquire rare attributes, we will continue to carry out optimizations in future updates.
IX. Sense Level Adjustments
The minimum recommended Sense Level and the minimum Sense Level of dropped Souljades have increased to 450. The maximum Sense Level for a single Season has been increased to 680.
X. Other Changes

Now, you must clear specific levels before you can unlock and obtain the corresponding Souljades through Souljade conversion and the new Souljade Choice Gifts. Previous Souljade Choice Gifts are not subject to this change.

I. New Hero: Hadi Ismail, The Visionary

Hadi refused to yield to adversity. Tragedy and misfortune, instead of breaking him, steeled his determination to shape his own destiny. His unwavering commitment to pursuing knowledge and self-improvement was the path he followed to hold fast to his fate...

(Hadi's third skill variant and third ultimate variant will be made available in future updates. Once they are, complete the corresponding Cultivation Quests to unlock them. They will automatically unlock for players that have already completed the corresponding Cultivation Quests.)

Kurumi, Yueshan and Matari convened outside the capital city of Chang'an. A meeting of three great minds under the moon to revel in poetry.
Event Duration: From after the November 16, 2023 update is complete until January 31, 2024 at 16:00 (UTC).

Play the minigame "Journey with Tang Poetry" to win rewards like Regular Treasure Choice Gift and Exclusive Avatar!
IV. Limited-time Event: Rise of Heroes
Here is where the heroes gather and rise. The 2023 J Cup is about to kick off, with top players from all five regions competing for the ultimate honor.

Participate in the limited-time event Zenith Clash to obtain Martial Jadestones, which can be redeemed for amazing custom rewards. Join the platform's spectator and tournament prediction events to earn a ton of Martial Jadestones.

Participate in the limited-time event Glory of the Past Offers to purchase previous world Champions' custom cosmetics in bulk and get additional exclusive event discounts. Collect enough cosmetics to claim exclusive item rewards.
Participate in the limited-time event Player Support, and help the supported team complete quests to receive team-exclusive custom Tattoos.

Event Duration: From the November 16th, 2023 update to Feburary 1st, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC).
When opening Pioneer Treasures, there's a chance to obtain the Extreme Longsword Skin [Star - Florescent Cryolite] and the Legendary Tianhai Outfit [Star - Variance].
How to obtain: Each time you open a Pioneer Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you obtain more Legendaries. The maximum chance is 100%.
The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Florescent Cryolite] and 2 [Star - Variance].
The number of Star-Collections granted through the Pioneer Treasure is limited and available while stocks last.

You can now enable cosmetic set rotation for every Hero individually.

On the Hero cosmetics interface, tap Rotation Settings to choose the sets to include in the rotation and the rotation rules. After saving, you can check the option to enable it. You may choose between Random Rotation or Sequential Rotation.
Once the set rotation feature is enabled, each time you enter the game, a set will automatically be selected for you according to the rotation rules.
This feature does not work in training mode.

With the 2023 J Cup approaching, players from the five regions that have advanced to the J Cup will have a verified 2023JCUP player label added to their accounts. We look forward to seeing everyone shine in the J Cup.

I. Yoto Hime

1. Changed the Defense Focus during the startup frames of [Flying Edge: Callback] to a Blue Focus. Increased the Demonic Blade's hover time from 5 sec to 9 sec, and enhanced the horizontal strike's 2nd stage pull performance.
2. Adjusted initial Ultimate Talent [Demon Blade]

(1) Canceled the mechanism of "increasing Attack based on the number of nearby Remains". Yoto Hime's Ultimate Attack is now increased based on the number of living enemies within a 10m radius at each flash or strike. The corresponding relationship is as follows:
≤1 Enemies = 0% Ultimate Attack Increase
2 Enemies = 20% Ultimate Attack Increase
3 Enemies = 40% Ultimate Attack Increase
4 Enemies = 50% Ultimate Attack Increase
≥5 Enemies = 55% Ultimate Attack Increase
(2) Increased Attack remains consistent throughout the Ultimate duration and lasts until the Ultimate ends.

//Dev Note: The previous conditions for [Demon Blade] were a bit harsh in real combat as it was difficult to ensure the presence of Remains in every scenario. Therefore, we adjusted it to have a more common trigger condition. We also distributed the trigger chances to every flash or strike, providing more gameplay options during actual combat.
II. Wuchen

Adjusted the calculation formula of reducing enemy weapon's durability for the [Spirit Blades] Skill during a Clash from a fixed value to 34% of the weapon's max durability, ensuring a consistent reduction across different weapon qualities.
Optimized the experience of casting the [Spirit Blades: Autotrack] Skill in the air. The recovery frame stagger can now be interrupted in advance with a Dodge or plummet strike.

Increased the interaction radius of the Portal from 2m to 4m.

Added Consumable and Upgradable Souljades to the current Souljade System, expanding the possibilities in battles.

1. Some Souljades have changed into Consumable Souljades.

1. Some Souljades have changed into Upgradable Souljades.
On top of inherent effects, completing certain quests will grant extra combat effect. By combining Souljades, the issue where the Souljade Bag was often short of storage has been alleviated.

Nunchucks Souljade [Trigger & Lock Breaker]: Using Horizontal Block no longer consumes Biding Fury and triggers when hit by ranged attacks. After triggering the Horizontal Block of Nunchucks twice, gains new attributes: Alters the Horizontal Block Backfire.

Spear Souljade [Erudition & Spear Storm]: Alters the Spear's charged vertical strikes. After hitting enemies 8 times with the Spear's charged vertical strikes, gains new attributes: Alters the 3rd vertical strike in the Spear combo.

Greatsword Souljade [Warrior Pace & Infernal Slash]: Increases move speed while charging up a horizontal strike with Greatsword. After hitting enemies with the Greatsword's charged horizontal strikes 4 times, gains new attributes: Alters the Greatsword's 1st- and 2nd-stage charged horizontal strikes.

Repeating Crossbow Souljade [Venom Tip & Barbed Bolts]: The Repeating Crossbow deals less damage but poisons enemies hit, dealing damage over time. After hitting enemies with the Repeating Crossbow 20 times, gains new attributes: Landing a shot on an enemy with the Repeating Crossbow leaves them unable to sprint for 1 sec.

[Curative Bolts & Healing Bolts]: The Repeating Crossbow's shots restore 40% of the damage dealt as Health or Armor. After hitting enemies with the Repeating Crossbow 20 times, gains new attributes: Allows you to heal teammates by shooting them with the Repeating Crossbow.

Bow Souljade [Fire Arrows & Target Lock]: Arrows fired in the Bow's 2nd charge state deal less damage but can ignite enemies, dealing damage over time. After hitting an enemy with the Bow 5 times, gains new attributes: Shooting enemies with the Bow leaves them unable to sprint or dodge for 3 sec. Attacks on the same enemy can only trigger this once per 15 sec.

Cannon Souljade [Twinshot & Bounce Shell]: The Cannon deals less damage but fires 2 projectiles with each shot. After hitting enemies with the Cannon 8 times, gains new attributes: Cannon shots can bounce twice, and automatically explode with increased damage when near enemies.

[Rupture Gale Orb & Burn]: Increases the explosion radius of the Cannon's shots. After hitting enemies with the Cannon 8 times, gains new attributes: Cannon shots burn enemies, dealing damage over time.

Pistol Souljade [Quick Charge & Thundercall]: Reduces charged Pistol shots' damage, but allows you to load up to two shots at a time and the charging will be muted. After hitting enemies with the Pistol 20 times, gains new attributes: Charged Pistol shots fire with larger explosion range and higher damage.

Musket Souljade [Slowshot & Sunwing Shot]: Increases the intervals between and the damage of the Musket's aimed shots. After hitting enemies with the Musket 5 times, gains new attributes: Musket shots' bullet velocity is greatly increased.

[Soft Step & Gecko Foot]: Silences the sound of your footsteps. After traveling 500m, gains new attributes: Increased speed when running up walls and increased Scale Rush damage. After staying still for 5 sec while climbing, you will enter Stealth for 15 sec or until you move again.
[Ripple Step & Phantom Step]: Dodging while sprinting briefly provides Stealth. After dealing 2,500 damage, gains new attributes: The 1st-stage Dodge briefly provides Stealth.

[Assault·Smolder]: Burns enemies hit with melee weapon's Grappling Strikes, dealing damage over time. After hitting enemies 8 times with Grappling Strikes, gains new attributes: Increased Grappling Strike damage.

[Switch·Dazzle]: Switching to a ranged weapon while carrying out a melee attack unleashes a special move (Morus' Blessing weapons excluded). After hitting enemies with Switch·Dazzle 3 times, gains new attributes: Switching between a ranged and a melee weapon increases Attack by 15% for 3 sec.

[Soothing Boon]: There's a 25% chance that Weapon Repair Kits, Grappling Hooks, Healing Berries or Armor Powder won't deplete after use. After dealing 2,500 damage, gains new attributes: The chance that Weapon Repair Kits and Grappling Hooks won't deplete after use is increased to 40%.

1. HDR Function

HDR is a technology that improves the brightness and contrast of an image. It improves detail levels in dark places, making them seem darker, and provides a greater variety of colors, improving the visibility of the gaming screen.
* Turning on HDR requires a monitor that supports HDR. To turn on HDR, open Windows System Settings - Screen - Use HDR. Some monitors also need to additionally turn on the HDR.
2. Intel XeSS

Intel Xe Super Sampling (XeSS) technology is a new image amplification technology based on AI deep learning which supports high performance and high fidelity visuals. It uses deep learning to synthesize images that are very close to the quality of native high-resolution rendering, which can dramatically improve game performance and ensure excellent image quality.
3. DLSS 3

DLSS is a revolutionary breakthrough in AI-powered graphics that multiplies performance. DLSS 3 is powered by the new fourth-generation Tensor Core and optical flow accelerators on GeForce RTX 40-series Gpus, which can use AI to generate more frames and improve image quality.
4. At present, D3D12 is still in testing
Its functions and performance are still under continuous optimization:
(1) At present, only some graphics cards can open the D3D12 test version.

items.text: The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep 6th, 2023 23:00 (UTC) to Sep 7th, 2023 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
I. Capture the Spirit Well
Introducing a brand-new map area for Capture the Spirit Well: Celestra.
The map rotation between the new area, Celestra, and the existing area, Plumed Castle, will occur every hour.
New combat items have been added for Capture the Spirit Well: use Charms to cast ploys and to secure victory.
Ploy Charm·Ballista: Summons a Ballista at the current location. (Only accessible for allies. Projectiles will be cleared out once used.)
Ploy Charm·Forbidden Seal: Summons a Forbidden Seal at the current location. (Only affects your enemies.)
Ploy Charm·Rift: Summons an Enigmatic Rift that connects a location in a valid area and the current location. (Only accessible for your allies.)
Ploy Charm·Banish: After a warning, teleports enemies in the selected area to their Spawn Point.
Ploy Charm·Reclaim: Changes the status of a selected Spirit Well to be uncaptured.
Ploy Charm·Detect: Detects enemies in the selected area.
II. Tessa's new Skill [Tail Strike: Repel] and Ultimate [Enchant: Group Prey] are now available
Skill [Tail Strike: Repel]: Tessa unleashes her fox tail and summons a Tailglow Zone in the aimed direction that lasts 6 sec.
Summons a fox tail upon an ally entering the zone, knocking nearby enemies in the air while gaining for 5 sec.
Ultimate [Enchant: Group Prey]: Tessa summons the fox spirit that unleashes a shockwave and snatches all enemies' souls within 10m, storing them in a Soul Vessel.
Enemies who fail to retrieve their soul by interacting with the Soul Vessel within 6 sec will be for 3 sec.
It costs only 50% of the Rage if no souls are snatched.

If the shockwave hits an enemy, Tessa will gradually restore Health in 6 sec (exceeded amount will turn into Armor). Each enemy hit by the shockwave increases the Health recovery by 100% (up to 300%).
III. Solo mode is now available in Showdown
Now you can select in the stage selection page of Showdown mode to challenge Showdown alone. Monsters will be weakened for solo gameplay, and all rewards remain the same.
You can play solo mode in all levels, including Emerald and Topaz Enigma Domain. But it's temporarily unavailable in Doom levels and Enigma Peak.
IV. Clash League
Info
Available Time: From Sep 6, 2023, 20:00 to Sep 26, 2023, 04:00 (UTC).
NA Server: 00:00 - 04:00 (UTC) every day
EU Server: 18:00 - 22:00 (UTC) every day
AS Server: 11:00 - 15:00 (UTC) every day
SEA Server: 12:00 - 16:00 (UTC) every day
Rules: Same as Capture the Spirit Well. For details, please check the rules of Capture the Spirit Well mode.
Check the June 29th patch notes here.
Requirement: Join a Justice Chamber and form a party of 3/6/9/12 with Justice Chamber members in the Justice Rally Room.

Stages: There are three stages: preliminary, semifinal, and final. Each round of competition starts from the preliminary stage and ends when you fail to advance or win the final stage. Winning a single match will advance you to the next stage. You can play unlimited rounds of competition while it is available. The preliminary and semifinal stages are played on the Plumed Castle map, and the final stage is set on the Celestra map.
Advancing to the final stage: Hero Badges.
Winning in the final stage: Hero Badges, preparation-stage special effects and titles.
Scoring

You get different points for victory/draw/defeat in each stage: 20/15/10 points respectively in the preliminary stage 30/20/15 points respectively in the semifinal stage, and 40/30/20 points respectively in the final stage.
A Justice Chamber's total score is the sum of all players' single-match scores in that Justice Chamber.
Clash League Leaderboard
Clash League Leaderboard is ranked based on Justice Chamber Total Score
(Clash League is not yet available for Xbox One players due to the console features.)
V. Limited-time Event: Refreshing Equinox
Autumnal winds arrive to whisk away clouds, as crisp leaves fall in unison.
Players can obtain Equinox Coins by completing daily and event quests. Equinox Coins can be exchanged for rare rewards.

Challenge Quests include Event-Only Quests (completed in Clash League matches) and Showdown Exclusive Quests (completed in Showdown mode). Clash League quests are unavailable for Xbox players. Xbox players can complete the corresponding event-only quests through Ranked Mode, Quick Match, Bot Mode and Casual Mode with the same amount of Equinox Coins as rewards.
I. Justina Gu
Adjusted Justina Gu's Freeze threshold for transformed enemies with all her Ultimate Talents. The threshold is changed from (1.5x Attack + 90) to (5x Attack + 10).
Modified the freezing conditions of against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith]. Now, can freeze all transformed enemies who are not currently using skills.
Increased the attack Focus level of Shadowswipe against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], allowing it to stagger transformed enemies who are not using skills.
During the recovery frames of [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], an additional 0.3 sec of Ultimate Focus and 70% Damage Reduction have been added.
Increased the duration of freezing effects against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard] and [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind]. The duration is now 3 sec, up from 1.6 sec.
Reduced the startup frames of [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind] to a unified 1.5 sec.

//Dev Notes: Due to changes in the game environment, Justina Gu's Ultimate had poor performance when facing transformed enemies, making her susceptible to counterplay. Therefore, we've adjusted her gameplay interaction with transformed enemies.

I. New Hero: Tessa, The Vixen
Sultry but deadly, don't let those tails fool you. Many have fallen prey to her beguiling charms.
A young Herald sharing her soul with an ancient fox spirit, Tessa uses charm and trickery to manipulate any and all into doing her bidding.

She wields sensuality and wit like weapons, weaving a web of pleasure to ensnare her prey. Though her love might feel genuine, the targets of her affection are little more than pawns in her quest to revive the fallen god Sunwing.

The third skill and ultimate are not yet available in this version. Once available, you can complete heroes' Cultivation Quests to unlock them. If you've completed the required Cultivation Quests before upcoming updates, the skill and ultimate will be unlocked automatically.
II. New Mechanism: Congeneric Skill
New Mechanism: Congeneric Skill of Greatsword and Polesword is now available.
Equip both Greatsword and Polesword in the weapon slots;
While performing an attack move with Greatsword or Polesword, you can switch between primary and secondary weapons to execute the resonated move, which enables subsequent "Congeneric Skill".
III. Fight with Tenacity (Newbie Protection)
Players below Lv. 20 (this standard will be adjusted according to actual performance in battle) will gain the Tenacity effect in Quick Matches.
An extra Rebirth (each player can have 2 Rebirth chances until the Shadow Corruption's first advance).
+25% damage reduction.

"Everything that lives is designed to end.

in a never-ending spiral of life and death."

Once you begin exploring a selected chapter, you cannot switch to other chapters on the same day nor complete quests in other chapters. However, you can still claim rewards for completed quests from other chapters. Changing chapters do not change your current quest progress.
Complete all chapter quests to claim the Crossover-Themed Longsword Legendary Skin: [Replicant ·Moonrise].

Pod-24 has hacked into your friend list, you may sometimes receive messages or rewards from it.

Event Time: From Aug 10th, 2023 Update to Nov 16th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC)
When opening Mythic Treasures, there is a chance to receive the Extreme Outfit, Star - Nine Tailed Destiny and the Legendary Outfit, Star - 2P.

[Star - Nine Tailed Destiny]: There is a chance to get this outfit when obtaining an Extreme cosmetic from Mythic Treasures. Your chances increase as you obtain more Extremes, up to a maximum of 100%.
[Star - 2P]: There is a chance to get this outfit when obtaining a Legendary cosmetic from Mythic Treasures. Your chances increase as you obtain more Legendaries, up to a maximum of 100%.
After you have obtained the Star-Collections listed above, your increased chances will reset to their original level.
The number of Star-Collections that can be obtained from Mythic Treasures is limited.
[Star-Nine Tailed Destiny] has four Constellations that are , [Fox Tail], [Dress Pattern], and [Divine Fox].
[Star - 2P] has no Constellation and cannot be restyled.
Each Star-Collection has its own unique 6-digit code, determined at intervals of 50 by the time at which it was claimed.
It means that the first 50 to claim theirs will have codes (randomly) ranging from 000001-000050, the next 50 from 000051-000100, and so on.
This is not applicable for Star-Collections before this updates, which means the identifier of [Star - Wolf King's Fang] and [Star-Dragon's Bane] remain the same.
For more detailed information on these particular Star-Collection Bonus Gifts please see our FAQ: https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230808/35280_1103467.html.
I. Kurumi
Optimized the [Healing Ray] skill and its Talents, altering the logic it uses to choose a link target.
If there's an ally in the direction aimed, it links to them.
If not, it links instead to the nearest ally within 30m (prioritizing heroes and Remains, then Light Parasols).
In the event there are no allies, and no others to link within 30m, a Light Parasol is summoned in the direction aimed instead.
Optimized the skill [Healing Ray] and all its talent moves.
(1) Slightly increased the attack range of the Horizontal Strike after connecting the target.
(2) The Horizontal Strike after connecting the target now provides 100% damage reduction instead of 70%. During the recovery frames, the damage reduction is 0.

While the healing circle of Ultimates [Purified Circle] or [Purified Circle: Armor] is active, you can recast it by unleashing the Ultimate again. The new circle inherits the old one's remaining time and elemental effects.
The Ultimate [Purified Circle: Rapid] now launches a knock-airborne attack on nearby enemies.

//Dev Note: Kurumi possesses strong rescue and protection capabilities, but her survivability has been slightly lacking through each version update. Therefore, we have adjusted the difficulty of using [Healing Ray] and added additional effects to [Purified Circle] to lower the entry barrier for Kurumi and enhance her survivability.
II. Temulch
Improved the operation experience of all [Zephyr Wisp] skill branches:

Jump optimization: slightly increased the jumping height. Now the character's speed when activating the skill will be reset, ensuring consistent jumping height. During the jump phase, you can control the character's movement with directional buttons.
Changed the status during the jump from Blue Focus to Golden Focus.

//Dev Notes: The ability to perform horizontal movement during the jump phase significantly enhances Temulch's mobility. We hope this change addresses the issue of Temulch being easily interrupted by the Uppercut Slash move after skill activation and jumping.
III. Tarka Ji
After activating the Ultimate, Tarka Ji's 2nd-stage dodge (elbow strike) attack can interrupt higher Focus. Now it can interrupt enemies' Purple Focus Strikes.
The damage multiplier for the skill [Flame Force: Fireball] has been adjusted from 2.0 to 2.2.
Tarka Ji now expends 8.5% instead of 9% Rage to cast [Flame Force: Fireball] while [Fire Frenzy: Reload] is in effect.
IV. Valda Cui
The bubble duration of skill [Water Trap: Trinity] has been adjusted from 4 sec to 2.5 sec.
Added a 3-sec CD after throwing the water spear during the Ultimate [Rising Tide: Unchained], preventing consecutive spear throws.

//Dev Notes: Consecutive spear throws with continuous Focus have provided Valda with strong defensive advantages and exerted immense pressure on opponents during gameplay. To balance her offensive and defensive capabilities, we have introduced a CD for consecutive spear throws.
V. Zai
All talents of the skill [Flame Ward] and itself will now exit the [Flame Ward] state when affected by Control effects.
Adjusted the rush action for [Flame Ward] and [Flame Ward: Ignition] to rush toward the aiming direction.
Adjustments to the attack moves of [Chain Scythe] after activating the Ultimate:
Changed the Focus level for the second hit of Horizontal and Vertical Strikes from Golden Focus to Purple Focus.
Increased gravity during Airborne Horizontal Strikes.
The charged move [Chain Link: Suppress] can no longer knock enemies airborne.
Updated the skill description for the Ultimate [Chain Scythe: Afflict].

//Dev Notes: Zai's continuous Horizontal Strikes with [Chain Scythe] made it difficult for opponents to counter, and her Airborne Horizontal Strike mechanism granted her additional survivability and damage output. We have adjusted the performance of the [Chain Scythe] moves to address these issues. Additionally, Zai's ability to continue using [Flame Ward] even under Control effects made it challenging for Control-based Heroes to time their actions correctly when facing Zai. Thus, we have revised the interruption conditions to reduce Zai's margin for error.
VI. Wuchen

Optimized the placement of Yin Yang Orbs for Wuchen's Ultimates [Tai Chi Teleport] and [Tai Chi Teleport: Switch], as well as the selection of the aiming point for [Tai Chi Teleport: Portal], reducing potential issues and camera blocking to ensure accurate targeting.
I. General Adjustments for Melee Weapons
Added a grappling button buffer during the execution of the Uppercut Slash move.

//Dev Notes: Combining Uppercut Slash, grappling, and Blink Strike with the Katana or Uppercut Slash, grappling, and Decimator with Dual Halberds is fascinating gameplay. However, the use of the grappling hook mid-combo was leading to combo failures more than we would like due to timing issues. To address this, we have introduced a grappling button buffer during the execution of the Uppercut Slash move, ensuring that you can perform the combo without grappling prematurely. With this input buffer, we hope that more of you will be encouraged to explore and enjoy these combos.

I. New Lobby- Fairyland Penglai

Following the Heroes' victory over Omnius, the Psylith people escaped and launched their retaliation. Under critical circumstances, the Fervent disciples transported the Heroes from the Morus Isle to the floating island of Fairyland Penglai.

The lobby has been upgraded to a brand-new interactive scene—Fairyland Penglai! Embark on a journey in Fairyland Penglai, where you'll meet different Heroes or even dance together. Compete in Sky-high Racing, take photos, and create memories. You can even team up and battle on the Morus Isle.
(After the update, log in to the game lobby and press if you're using mouse and keyboard or if using a controller to enter Fairyland Penglai.)
1. Interactions
Instrumental Performance: You can play four types of instruments, which are , [Er-hu], , and . You may perform solo or as part of an ensemble, and do your own interpretations.
Parkour Racing: [Sky-high Racing] lets you compete with other players in an epic airborne race, dodging obstacles and striving to become the fastest of all in Fairyland Penglai.
Interactive Mechanisms: Discover and interact with [NARAKA Balls] scattered all over the island for delightful surprises.
2. Photo Mode

Take photos with three different camera modes tailored to meet different needs, and share them with just one button. You can use the scenes from Pantheon, Reverie Cascade, to Fairy Cave and other locations to get that perfect shot!
3. Social Features
[Nearby Voice Chat] and [Nearby Chat] are offered for convenience. The addition of [Nearby Players] in the friend list also allows you to connect with and befriend people you're interested in.
A function has also been added. You can teleport to where your friends and Justice Chamber teammates are by using this function in the friend list.
4. Custom Display
You can change your current character, weapons, and outfit combinations to your liking. Use various emotes and gestures to become the center of attention!
II. New Congeneric Weapon: Dual Halberds
Wield power and grace, a storm's silent embrace.
In the new update, we'll be introducing the ancient Chinese weapon—Dual Halberds. Try it out!
III. New Specialized Practice Mode

Specialized Practice is now available in Free Training mode. This new mode aims to assist players in gaining a better understanding of advanced combat skills through various demonstrations and explanations. You can now access the Specialized Practice menu and start training in Free Training through the training mode selection. You can also switch between Specialized Practice and Free Training modes in the Training Ground.

Specialized Practice is divided into 6 chapters: Common Attack, Grappling Hook, Charged Attack, and more. They consist of 23 training exercises, such as Airborne Horizontal Strike, Consecutive Grappling, Charged Attack and Uppercut Slash, Charged Attack and Slide, Charged Attack and Counter, and others.

Upon reaching a certain level and completing all exercises in the previous chapter, the next chapter will be unlocked automatically. When completing all training exercises in each chapter for the first time, you can claim corresponding rewards in the Specialized Practice menu.
IV. Brand-new series of Star-Collections (Coming Soon)
On the day when the energies of water and gold intersect, a starfall comes.

You may notice some changes to the Collections UI to allow for some new fields of information to be revealed. These changes are in preparation for a new series of cosmetics that will be coming later in NARAKA.

The brand-new Star-Collections will arrive in August. Star-Collections have two qualities: Legendary and Extreme. In addition to a more exquisite appearance, they have some unique features including: [Star-Constellations], [Can be Obtained Repeatedly], [Exclusive Number], [Exclusive Stats], [Custom Name], [Support Trading], [Security Lock], etc.
Star-Collections are incredibly rare and each server has a limited number of Star-Collections available. There will be no new Star-Collections generated once the current distribution is completed.
Star-Collection Features Info
Star-Constellations: Each Constellation represents an attribute that can be randomly altered. Changing the Constellation can affect the appearance of the cosmetic.
Obtained Repeatedly: Star-Collections can be obtained multiple times, and if you obtain a duplicate, it will not be converted into Spectral Silk.
Unique Identifier: Each Star-Collection is assigned an exclusive 6-digit number that is sorted according to the date it was claimed.
Exclusive Stats: When wearing Star-Collections, the battle stats of players are registered exclusively.
Custom Name: Players can customize the name of their Star-Collections, and each name is unique and cannot be repeated.
Tradable: The Star-Collections can be traded on the Treasure Pavilion, Steam and other platforms. (Please stay tuned for more details on the trading platform, set to launch in August.)

Security Lock: The player can use the Security Lock feature to lock the Star-Collections. Once a Star-Collection is locked, it can only be equipped and cannot be restyled, renamed, or undergo any other operations. To activate this feature, players can go to "Settings - Social - Security Lock Settings."
For detailed rules of the above features, please visit the in-game event page. Players can visit ''Inventory - Star-Collection'' to check the obtained collections.

I. Capture the Spirit Well Early Access

Taking advantage of the heroes' victory over Omnius, the Psylith people, who had been suppressed for millennia, broke free from the prison island and initiated their retaliation against the Fervent disciples.

This is a battle between the Fervent and the Psylith factions for control over the Spirit Wells. Each faction consists of 12 players and is divided into 4 teams of 3 players each. Players on the same team cannot select the same Hero.
Capture and maintain control of the 5 Spirit Wells on the battlefield to increase your faction's points.
The faction that reaches a total point of 1000 first wins the game. The result will be a draw if there is no clear winner.
When defeated, you can open the map and choose to revive at your faction's Soul Altars.
In Capture the Spirit Well, players gain Dark Tide Coins over time. Additionally, capturing the Money Tree on the battlefield increases the Dark Tide Coins for your faction.
Challenges to boost morale will appear periodically during the battle. You can get the corresponding rewards upon completing the challenges.
You can spend Dark Tide Coins at the Rift Dealer on the battlefield to assemble powerful sets of equipment for yourself.
When defeated you keep all your items, except for Extreme Souljades.
When there is a significant point difference between the factions, Bounty and Bodyguard Quests will be triggered. Pursuing or protecting the Bounty objective grants your faction a substantial points.
In this mode, the effective range of Ziping Yin's Ultimate, [Saving Grace] and [Saving Grace: Aegis], is changed to 50 meters.

I. New Hero: Zai
Zai's life is defined by pain and struggle. After a prophecy warned she would bring about great calamity, her parents sold her to human traffickers.
She spent years in their hands before escaping to the Annica, an elite clan of assassins who recognized her potential for darkness and violence.
They trained her to be the ultimate killing machine, and though she was denied the vengeance she initially wanted, she's found the next best thing: destroying everything good and pure in the world.

The third skill and ultimate are not yet available in this version. Once available, you can complete heroes' Cultivation Quests to unlock them. If you've completed the required Cultivation Quests before upcoming updates, the skill and ultimate will be unlocked automatically.
II: New Feature: Spirit Well

Starting now, multiple Spirit Wells will spawn at the 240-second and 500-second marks in The Herald's Trial and BOT Mode. When you occupy one of them, you will receive an item that upgrades your main weapon or armor (excluding air-dropped weapons) to Epic quality.
III: New Quest: Valiant Challenge

In Quick Match, The Herald's Trial, and BOT Mode, a new Valiant Challenge Quest Scroll has been introduced. Accepting the quest initiates the Valiant Challenge, which reveals the player's location to all non-friendly players on the map and periodically scans for non-friendly players within a specific range. If the challenger survives within the designated time, they will be rewarded with a large number of Dark Tide Coins.

When a player accepts the Valiant Challenge quest, they become the challenger, and non-friendly players become opponents. Opponents can track the challenger on the map, and defeating the challenger yields considerable rewards. Even assisting in the defeat will earn some Dark Tide Coins.
IV. New Enigma Peak Levels in Showdown
In Showdown, when your sense level reaches 450, you can challenge the new Enigma Peak Levels, where the monsters have strengthened Health and Attack, and some of the Bosses' moves have changed.

In the Enigma Peak, Showdown Souljades drop by various kinds. If you defeat a certain number of Bosses in a single match, you can also receive rewards like Legendary Souljade Choice Gift, Thunder Essence, exclusive Hero Badge, Quench Crystal and so on.

I. Justina Gu
Adjustments have been made to the Rage consumption of [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard] as follows:
Activating the Ultimate will consume 40% Rage, and the remaining Rage will not gradually deplete over time. The duration of the Ultimate remains at 30 seconds.
Using and [Shadowswipe: Blizzard] will consume Rage: 20%/30% in Solo and Duos, and 15%/30% in Trios.
If hits 2 enemies at the same time, the next will not consume Rage.
and [Shadowswipe: Blizzard] will now have a 70% damage reduction effect.

//Dev Notes: The benefits that Justina gains after activating her Ultimate now solely depend on the player's performance with Shadowswipe. In the current environment, we believe that the previous Rage consumption was somewhat high, especially in Solos. After the adjustment, Shadowswipe will now consume Rage, thus limiting its synergy with the Souljade [Soul Release]. However, it gains more flexible endurance through [Rebirth Blossom Spirit].

//Dev Notes: Currently, Valda’s V2 Ultimate has a short duration after activation, making it difficult to exert its intended pressure. The use count and hit experience of the water spear also fall short of expectations. Therefore, we have extended the duration of the V2 Ultimate and optimized the throwing experience of the water spear to make it easier to hit enemies.
III. Yueshan
[Rampage: Heaven's Descent] has been changed to [Rampage: Command]. This ability now attacks surrounding enemies and grants substantial health recovery, with a CD of 16 seconds.
The duration of the recovery frames for has been slightly shortened.

//Dev Notes: Currently, Yueshan's V2 has limited utility and lacks effective recovery capabilities during combat. Therefore, we have made adjustments to V2’s skills and effects to provide Yueshan with a means of health recovery.
IV. Viper Ning
The Recovery reduction effect of [Yushan Enigma: Enfeeble] now lasts for 7 seconds, down from 15, and its CD has been increased from 20 to 22 seconds.

//Dev Notes: Viper Ning's F3 currently triggers opponents to confront and seek healing opportunities after being hit. However, the 15-second healing ban significantly limits this strategy. Therefore, we have reduced the duration of the healing ban and will closely monitor its performance.
V. Akos Hu
The duration of the [Feral Frenzy] and [Feral Frenzy: Grab] Ultimates has been adjusted to 26 seconds in Solos, while it remains 35 seconds in Duos and Trios.
The duration of the recovery frames for the airborne vertical strikes performed during the tiger leap state has been increased.
The airborne horizontal strikes performed during the tiger leap state will no longer stagger targets under the effect of Ziping Yin's [Inspiration Shield].
With the Talent Skill [Roar: Terror], targets under the terror effect can now pre-input commands while in a controlled state.

//Dev Notes: Currently, Akos Hu can gain an advantage by utilizing a pounce attack after activating his Ultimate. While preserving the experience of his enhanced burst ability, we have adjusted the duration of Akos Hu’s abilities in Solos to balance his combat effectiveness against other heroes.

[Roar: Terror] is intended to primarily serve as a tool for focus firing in team modes, but currently, it also provides a strong advantage in initiating combat in Solos. Allowing pre-input commands while under the terror effect will enable players to react promptly once the terror effect ends.
VI. Tarka Ji

The default duration for all of Tarka Ji's Ultimate talents will vary depending on the different game modes. and [Blackout: Vulcan] now last 24 seconds in Solos, while [Blackout: Frenzy] lasts for 20 seconds. The default durations of all Ultimate Talents in Duos and Trios remain unchanged.
The Rage recovery efficiency of [Blackout: Frenzy] has been reduced by 35%, and the Attack boost for both the player and teammates has been adjusted from 10% to 5%.
The Rage consumption of [Inner Fire] and [Inner Fire: Bide] while using [Blackout: Vulcan] has been reduced. The current Rage consumption for both abilities is now 20% across the board.

//Dev Notes: Currently, Tarka Ji's exceptional durability, extended invincibility frames, and stamina make him excel in terms of survival, mobility, and damage output, surpassing most other heroes. Therefore, while preserving his core gameplay, we have adjusted the duration of Tarka Ji’s Ultimates across different modes and talents. This is to maintain a balanced combat pace and ensure fair matchups with other heroes.

III. New Feature: Souljade Recast

Epic and Legendary Showdown Souljades can be recast by consuming another Showdown Souljade of the same quality. After recasting, the attributes of the new Souljade will be randomly selected and combined from the consumed ones, and the values will be random (affected by the original attribute). After recasting, you can choose to keep the original attributes or accept the new ones generated by the recast.

If the number of attributes in the newly created Souljade is less than 4, there is a chance to get an extra attribute and possibly yield an additional powerful rare attribute. Please refer to Narakapedia - Showdown - Buffs - Rare Attribute for further details.

//Dev Note: The attributes of the Showdown Souljades are a crucial part of the development of the Showdown. However, obtaining the desired attributes (and ideal values) through specific combinations of Souljdes has been overly random and difficult. Therefore, we have introduced the recast system to help players develop attributes in a more purposeful and enjoyable way.

3. Each day, you can help a player obtain a Scroll Fragment (by selecting "Share Scroll Fragment" in friends list). You won't consume your Scroll Fragments by doing so. However, each player can receive only one Scroll Fragment per day.

4. After the event ends, you can still claim rewards on the event page within the remaining time. But you can no longer complete Quests nor share Scroll Fragments. Once the time for claiming rewards runs out, the expired Scroll Fragments can be converted into 160 Tae each in the Inventory.

items.text: Brand-new content!
I. A New Episode of Showdown
1. New Level: Gelid Yushan
Among the mist around Yushan Snowy Peaks, countless heroes had gambled their lives for that ancient artifact.
It's time to meet this new boss, the Matron of Yushan, on the top of Yushan Ruins.
2. New Hero Joined: Tianhai
This humble monk transforms into a colossal Vajra warrior, all those who stand in his path shall fall.

In Showdown, Tianhai has a new ability to "Counter" after transforming into Vajra. The Counterstrike combo is enhanced when equipped with the exclusive Souljade that enhances the ultimate, and the Boss is staggered for a longer period.
3. New Mode: Enigma Domain
In the game of Enigma Domain, monsters grow stronger over time. Before time runs out, the more monsters you defeat, the more rewards you will win.
Come and explore the Enigma Domain, there are loads of new Souljades await!
4. New Type of Omens: Frostbite Omens
Affected by Matron of Yushan, many Omens turn into [Frostbite Omens] which accumulate heroes' Frostbite. When Frostbite reaches a certain amount, the hero will be frozen.
Equipping Souljades with [Ice-wielding] attribute can help to resist the effect brought by Frostbite Omens.
5. Showdown Souljade: Ice-wielding

In the new updates, there's a chance to get Souljade with [Ice-wielding] attribute in all Showdown levels. Meanwhile, [Ice Essence] can be obtained by completing weekly challenges. [Ice Essence] can imbue [Ice-wielding] to the those Souljades without this attribute.

Attacking monsters with [Ice-wielding] Souljades can accumulate Frostbite of the monsters. When Frostbite reaches a certain amount, ice blast will be triggered and cause damage to monsters' Astral Aegis.
Each [Ice-wielding] Souljade you equip increases you [Ice-wielding] by 1.
Higher levels of [Ice-wielding] deals more damage to Astral Aegis and can better resist Frostbite Omens.
6. Showdown Souljade
In the updates, 30 new Showdown Souljades are now available, which include:
(1) 7 Ice Souljades of melee weapon, 6 of ranged weapon an 4 of other special effect.
(2) Exclusive Souljades that enhance Tianhai, Temulch and Matari's ultimates.
(3) Defuse·Dash(Counterattack) & (Concentrate), Defuse·Combo(Counterattack) & (Concentrate).
(4) 5 Souljades that enhance ranged attack and Weaponry Chest Boon.
II. Feria Shen's new skill [Gunplay: Aim] and ultimate [Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot] are now available
[Gunplay: Aim]
Leap backward and raise the gun, aim and shoot with high damage and mark enemies with for 3 sec.
Move the crosshair while using this skill to adjust the leap direction.
[Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot]
Set a beacon at the target point and knock nearby enemies airborne.
Feria and allies can pilot [Bronze Mech] by interacting with the beacon.

Compared to ultimate [Mech Mayhem], the [Bronze Mech] summoned by beacon has lower Health. When shooting enemies, it deals higher damage and builds Energy faster (but its own Energy recovery speed is slower).

//Dev Note: Tarka Ji's elbow strike, which has a low Energy cost, gives him the upper hand in a 1v1 battle. Enemies knocked down have no countermeasures against Taka Ji's elbow strike. Therefore, we adjusted the energy cost and attack range of Tarka Ji's elbow strike so his enemies could counter him.

notes.title: I. Adjustments to Calculation of Damage Reduction

items.text: Now according to different sources, damage reductions are divided into [Item Damage Reduction], [Ultimate Skill Damage Reduction], [Talent Skill Damage Reduction] and [Weapon Damage Reduction]. Reductions from the same sources are added up with an upper limit of 90%, while those from different sources are multiplied. After the updates, the final damage reduction by multiplying will be slightly reduced. But damage reduction of a single kind remains unchanged.

For example: when Justina Gu casts [Ice Core], she has 70% [Talent Skill Damage Reduction] during the preparation stage. If her teammate Yueshan casts Formation Roar as Almighty General, all team members will get the effect that grants 35% [Talent Skill Damage Reduction]. Now with Justina Gu's 70% [Talent Skill Damage Reduction], her final damage reduction is 90% because the sum of the two effects exceeds the upper limit of 90%. Thus Justina Gu only takes 10% of the original damage.
If Justina Gu has the 10% [In-game Item Damage Reduction] from simultaneously, the final damage she will take is: (1-90%) * (1-10%) = 9%.

notes.title: II. Adjustments to Calculation of Damage Bonus

items.text: Now all damage bonuses are added up. After the updates, the final damage bonus by multiplying is slightly reduced. But damage bonus of a single kind remains unchanged.
